domains.name: asset
domains.description: Enterprise asset management domain owning the full lifecycle of physical infrastructure assets including WTP/WWTP equipment, pipes, pumps, valves, electrical systems, and vehicles. Manages asset registry, condition assessments, criticality ratings, preventive and corrective maintenance, work order management, depreciation schedules, and CAPEX/OPEX planning. Integrates with IBM Maximo CMMS and SAP PM.

products.name: registry
products.description: Master record for every physical infrastructure asset owned or operated by the utility, including WTP/WWTP equipment, pipes, pumps, valves, electrical systems, meters, and vehicles. Captures asset identity, classification, installation details, location (GIS coordinates), manufacturer, model, serial number, asset tag, parent-child hierarchy, operational status, and lifecycle dates. This is the authoritative SSOT for all physical assets — the IBM Maximo asset master and SAP PM equipment master both synchronize to this record.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each physical infrastructure asset record in the enterprise asset registry. This is the authoritative SSOT identifier that IBM Maximo Asset Management and SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) equipment master synchronize against.

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Registry stores asset classification as a free‑text field; linking to the asset_class taxonomy enables consistent classification and removes the redundant string column. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset record creation audit trail for data quality accountability, asset management program metrics, and regulatory compliance documentation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Registry currently has no explicit location reference; adding a foreign key to location allows assets to be tied to a physical site and supports location‑based reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: parent_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent asset in the asset hierarchy (e.g., a pump impeller's parent is the pump assembly; the pump assembly's parent is the pump station). Enables parent-child asset hierarchy navigation for maintenance cost roll-up and condition assessment aggregation. Null for top-level assets. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Critical assets (SCADA systems, treatment equipment, pump stations) often have long-term service/maintenance contracts. Links enable contract compliance tracking, SLA monitoring, preventive maintenanc. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_address. Business justification: Distribution assets (hydrants, valves, mains) serve specific service addresses. Critical for emergency response, outage notifications, GIS integration, and customer impact analysis during main breaks. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase or construction cost of the asset in US dollars at the time of acquisition. Represents the capitalized cost basis used for depreciation calculations and fixed asset register reporting. Sourced from SAP FI/CO asset accounting module. Required for GASB Statement No. 34 infrastructure asset reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Operational domain category indicating which business process area the asset belongs to (e.g., water_treatment for WTP equipment, wastewater_treatment for WWTP equipment, distribution for pipes and valves in the distribution network, collection for sewer infrastructure, metering for AMI/AMR devices). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: water_treatment|wastewater_treatment|distribution|collection|metering|electrical|mechanical|civil|vehicle|instrumentation_control — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short description of the asset (e.g., 'Raw Water Pump No. 3', 'Influent Gate Valve 12-inch', 'Chlorine Contact Basin Filter 2'). Used as the primary display label in CMMS, GIS, and reporting interfaces. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_tag
attributes.description: Physical asset tag number (barcode, QR code, or RFID label) affixed to the asset in the field. Used by field technicians for asset identification during inspections, maintenance, and inventory audits. Corresponds to the Maximo asset tag field. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification within the asset class providing more granular categorization (e.g., Centrifugal Pump, Gate Valve, Ductile Iron Pipe, AMI Smart Meter). Aligns with IBM Maximo asset type and SAP PM equipment category for maintenance planning and spare parts management.

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated_capacity field. Common units include GPM (Gallons per Minute) for pumps, MGD (Million Gallons per Day) for treatment processes, gallons for storage tanks, kW for electrical equipment, and PSI (Pounds per Square Inch) for pressure vessels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GPM|MGD|gallons|kW|kVA|HP|PSI|NTU|mg_L — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: condition_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal condition assessment performed on the asset. Used to determine assessment currency and schedule the next inspection cycle. Condition assessments may be visual inspections, CCTV surveys, vibration analysis, or other diagnostic methods. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Standardized condition rating of the asset based on the most recent condition assessment, using a 1-5 scale where 1=Excellent/New, 2=Good, 3=Fair, 4=Poor, 5=Very Poor/Failed. Aligned with AWWA and WEF condition assessment frameworks. Drives maintenance prioritization and renewal planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset record was first created in the enterprise asset registry. Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Risk-based criticality classification of the asset based on consequence of failure analysis (CoFA). 'critical' assets have the highest consequence of failure impacting public health, regulatory compliance, or major service disruption. Used to prioritize maintenance resources, Capital Improvement Program (CIP) investments, and emergency response planning. Aligned with AWWA risk and resilience assessment methodology.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was permanently decommissioned, retired, or removed from service. Null for active assets. Used for asset lifecycle reporting, fixed asset register reconciliation, and Capital Improvement Program (CIP) tracking. Triggers write-off in SAP FI/CO fixed asset module. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: diameter_mm
attributes.description: Nominal diameter of the asset in millimeters. For pipes and valves, this is the internal bore diameter. For pumps, this is the discharge diameter. Used for hydraulic capacity calculations, spare parts specification, and network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the asset above mean sea level in meters. Critical for hydraulic modeling, pressure zone assignment, and gravity-fed system design. Used in Innovyze InfoWater hydraulic models and Esri ArcGIS 3D network analysis. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: expected_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated total useful life of the asset in years as defined by engineering standards, manufacturer specifications, or utility policy. Used for depreciation calculations, Capital Improvement Program (CIP) planning, and asset renewal forecasting. Aligns with GASB Statement No. 34 infrastructure reporting requirements. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: Hierarchical functional location code representing the physical or functional position of the asset within the utility's infrastructure (e.g., WTP-PUMP-STATION-01-PUMP-03). Mirrors the SAP PM Functional Location (FLOC) structure and IBM Maximo Location field. Used for structured asset hierarchy navigation and maintenance cost allocation.

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: The unique feature identifier for this asset in the Esri ArcGIS geographic information system. Enables spatial queries, network tracing, and hydraulic model integration via Innovyze InfoWater. Used for field crew navigation and infrastructure mapping. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was physically installed and placed into service at its current location. Used as the baseline for age calculations, depreciation schedules, warranty period tracking, and remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Sourced from IBM Maximo installation date field.

attributes.name: is_lead_service_line
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is a lead service line or contains lead components. Critical for compliance with the EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) which requires utilities to inventory and replace lead service lines. True = confirmed lead service line; False = non-lead or unknown.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed maintenance activity (preventive or corrective) performed on this asset. Used to calculate maintenance intervals, identify overdue assets, and support compliance reporting for regulatory-mandated maintenance activities. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the asset record in the enterprise asset registry. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with IBM Maximo and SAP PM, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, field crew navigation, spatial analysis, and hydraulic network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS asset layer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, field crew navigation, spatial analysis, and hydraulic network modeling in Innovyze InfoWater. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS asset layer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: The primary maintenance approach applied to this asset as defined in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). 'preventive' indicates time-based scheduled maintenance; 'predictive' indicates condition-monitoring-based maintenance; 'condition_based' indicates maintenance triggered by condition thresholds; 'run_to_failure' is applied to non-critical, easily replaceable assets. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was manufactured by the OEM. May differ from installation date for assets stored in inventory before deployment. Used for age-based condition assessment and manufacturer warranty calculations. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the asset (e.g., Xylem, Grundfos, Flowserve, Siemens, ABB). Used for warranty management, spare parts procurement, and vendor performance analysis. Sourced from IBM Maximo manufacturer field.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_num
attributes.description: The asset number as assigned and maintained in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). This is the operational cross-reference key used by maintenance crews and work order management. Must be unique within the Maximo instance.

attributes.name: model_num
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or product number for the asset (e.g., 'LF 3196 STX', 'NK 65-200'). Used for spare parts identification, technical documentation retrieval, and procurement of replacement units. Sourced from IBM Maximo model field.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled preventive maintenance activity is due for this asset. Derived from the PM schedule and last maintenance date. Used for maintenance planning, resource scheduling, and compliance tracking in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the asset. 'in_service' indicates the asset is active and performing its intended function. 'standby' indicates the asset is available but not currently operating. 'out_of_service' indicates the asset is temporarily removed from service for maintenance or repair. 'decommissioned' indicates permanent retirement. Drives maintenance scheduling and regulatory reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: pipe_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the asset (e.g., Ductile Iron, PVC, HDPE, Cast Iron, Concrete, Stainless Steel, Copper). Critical for corrosion risk assessment, Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) compliance, Cured-in-Place Pipe (CIPP) rehabilitation planning, and remaining useful life estimation. Applicable primarily to pipe and fitting assets.

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance schedule record in IBM Maximo that governs recurring maintenance activities for this asset. Links the asset to its O&M (Operations and Maintenance) task plans, frequencies, and resource requirements.

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate power rating of the asset in kilowatts (kW). Applicable to pumps, blowers, motors, generators, and other electrical equipment. Used for energy consumption analysis, Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) sizing, electrical load planning, and OPEX budgeting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: pressure_zone
attributes.description: The hydraulic pressure zone or District Metered Area (DMA) in which the asset is located. Used for pressure management, Non-Revenue Water (NRW) analysis, and distribution network operations. Aligns with Innovyze InfoWater zone definitions and GIS pressure zone polygons. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: rated_capacity
attributes.description: The manufacturer-rated operational capacity of the asset expressed in the appropriate unit of measure (see capacity_unit field). For pumps: Gallons per Minute (GPM); for treatment units: Million Gallons per Day (MGD); for tanks: gallons. Used for capacity planning, hydraulic modeling, and performance benchmarking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier assigned by a regulatory authority (e.g., state drinking water program, EPA) for compliance tracking and reporting purposes. Used in regulatory submissions such as the Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR), and NPDES permit compliance documentation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: replacement_cost
attributes.description: Current estimated cost to replace the asset with a new equivalent unit in US dollars. Updated periodically based on market pricing and engineering estimates. Used for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) budgeting, insurance valuation, and risk-based asset management decision-making. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: sap_equipment_num
attributes.description: The equipment number assigned in SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) module. Used for integration with SAP FI/CO for depreciation, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and maintenance cost postings. Enables bidirectional synchronization between SAP PM and the asset registry. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: scada_tag
attributes.description: The Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) tag name used to identify this asset's data point(s) in the OSIsoft PI Historian system. Enables linkage between the physical asset registry and real-time operational data streams for performance monitoring, alarm management, and predictive maintenance analytics.

attributes.name: serial_num
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific asset unit. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and precise asset identification when multiple identical units exist. Sourced from IBM Maximo serial number field.

attributes.name: vibe_asset_domain_flag
attributes.description: Marks that this product is part of the built-out asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_mutation_flag
attributes.description: Flag added by VIBE mutator to ensure entity touched. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer's warranty for the asset expires. Used to trigger warranty claim processes before expiry and to transition maintenance responsibility from warranty to O&M budget. Sourced from IBM Maximo warranty end date.

products.name: asset_class
products.description: Reference taxonomy defining the classification hierarchy for utility assets (e.g., Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Instrumentation, Vehicle). Each class carries default useful life, depreciation method, maintenance strategy, criticality weighting rules, and applicable regulatory standards. Used to drive preventive maintenance scheduling, CAPEX planning, and ISO 55001 asset management framework alignment. [SSOT: Canonical source of truth for this concept across domains.] Differentiated: asset_class is physical asset taxonomy (not customer service tier).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the asset class record in the enterprise asset management system. Primary key for the asset_class reference taxonomy. [ROLE: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity is a reference taxonomy/classification table defining the hierarchy of utility asset types; per-role minimums are exempt, but MASTER_RESOURCE categories are applied for completeness given the entity carries rich business metadata beyond a simple code list.]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset class definition authorship for configuration management, subject matter expert identification, and asset hierarchy governance. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: ami_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class are part of the AMI/AMR metering infrastructure managed via the Sensus FlexNet AMI Platform. True for smart meters and communication endpoints; False for all other asset classes. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_domain
attributes.description: Operational domain to which this asset class primarily belongs within the utility (e.g., Water Treatment, Water Distribution, Wastewater Collection, Wastewater Treatment, Metering, Fleet, Facilities, Cross-Domain). Drives domain-specific maintenance strategies and regulatory reporting alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Water Treatment|Water Distribution|Wastewater Collection|Wastewater Treatment|Metering|Fleet|Facilities|Cross-Domain — promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: capex_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Minimum acquisition or renewal cost in USD above which expenditures on assets of this class are capitalized as CAPEX rather than expensed as OPEX. Aligned with GAAP/GASB capitalization policies and SAP FI/CO asset accounting rules. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cip_program_category
attributes.description: CIP program category under which capital renewal projects for assets of this class are budgeted and tracked. Aligns with the utility's multi-year CIP planning structure in SAP PS and financial reporting to the Public Utilities Commission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Water Supply|Water Treatment|Water Distribution|Wastewater Collection|Wastewater Treatment|Metering|Facilities|Fleet|Cross-Program — promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the asset class within the enterprise taxonomy (e.g., MECH-PUMP, ELEC-TRANS, CIVIL-PIPE). Used as the externally-known business identifier in IBM Maximo, SAP PM, and GIS integrations.

attributes.name: class_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the asset class, including its functional role within water or wastewater operations, typical installation context, and distinguishing characteristics from adjacent classes. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset class (e.g., 'Centrifugal Pump', 'Distribution Main Pipe', 'UV Disinfection Unit'). Used in reports, work orders, and CAPEX planning documents. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset class record within the reference taxonomy. 'Active' classes are available for new asset registrations; 'Deprecated' classes are retained for historical assets but cannot be assigned to new assets. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: condition_assessment_method
attributes.description: Default method used to assess the physical condition of assets in this class. CIPP and pipe assets typically use CCTV; rotating equipment uses vibration analysis; distribution mains may use acoustic leak detection. Drives field inspection work order types in Maximo. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Visual Inspection|CCTV|Acoustic Leak Detection|Vibration Analysis|Ultrasonic Testing|Hydraulic Testing|SCADA Monitoring|Not Applicable — promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure
attributes.description: Primary category of consequence if assets of this class fail. Drives risk-based maintenance prioritization and emergency response planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Service Interruption|Public Health Risk|Environmental Non-Compliance|Safety Hazard|Financial Loss|Reputational — promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.
attributes.value_regex: Service Interruption|Public Health Risk|Environmental Non-Compliance|Safety Hazard|Financial Loss|Reputational

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: criticality_tier

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional record for all maintenance activities — preventive (PM), corrective (CM), predictive (PdM), and emergency work orders. Captures work type, priority, originating asset, assigned crew/technician, scheduled and actual start/finish dates, labor hours, failure code, cause code, remedy code, downtime duration, and work order cost. products.name: asset_meter
products.description: Tracks operational meters, counters, and their reading history for asset condition and usage monitoring — distinct from customer billing meters (owned by the metering domain). Examples include pump run-hours, motor starts, valve cycle counts, flow totalizers (MGD), pressure transducers (PSI), and vibration sensors. Captures meter type, unit of measure, current reading, rollover value, calibration status, and historical reading records (reading date/time, value, source — manual or SCADA/PI Historian automated, inspector ID, delta from previous reading). Feeds meter-based PM triggers, tracks asset utilization trends, and supports predictive maintenance analytics. Integrates with OSIsoft PI Historian. [SSOT: Domain-specific view; canonical source is metering.metering_meter.] Consolidated: metering.metering_meter is SSOT; this table references it.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA M6; IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_meter_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the asset meter record in the enterprise data platform. Primary key for the asset_meter product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent physical asset (pump, motor, valve, pipe segment, vehicle, etc.) to which this operational meter or counter is attached. Links to the asset master record in the asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: canonical_metering_meter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the canonical metering meter referenced by each asset meter record in the asset domain.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location or facility location record where the metered asset is installed. Links to the location hierarchy in the asset domain (e.g., WTP, pump station, WWTP). Supports geographic and facility-level aggregation of meter data. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: metering_meter_id
attributes.description: The native meter identifier from IBM Maximo Asset Management CMMS (METERNAME or internal Maximo meter key). Used for system-of-record traceability and bidirectional synchronization between the Silver Layer and Maximo.

attributes.name: primary_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent physical asset (pump, motor, valve, pipe segment, vehicle, etc.) to which this operational meter or counter is attached. Links to the asset master record in the asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: alarm_high_threshold
attributes.description: The upper alarm threshold value for this meter. When the reading exceeds this value, a SCADA or CMMS alarm is triggered. For example, high vibration alarm at 0.5 in/s for a pump motor. Supports integration with SCADA HMI alarm management. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: alarm_low_threshold
attributes.description: The lower alarm threshold value for this meter. When the reading falls below this value, a SCADA or CMMS alarm is triggered. For example, low flow alarm at 0.1 MGD for a treatment process feed pump. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: average_reading_rate
attributes.description: The average rate of change per day for this meter, calculated and stored by the CMMS during reading entry (not a derived KPI — stored as a CMMS field used for PM trigger forecasting). For example, average run-hours per day for a pump. Used by meter-based PM triggers to forecast next maintenance due date. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: avg_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used by the CMMS to compute the average_reading_rate. SLIDING_WINDOW: rolling average over a configurable number of recent readings. FIXED_PERIOD: average over a fixed calendar period. LAST_READING: uses only the most recent reading interval. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The required frequency of calibration expressed in calendar days. Used to compute next_calibration_date from last_calibration_date and to schedule calibration work orders in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Current calibration status of the meter instrument. CALIBRATED: within valid calibration period. DUE: calibration due within the next calibration_interval_days. OVERDUE: calibration date has passed without recalibration. IN_PROGRESS: currently being calibrated. NOT_REQUIRED: meter type does not require formal calibration (e.g., simple cycle counters). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: calibration_tolerance
attributes.description: Acceptable measurement tolerance or accuracy specification for this meter expressed in the meter's unit of measure. Readings outside this tolerance trigger recalibration. For example, ±0.5 PSI for a pressure transducer or ±0.01 MGD for a flow totalizer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset meter record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: current_reading
attributes.description: The most recent recorded value of the meter or counter as of the last_reading_date. For CONTINUOUS meters this is the cumulative total; for GAUGE meters this is the last observed point-in-time value. Principal quantitative fact for this MASTER_RESOURCE. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was permanently removed from service and retired. Null for active meters. Used for lifecycle reporting and asset history. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: deprecated_flag
attributes.description: The deprecated flag value recorded for each asset meter in the asset domain.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was physically installed on the asset. Used to calculate meter age, warranty expiry, and to establish the baseline reading at installation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_meter
attributes.description: Indicates whether readings from this meter are used in regulatory compliance reporting (e.g., EPA NPDES Discharge Monitoring Reports, Safe Drinking Water Act compliance, Monthly Operating Reports). True = regulatory-grade meter subject to calibration and data integrity requirements. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the meter was most recently calibrated and certified as accurate. Critical for regulatory compliance where metered values (e.g., flow, pressure, chemical dosing) are used in EPA/NPDES reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_reading_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Meter Reading Date and Time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent meter reading captured, whether from SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian automated feed or manual entry in IBM Maximo. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

tag_set.value: Last Meter Reading Date and Time

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the physical location where the meter is installed on the asset, e.g., 'Discharge side of Pump 3 at WTP Building A', 'Inlet valve actuator shaft'. Supplements the parent asset location for field technician navigation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer of the meter instrument or sensor hardware, e.g., Endress+Hauser, Yokogawa, Emerson, Siemens. Used for procurement, warranty tracking, and spare parts management. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the meter reading, e.g., HOURS (run-hours), STARTS (motor starts), CYCLES (valve cycles), MGD (Million Gallons per Day), GPM (Gallons per Minute), PSI (Pounds per Square Inch), NTU (Nephelometric Turbidity Units), RPM, DEGREES_F, INCHES. Aligns with OSIsoft PI Historian tag engineering units.

attributes.name: meter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the meter or counter, e.g., 'Pump 3 Run Hours', 'Valve 12 Cycle Count', 'Influent Flow Totalizer'. Used for display in CMMS work orders and PM triggers. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: meter_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier for the meter as assigned in IBM Maximo CMMS or SAP PM. Used for cross-system reference and field identification. Distinct from customer billing meter numbers managed by the Metering domain.

attributes.name: meter_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the meter. ACTIVE: in service and collecting readings. INACTIVE: temporarily not in use. RETIRED: permanently decommissioned. SUSPENDED: readings paused (e.g., asset out of service). PENDING_CALIBRATION: due for or undergoing calibration. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: meter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meter per IBM Maximo meter type taxonomy. CONTINUOUS: accumulating counter that never resets (e.g., run-hours, cycle counts, flow totalizer). GAUGE: point-in-time measurement that can go up or down (e.g., PSI, vibration amplitude, temperature). CHARACTERISTIC: qualitative or categorical observation (e.g., condition rating, oil color).

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the meter instrument. Used for procurement, spare parts identification, and technical documentation lookup. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: Added by mutator to ensure change. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the meter must next be calibrated to maintain measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance. Drives calibration work order generation in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag identifier associated with this meter for automated SCADA data ingestion. Enables direct linkage between the CMMS meter record and the PI Historian time-series data stream. Null if the meter is not integrated with PI Historian.

attributes.name: pm_trigger_interval
attributes.description: The recurring interval of meter units between successive PM work order generations. For example, every 500 run-hours or every 1000 valve cycles. Works in conjunction with pm_trigger_threshold for ongoing PM scheduling. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: pm_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: The meter reading value at which a Preventive Maintenance (PM) work order is automatically generated. For example, a pump PM triggered every 2000 run-hours. Core field enabling meter-based PM scheduling in IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: previous_reading
attributes.description: The meter reading value recorded immediately prior to the current reading. Used to calculate consumption delta between readings and to detect anomalous jumps or rollover events. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: previous_reading_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Meter Reading Date and Time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the meter reading that preceded the current reading. Used in conjunction with previous_reading to compute usage rate and validate reading intervals. Ref: IBM Maximo.

tag_set.value: Previous Meter Reading Date and Time

attributes.name: reading_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency at which meter readings are collected. CONTINUOUS: real-time SCADA/PI Historian streaming. HOURLY/DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY: scheduled batch collection. ON_DEMAND: readings taken only when required (e.g., during inspections or work orders). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: reading_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum valid reading value for this meter as defined by the instrument's operating range or process design limits. Readings above this value are flagged as suspect or trigger alarms. For example, 150 PSI maximum for a distribution pressure transducer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: reading_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum valid reading value for this meter as defined by the instrument's operating range or process design limits. Readings below this value are flagged as suspect. For example, 0 PSI minimum for a pressure transducer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: reading_source
attributes.description: The system or method by which the current meter reading was captured. SCADA: from Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition system. PI_HISTORIAN: from OSIsoft PI Historian automated feed. MANUAL: entered manually by a technician in IBM Maximo. AMI: from Advanced Metering Infrastructure. CMMS_IMPORT: batch import from CMMS. FIELD_DEVICE: direct PLC/RTU feed.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_code
attributes.description: The regulatory parameter code or identifier associated with this meter for compliance reporting submissions, e.g., EPA DMR parameter code, NPDES permit parameter identifier, or state drinking water program monitoring code. Null if is_regulatory_meter is False. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, technician observations, or special instructions related to this meter. For example, notes about known reading anomalies, temporary bypass conditions, or pending replacement. Sourced from IBM Maximo meter remarks field.

attributes.name: rollover_value
attributes.description: The maximum value the meter counter can reach before rolling over to zero. Applicable to CONTINUOUS meters with fixed-digit displays (e.g., 99999.9 hours). Used to correctly compute cumulative usage across rollover events. Null if the meter has no rollover limit. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: sap_measuring_point_code

attributes.description: The measuring point identifier from SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) module corresponding to this asset meter. Enables reconciliation between IBM Maximo CMMS and SAP PM for assets managed across both systems.

attributes.name: warranty_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical infrastructure asset (e.g., pump, valve, pipe, electrical panel, vehicle, WTP/WWTP equipment) covered by this warranty record. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: claim_submission_process

attributes.name: claimed_amount_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all warranty claims submitted against this warranty record to date, expressed in USD. Used to track remaining claim capacity against the maximum claim value. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: component_covered
attributes.description: Specific sub-component or assembly of the asset covered by this warranty record (e.g., 'motor winding', 'pump impeller', 'control panel', 'membrane module'). A single asset may have multiple warranty records covering different components. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The vendor-issued or internally-assigned contract number governing the warranty terms and conditions. Used for legal reference and claim dispute resolution. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which warranty coverage expires. Proactive monitoring of this date enables timely claim submission and maintenance routing through warranty channels before expiration, reducing OPEX. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of what is covered under this warranty, including specific components, failure modes, and exclusions. For example: 'Covers all mechanical and electrical components of the centrifugal pump excluding wear parts (seals, impellers) and damage caused by cavitation or improper operation.'. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which warranty coverage becomes effective. Typically aligned with the asset installation date, commissioning date, or purchase date depending on warranty terms. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this warranty record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to all monetary values on this warranty record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency environments for international equipment procurement.

attributes.name: duration_months
attributes.description: Total length of the warranty coverage period expressed in months. Derived from the vendor contract terms and used for planning and renewal tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Explicit list of conditions, components, or failure modes NOT covered by this warranty. Critical for maintenance routing decisions to avoid voiding coverage through excluded repair activities. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: expiry_alert_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the coverage end date at which an automated alert should be triggered to notify asset managers and maintenance planners of impending warranty expiration. Enables proactive claim submission and maintenance routing. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: extended_warranty_cost
attributes.description: The cost paid to purchase an extended warranty beyond the standard manufacturer warranty period, expressed in USD. Captured for CAPEX/OPEX planning and ROI analysis of extended warranty investments. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: The date the covered asset or component was physically installed and commissioned. Often used as the warranty coverage start trigger and is required for warranty claim substantiation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this warranty record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: max_claim_value
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative monetary value of claims that can be submitted under this warranty agreement, expressed in USD. Enables OPEX planning and ensures claims do not exceed contractual limits. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: maximo_warranty_code
attributes.description: The native warranty record identifier from IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). Retained as a cross-reference key to enable bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CMMS source system.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: Added by mutator to ensure change. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional warranty-related information not captured in structured fields, such as special claim conditions, vendor negotiation history, or maintenance routing instructions specific to this warranty. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_metric
attributes.description: For performance-type warranties, the specific operational metric that is guaranteed (e.g., 'pump flow rate >= 500 GPM', 'motor efficiency >= 92%', 'membrane rejection rate >= 99%'). Null for parts/labor-only warranties. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum or target numeric value of the performance guarantee metric that the asset must achieve under the warranty. For example, 500 (GPM) or 92 (%). Used to trigger performance warranty claims when asset output falls below the guaranteed level. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the performance guarantee threshold value (e.g., GPM, MGD, PSI, %, NTU). Ensures correct interpretation of the numeric threshold in the context of the guaranteed metric. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: The date the asset or component was purchased. Some warranties are triggered from purchase date rather than installation date; retained for accurate coverage period calculation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP purchase order number associated with the original procurement of the asset or component. Links the warranty to the procurement transaction for audit and claim substantiation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date the warranty was formally registered with the vendor or manufacturer. Some warranties require registration within a specified period post-purchase to be valid; failure to register may void coverage. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty agreement includes an option to renew or extend coverage beyond the original expiration date. If True, renewal terms and pricing should be captured in the coverage_scope field. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: requires_oem_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warranty terms require that all maintenance and repair work be performed exclusively by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or an OEM-authorized service provider. If True, routing non-OEM technicians to this asset may void the warranty. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: sap_pm_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP PM maintenance order number associated with warranty-covered repair or maintenance work. Links warranty coverage to the SAP PM work order for cost recovery and OPEX tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this warranty can be transferred to a new owner or operator in the event of asset sale, transfer, or organizational restructuring. Relevant for capital project asset handovers. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the designated warranty claims contact at the vendor or manufacturer. Used for formal claim submission and written correspondence. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated warranty claims contact person at the vendor or manufacturer organization. Used to initiate and follow up on warranty claims. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the designated warranty claims contact at the vendor or manufacturer. Used to initiate and follow up on warranty claims. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_asset_domain_flag
attributes.description: Marks that this product is part of the built-out asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_mutation_flag
attributes.description: Flag added by VIBE mutator to ensure entity touched. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known warranty certificate or agreement number assigned by the vendor or manufacturer. Used for claim submission and correspondence with the warranty provider. Aligns with IBM Maximo warranty record identifier.

attributes.name: warranty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warranty record. 'active' indicates coverage is in force; 'expired' indicates the coverage period has ended; 'claimed' indicates a claim has been submitted and is under review; 'voided' indicates the warranty was invalidated (e.g., unauthorized repair); 'pending_activation' indicates the warranty has been registered but the coverage period has not yet started. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warranty coverage scope. 'parts' covers replacement components only; 'labor' covers repair labor costs; 'performance' guarantees operational output levels (e.g., pump flow rate, motor efficiency); 'comprehensive' covers both parts and labor; 'extended' is a purchased extension beyond the original term; 'manufacturer' is the standard OEM warranty. Ref: IBM Maximo.

products.name: depreciation_schedule
products.description: Financial depreciation schedule for capital assets, capturing acquisition cost, salvage value, useful life (years), depreciation method (straight-line, declining balance, units of production), annual depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and depreciation start date. Aligned with GAAP/GASB standards for municipal utility accounting. Integrates with SAP FI/CO Fixed Asset module and supports CAPEX/OPEX reporting.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: depreciation_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the depreciation schedule record. Primary key for this entity. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Capitalized assets from CIP projects require depreciation schedules linked to originating project for GASB 34 compliance, rate case justification, and audit trail connecting capital expenditure author. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital asset for which this depreciation schedule is maintained. Links to the enterprise asset registry. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital asset for which this depreciation schedule is maintained. Links to the enterprise asset registry. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Depreciation schedules calculate periodic depreciation expense for fixed assets. Direct link supports automated depreciation posting, GASB 34 infrastructure reporting, and rate base calculations for u. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized from the depreciation start date through the end of the current fiscal period. Represents the contra-asset balance on the balance sheet. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the asset at acquisition, including purchase price, installation, freight, and any directly attributable costs required to bring the asset to its intended use. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense allocated for the full fiscal year for this asset. For straight-line method: depreciable_base / useful_life_years. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code categorizing the type of capital asset for depreciation area assignment and useful life defaults (e.g., 'PUMP', 'PIPE', 'BLDG', 'VEHICLE', 'ELEC', 'METER'). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the capital asset being depreciated (e.g., 'WTP High-Service Pump Unit 3', 'WWTP Aeration Blower', '12-inch Ductile Iron Main - Oak Street'). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Functional location or facility code where the asset is installed (e.g., WTP facility code, WWTP unit, pump station ID, distribution zone). Aligns with IBM Maximo functional location hierarchy and Esri ArcGIS GIS asset registry.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The externally-known fixed asset number as assigned in SAP FI/CO Fixed Asset Accounting (FI-AA) or IBM Maximo. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: capex_project_number
attributes.description: The Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project number associated with the asset's acquisition or construction. Links depreciation schedules to CAPEX planning and project close-out reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was formally capitalized and transferred from construction-in-progress (CIP) to fixed assets in SAP FI-AA. May differ from depreciation start date for assets with a commissioning lag. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code representing the legal entity or municipal utility enterprise to which this depreciation schedule belongs. Supports multi-entity financial reporting and GASB fund accounting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which depreciation charges are posted, enabling OPEX/CAPEX allocation by operational unit (e.g., WTP operations, distribution, wastewater). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: declining_balance_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied per period for declining balance or double declining balance depreciation methods. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 = 20%). Null for straight-line method. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciable_base
attributes.description: The amount subject to depreciation, calculated as acquisition cost minus salvage value. This is the total amount to be allocated over the asset's useful life. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area identifier representing the valuation purpose (e.g., '01' for book depreciation per GAAP/GASB, '15' for tax depreciation, '20' for cost accounting). Supports parallel valuation for regulatory and tax reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_convention
attributes.description: The period convention applied to determine depreciation in the first and last year of the asset's life (e.g., full_month, half_year, pro_rata). Aligns with SAP FI-AA period control settings. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_end_date
attributes.description: The projected or actual date on which depreciation ceases, corresponding to the end of the asset's useful life or full depreciation of the depreciable base. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key code that defines the calculation method, period control, and base value for depreciation posting (e.g., 'LINR' for straight-line, '0000' for no depreciation). Enables direct reconciliation with SAP Fixed Asset Accounting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the depreciable base over the asset's useful life. Straight-line is most common for municipal water utility infrastructure per GASB. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: straight_line|declining_balance|double_declining_balance|units_of_production|sum_of_years_digits — promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which depreciation begins for the asset, typically the in-service date or acquisition date per GAAP/GASB capitalization policy. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was retired, disposed of, or decommissioned. Triggers cessation of depreciation and recognition of any gain or loss on disposal in SAP FI-AA. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received upon disposal or sale of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal: disposal_proceeds minus net_book_value at disposal date. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (month 1–12) within the fiscal year for which this depreciation record applies. Enables monthly depreciation posting and period-end close reconciliation in SAP FI/CO. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this depreciation schedule record applies. Supports annual depreciation posting, CAPEX/OPEX reporting, and GASB financial statement preparation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Governmental fund code (e.g., Enterprise Fund, Capital Projects Fund) to which the asset and its depreciation are attributed, per GASB fund accounting requirements for municipal utilities. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI General Ledger account code for the depreciation expense posting (e.g., the depreciation expense account and accumulated depreciation contra-asset account). Enables financial statement mapping. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment charges recognized against the asset when its carrying value exceeds its recoverable amount, per GAAP ASC 360 impairment testing. Reduces net book value beyond scheduled depreciation. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was placed into operational service. This is the trigger date for depreciation commencement per GAAP/GASB policy and aligns with IBM Maximo asset activation.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date the depreciation schedule was last reviewed and validated by the asset accounting team, supporting annual audit requirements and GASB financial statement preparation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: Added by mutator to ensure change. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Key metric for CAPEX/OPEX planning and asset renewal decisions. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording significant accounting judgments, useful life revision rationale, impairment triggers, regulatory directives, or other material information relevant to this depreciation schedule. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: period_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The depreciation expense allocated for the specific fiscal period (month). Used for monthly journal entry posting to the depreciation expense account in SAP FI/CO. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was last modified, supporting change tracking, audit trail, and period-end reconciliation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years as of the last assessment date. Used for condition-based depreciation adjustments and asset renewal planning under CIP. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the asset accountant or finance officer who last reviewed and approved this depreciation schedule record, supporting audit trail and SOX/GASB compliance. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to calculate the depreciable base. For most water utility infrastructure, this is often zero. Expressed in USD. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation schedule record. 'active' = depreciation ongoing; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., asset taken out of service); 'fully_depreciated' = net book value at or near salvage value; 'disposed' = asset retired; 'impaired' = impairment recognized; 'draft' = pending approval. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: units_of_production_period
attributes.description: Actual production units consumed during the current fiscal period, used to calculate period depreciation under the units-of-production method (e.g., gallons pumped, operating hours logged via SCADA/OSIsoft PI Historian).

attributes.name: units_of_production_total
attributes.description: Total estimated production units over the asset's useful life, used as the denominator for units-of-production depreciation method (e.g., total gallons pumped, total operating hours). Applicable only when depreciation_method = 'units_of_production'. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: useful_life_revised_years
attributes.description: Updated estimated useful life in years following a formal engineering reassessment or condition assessment. Replaces original useful_life_years for prospective depreciation calculation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: useful_life_revision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset's estimated useful life was last revised, triggering a prospective change in depreciation calculation per GAAP ASC 250 change in accounting estimate. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the asset in years, as determined by engineering assessment and aligned with AWWA asset life guidelines and GASB/GAAP standards (e.g., 50 years for water mains, 20 years for pumps, 10 years for meters).

attributes.name: vibe_asset_domain_flag
attributes.description: Marks that this product is part of the built-out asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_mutation_flag
attributes.description: Flag added by VIBE mutator to ensure entity touched. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element linking the asset to its originating Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project for CAPEX tracking and project settlement. Ref: IBM Maximo.

products.name: acquisition
products.description: Records the acquisition of new assets into the utility's asset base, capturing acquisition type (purchase, construction, donation, transfer), acquisition date, purchase order reference, vendor/contractor, acquisition cost, funding source (CAPEX, grant, developer contribution), commissioning date, and initial condition grade. Triggers creation of the asset_registry record and depreciation_schedule. Integrates with SAP MM purchase orders and SAP FI asset capitalization.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset acquisition record. Primary key for the asset acquisition data product. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being acquired in the asset registry. Links this acquisition to the corresponding asset_registry record. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being acquired in the asset registry. Links this acquisition to the corresponding asset_registry record. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Capital Improvement Program project identifier if the asset was acquired as part of a capital project. Links to project management and budget tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Acquisitions are charged to departmental cost centers for capital budget tracking, CIP program management, and accountability. Supports budget-to-actual variance reporting for capital projects. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), pump station, or other facility where the asset is located. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Capital asset acquisitions post to specific GL accounts for capitalization, depreciation tracking, and GASB 34 infrastructure reporting. Critical for financial statement preparation and regulatory com. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor in the procurement or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was legally acquired or title transferred to the utility. Used for depreciation start date calculation and asset lifecycle tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the acquisition record in the workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion and asset registry creation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was acquired into the utility's asset base. Determines accounting treatment and capitalization rules. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset acquisition was formally approved by the designated authority. Part of the audit trail. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or authority who approved the asset acquisition. Required for audit trail and governance. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Detailed categorization within the asset class such as pump, valve, pipe, tank, or vehicle. Supports asset hierarchy and reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the asset type such as treatment equipment, distribution infrastructure, collection system, or vehicle. Used for depreciation schedule assignment. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount threshold for capitalizing an asset as defined by the utility's accounting policy. Typically ranges from $1,000 to $5,000 for water utilities. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the acquisition cost meets the utility's capitalization threshold for fixed asset recording. Determines if asset is capitalized or expensed. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was placed into service and became operational. Marks the start of depreciation for accounting purposes. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the construction contractor who built or installed the asset, applicable for construction acquisition type. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost of acquiring the asset including purchase price, installation, freight, and other capitalizable costs. Basis for depreciation calculation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset acquisition record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost. Typically USD for United States water utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate the asset over its useful life. Straight-line is most common for water utility infrastructure. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: SAP PM functional location code representing the hierarchical location of the asset within the utility's infrastructure. Supports Geographic Information System (GIS) integration. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funds used to finance the asset acquisition. Critical for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) tracking and regulatory rate case filings. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: grant_award_num
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant award that funded the acquisition, required for grant compliance reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: grant_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or local grant program that funded the acquisition, if applicable. Examples include EPA Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (WIFIA) or State Revolving Fund (SRF). Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: initial_condition_grade
attributes.description: Condition assessment grade assigned at the time of acquisition. Baseline for future condition monitoring and asset health tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset acquisition record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_num
attributes.description: IBM Maximo Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) asset number assigned at acquisition. External system identifier for cross-reference.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: Added by mutator to ensure change. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, conditions, or details about the asset acquisition. Supports audit trail and historical context. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: purchase_order_num
attributes.description: Purchase order number from SAP Materials Management (MM) or procurement system authorizing the asset acquisition. Links to procurement transaction. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculation for certain methods. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: sap_equipment_num
attributes.description: SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Plant Maintenance (PM) equipment number assigned at acquisition. External system identifier for cross-reference. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation. Varies by asset class per Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) guidelines. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_asset_domain_flag
attributes.description: Marks that this product is part of the built-out asset domain. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vibe_mutation_flag
attributes.description: Flag added by VIBE mutator to ensure entity touched. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_duration_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months. Calculated from warranty start and expiry dates for reporting purposes. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty period ends. Critical for maintenance planning and defect liability tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or contractor warranty period begins for the acquired asset. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: work_order_num
attributes.description: Work order number from IBM Maximo or SAP PM for construction or installation activities related to the acquisition.

products.name: disposal
products.description: Records the retirement, disposal, or decommissioning of assets from the utility's active inventory. Captures disposal date, disposal method (salvage, demolition, sale, transfer), disposal proceeds, reason for retirement (end of life, failure, regulatory, replacement), authorizing approver, and final book value at disposal. Triggers SAP FI-AA asset retirement posting and updates asset_registry operational status to Retired.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: disposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset disposal record. Primary key for the asset disposal transaction. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CIP project that triggered the asset replacement and disposal, if applicable. Links disposal to capital planning and renewal programs. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being disposed from the asset registry. Links to the physical infrastructure asset (pipe, pump, valve, equipment, vehicle) that is being retired or decommissioned. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_replacement_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new asset that replaced the disposed asset, if disposal reason was replacement. Links retired asset to its successor for lifecycle tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Asset disposals generate gain/loss transactions posted to specific GL accounts for financial reporting. Required for accurate net book value adjustments and GASB compliance in financial statements. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: primary_disposal_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset being disposed from the asset registry. Links to the physical infrastructure asset (pipe, pump, valve, equipment, vehicle) that is being retired or decommissioned. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or contractor who performed the disposal, demolition, or removal services. Links to vendor master data in SAP MM or procurement system. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense accumulated on the asset from installation date through disposal date. Used in calculating book value and gain/loss on disposal. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disposal transaction was formally approved by the authorizing approver. Required before disposal can proceed. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorizing approver who approved the asset disposal. Typically a senior manager, director, or capital planning committee member with authority over asset retirement decisions. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: book_value_at_disposal
attributes.description: The net book value (original acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the time of disposal. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal for financial reporting. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: buyer_contact_info
attributes.description: Contact information (phone, email, or address) for the buyer of the asset. Used for transfer documentation and warranty transfer. Confidential business contact data. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization that purchased the asset, if disposal method was sale or auction. Null for other disposal methods. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical disposal activity was completed. May differ from disposal effective date if removal or demolition took multiple days. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to dispose of the asset. Includes demolition costs, removal costs, environmental remediation, transportation, and disposal fees. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center responsible for the asset at the time of disposal. Used for departmental cost allocation and budget tracking. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disposal record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this disposal record. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was officially retired or disposed. This is the principal business event date that triggers SAP FI-AA asset retirement posting and updates the asset registry operational status to Retired. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the disposal transaction. Externally-known unique number used for tracking and audit purposes across SAP FI-AA and Maximo. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: disposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposal transaction. Tracks workflow from initiation through final completion and posting to financial systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|reversed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which environmental clearance was obtained, if required. Null if no clearance was required. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting environmental clearance process, remediation actions taken, or hazardous material handling procedures followed during disposal. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental clearance or remediation was required before disposal. True for assets containing hazardous materials, lead pipes, asbestos insulation, or contaminated equipment. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: gain_loss_on_disposal
attributes.description: The accounting gain or loss recognized on the disposal transaction, calculated as net disposal value minus book value at disposal. Positive values represent gains, negative values represent losses. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the employee or department that initiated the disposal request. Typically an asset manager, operations supervisor, or maintenance planner.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who last modified this disposal record. Audit trail for accountability. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this disposal record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The physical location or facility where the asset was disposed, demolished, or removed from. May be a treatment plant, pump station, or field location. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: maximo_disposal_code
attributes.description: The disposal transaction identifier in IBM Maximo CMMS. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail between Maximo and SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed. Indicates whether the asset was sold, scrapped, transferred to another entity, donated, demolished, or salvaged for parts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salvage|demolition|sale|donation|transfer|scrap|auction — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: Added by mutator to ensure change. Ref: IBM Maximo.

attributes.name: net_disposal_value
