attributes.name: test_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the validated and finalized analytical test result record. Primary key. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analytical_test_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent analytical test record from which this result was produced. Links to the in-process measurement and test execution context. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: calibration_curve_id
attributes.description: Reference to the instrument calibration curve used to quantify this result. Links result to the specific calibration standards and curve parameters in effect at the time of analysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst or laboratory supervisor who reviewed and approved this result for release. Must be a qualified individual with appropriate certification and training.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Test results must be attributed to projects for regulatory compliance reporting, cost recovery, and commissioning documentation. Water utilities track which analytical results support specific capital. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: contaminant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory parameter this result maps to (e.g., Total Coliform, Lead, Nitrate). Links result to compliance thresholds such as Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL), Maximum Contaminant Level Goal (MCLG), or National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) effluent limits. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory instrument used to perform the analysis (e.g., Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS), Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), spectrophotometer). Links result to instrument calibration and maintenance records. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_sample_id
attributes.description: Reference to the water or wastewater sample that was analyzed to produce this result. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: original_result_test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original test result record if this result is a reanalysis. Links reanalysis results back to the initial result for audit trail and comparison purposes. Null if this is the first analysis.

attributes.name: point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_point. Business justification: When test results exceed regulatory limits (lead action level, MCL violations), utilities must notify affected customers at specific service points. Customer notification letters, remediation tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality control batch in which this sample was analyzed. Links result to associated QC samples (blanks, duplicates, spikes, standards) run concurrently to validate analytical performance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory parameter this result maps to (e.g., Total Coliform, Lead, Nitrate). Links result to compliance thresholds such as Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL), Maximum Contaminant Level Goal (MCLG), or National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) effluent limits. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized analytical test method used (e.g., EPA Method 200.7, Standard Methods 2540 C). Defines the procedure, detection limits, and quality control requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this result was produced under laboratory accreditation (e.g., ISO/IEC 17025, state certification program). True indicates the result was produced by an accredited laboratory using an accredited method; False indicates non-accredited analysis.

attributes.name: analysis_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the analytical test was completed and the raw result was generated by the instrument or analyst. Distinct from approval_timestamp which represents the validation and release event. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the result was reviewed and approved by the approving analyst. Marks the point at which the result became the authoritative reported value available for compliance and operational use. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approved_result_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this result has been reviewed and approved by a qualified analyst or laboratory supervisor. True indicates the result has passed all quality control checks and is released for reporting; False indicates the result is pending review or has been rejected.

attributes.name: blank_contamination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the method blank analyzed in the same batch showed detectable contamination of the target analyte. True indicates blank contamination was detected, which may affect result interpretation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the result meets applicable regulatory thresholds. Values: compliant (result within acceptable limits), non-compliant (result exceeds Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL) or violates National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) limit), exceedance (result exceeds action level but not MCL), not_applicable (no regulatory threshold for this parameter), pending_review (compliance determination not yet made). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the result data. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: detection_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the analyte was detected in the sample. Values: detected (analyte present above Method Detection Limit), non-detect (analyte not detected or below MDL), trace (analyte detected but below quantitation limit), below_mdl (result below Method Detection Limit), above_mdl (result above Method Detection Limit and quantifiable). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The factor by which the sample was diluted prior to analysis. A value of 1.0 indicates no dilution. Values greater than 1.0 indicate the sample was diluted to bring analyte concentration within the calibration range or to reduce matrix interference. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: duplicate_relative_percent_difference
attributes.description: Relative percent difference between the sample result and its duplicate, calculated as (|Sample - Duplicate| / Average) × 100. Indicates the precision of the analytical method. Acceptable ranges are method-specific (typically <20%). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: holding_time_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sample was analyzed within the method-specified holding time (time between sample collection and analysis). True indicates compliance; False indicates holding time was exceeded, which may affect result validity. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lims_result_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Result ID
attributes.description: The unique result identifier from the source Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), such as LabWare. Enables traceability back to the originating system and supports data reconciliation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Result ID

attributes.name: matrix_spike_recovery_percent
attributes.description: Percent recovery of the analyte from the matrix spike sample analyzed in the same batch. Indicates the accuracy of the method in the presence of the sample matrix. Acceptable ranges are method-specific (typically 75-125%). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: method_detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum concentration of an analyte that can be measured and reported with 99% confidence that the value is greater than zero. Specific to the test method and laboratory instrumentation used. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result record was last modified. Tracks any updates to the result data after initial creation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: mvm_tier
attributes.description: The mvm tier value recorded for each test result in the laboratory domain.

attributes.name: proficiency_test_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this result is from a proficiency testing (PT) sample used to evaluate laboratory performance. True indicates this is a PT result; False indicates a routine sample result. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reanalysis_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this result is from a reanalysis of the sample. True indicates the sample was reanalyzed due to quality control failure, holding time exceedance, or other issue with the initial analysis; False indicates this is the first analysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: regulatory_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the regulatory threshold value. Must be compatible with the reporting_unit to enable valid comparison. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg/L|ug/L|NTU|CFU/100mL|MPN/100mL|pH units|percent|ppm|ppb|SU — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_threshold_value
attributes.description: The applicable regulatory limit against which this result is compared (e.g., Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL), Maximum Contaminant Level Goal (MCLG), National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) effluent limit). Captured at the time of result approval to preserve the threshold in effect. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reporting_limit
attributes.description: The minimum concentration at which the laboratory can quantitatively report a result with confidence. Typically set at 2-10 times the Method Detection Limit (MDL). Also known as Practical Quantitation Limit (PQL) or Limit of Quantitation (LOQ). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reporting_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the result was officially reported to the client or regulatory agency. Distinct from approval_timestamp which is internal laboratory validation; this marks external release. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reporting_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the result value is reported. Common units include milligrams per liter (mg/L), micrograms per liter (ug/L), Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU), Colony Forming Units per 100 milliliters (CFU/100mL), Most Probable Number per 100 milliliters (MPN/100mL), pH units, percent, parts per million (ppm), parts per billion (ppb), Standard Units (SU). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg/L|ug/L|NTU|CFU/100mL|MPN/100mL|pH units|percent|ppm|ppb|SU — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment field for analyst notes, observations, or explanations regarding the result. May include information about matrix interference, unusual sample characteristics, deviations from standard procedure, or other contextual information. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_qualifier
attributes.description: Data qualifier code providing additional context about the result (e.g., J=estimated value, U=undetected, E=exceeds calibration range, B=blank contamination, H=holding time exceeded, Q=quality control failure). Follows EPA and laboratory-specific qualifier conventions. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the result record. Values: final (result approved and released), preliminary (result generated but not yet approved), rejected (result failed quality control and is not valid), under_review (result pending analyst review), cancelled (result voided due to sample or procedural issue). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_value
attributes.description: The validated and finalized numeric result value reported from the analytical test. This is the authoritative measurement released for compliance and operational use. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: uncertainty_estimate
attributes.description: Quantitative estimate of the uncertainty associated with the reported result, expressed in the same units as the result. Represents the range within which the true value is expected to lie with a specified confidence level (typically 95%). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each test result in the laboratory domain.

products.name: sampling_plan
products.description: Master record defining a scheduled or regulatory-driven sampling program. Specifies the sampling frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly), required analytes, sampling locations, applicable regulation or permit (SDWA, NPDES, LCRR, state primacy), sample type requirements, required test methods, and responsible party. Drives the generation of sample_collection_event records and ensures regulatory sampling schedules are met. Covers CCR monitoring, DBP (THM/HAA5) monitoring, PFAS sampling, LCRR tap sampling, and NPDES effluent monitoring.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sampling_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sampling plan. Primary key. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Sampling plans are regulatory compliance documents requiring documented authorship. EPA and state regulations mandate traceable plan development by qualified employees for permit compliance and audit. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.service_territory. Business justification: Sampling plans are designed for specific service territories to meet regulatory monitoring requirements (distribution system monitoring, source water monitoring). Each territory has unique permit cond. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: treatment_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.treatment_permit. Business justification: Sampling plans implement permit monitoring requirements (NPDES discharge limits, drinking water MCLs, withdrawal permits). Every compliance sampling plan is driven by a specific permit's monitoring sc. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who approved this sampling plan. Used for audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation. Nullable for draft plans. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sampling plan was formally approved for use by authorized personnel (e.g., laboratory manager, quality assurance officer, regulatory compliance manager). Nullable for draft plans. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_analyst_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether samples under this plan must be analyzed by a state-certified or EPA-certified analyst. True for regulatory compliance samples; false for operational monitoring. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal chain of custody documentation is required for samples collected under this plan. True for regulatory, legal, or enforcement-related samples; false for routine operational monitoring. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory standard or internal guideline defining acceptable limits for analytes in this sampling plan (e.g., MCL, MCLG, NPDES permit limits, internal action levels). Detailed thresholds are managed in the quality domain. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of sample container required for collection (e.g., sterile plastic bottle, amber glass bottle, pre-preserved vial). Ensures compatibility with analyte and test method requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sampling plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sampling plan is scheduled to end or be replaced. Nullable for ongoing plans without a defined end date. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sampling plan becomes active and sample collection events should begin. Aligns with regulatory compliance periods or operational schedules. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: holding_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum allowable time (in hours) between sample collection and analysis to ensure sample integrity and regulatory compliance. Varies by analyte and test method. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: last_sample_collected_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sample collection event completed under this plan. Used for compliance verification and schedule adherence tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lims_integration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Integration Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sampling plan is integrated with the LabWare LIMS system for automated sample tracking, result entry, and reporting. True for plans with LIMS integration; false for manual tracking.

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Integration Flag

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this sampling plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sampling plan record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_sample_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled sample collection event under this plan. Updated dynamically as sample collection events are completed. Used for operational scheduling and compliance tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or operational notes related to this sampling plan (e.g., seasonal adjustments, site access requirements, coordination with other departments). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the sampling plan, used in LIMS and regulatory reporting systems. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the sampling plan describing its purpose and scope. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sampling plan based on its purpose: regulatory (compliance-driven), operational (routine monitoring), investigational (troubleshooting), proficiency (QA/QC), emergency (incident response), or special (one-time study). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: preservation_method
attributes.description: Required sample preservation technique to maintain analyte stability during transport and storage (e.g., refrigeration at 4°C, acidification with HNO3, addition of sodium thiosulfate for dechlorination). Nullable if no preservation is required. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory performing analyses under this plan must participate in proficiency testing programs (e.g., EPA Water Pollution Performance Evaluation Studies, state PT programs). True for regulatory compliance samples. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qaqc_protocol
attributes.description: Reference to the QA/QC protocol or standard operating procedure governing quality control measures for this sampling plan (e.g., blank samples, duplicate samples, spike recovery, proficiency testing frequency). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework or permit requirement driving this sampling plan: SDWA (Safe Drinking Water Act), NPDES (National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System), LCRR (Lead and Copper Rule Revisions), state primacy agency requirements, local ordinance, or none for operational plans.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which results from this sampling plan must be reported to regulatory agencies or internal stakeholders: monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, or as-needed (event-driven). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reporting_requirement
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or internal reporting obligation that this sampling plan supports: CCR (Consumer Confidence Report), DMR (Discharge Monitoring Report), MOR (Monthly Operating Report), state-specific report, internal management report, or none. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, team, or organizational unit responsible for executing this sampling plan (e.g., Water Quality Team, Field Operations, Contract Laboratory). May reference employee or organizational unit records. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Brief description of the reason for the most recent revision to this sampling plan (e.g., regulatory change, permit update, operational improvement, corrective action). Supports change control and audit trail. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Type of sample collection method required: grab (single point-in-time), composite (time- or flow-weighted), continuous (automated real-time), field (on-site analysis), or split (duplicate for QA/QC or third-party verification). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: sample_volume_ml
attributes.description: Minimum required sample volume in milliliters to perform all specified analyses. Ensures sufficient sample quantity for laboratory testing and QA/QC replicates. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

products.name: qc_batch
products.description: Quality control batch record grouping a set of analytical tests processed together under the same QC conditions. Defines the batch type (preparation batch, analytical batch), associated test method, batch size, batch preparation datetime, analyst, and the QC samples included (method blank, laboratory control sample, matrix spike, matrix spike duplicate, surrogate). Tracks overall batch acceptance status based on QC acceptance criteria and is the primary unit for QC review and data validation in the laboratory. Batch failure triggers corrective action and may require re-analysis of all associated samples.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: qc_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality control batch record. Primary key. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified laboratory analyst who performed the analytical work for this batch. Ensures traceability and accountability for test results. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: QC batch costs (reference standards, control samples, analyst time) represent laboratory overhead that must be allocated to a cost center for overhead rate calculation and indirect cost distribution.. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical instrument used for this batch. Links to instrument calibration records and maintenance history. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory supervisor or QA officer who reviewed and approved the batch QC results. Ensures accountability for data validation decisions.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory supervisor or QA officer who reviewed and approved the batch QC results. Ensures accountability for data validation decisions.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical test method applied to all samples in this QC batch. Ensures all samples are processed under the same standardized procedure. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: batch_completion_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when all analytical work for the batch was completed and results were recorded. Used to calculate batch processing time and ensure timely reporting. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique batch identifier assigned by the laboratory information management system (LIMS). Used for tracking and referencing in laboratory documentation and chain of custody records. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: batch_preparation_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the batch preparation or analytical run was initiated. Critical for hold time compliance and method-specific timing requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: batch_review_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC batch was reviewed and acceptance status was assigned by the laboratory supervisor or quality assurance officer.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Total number of samples (including field samples and QC samples) processed together in this batch. Used to verify batch integrity and compliance with method-specific batch size limits. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the QC batch based on the laboratory process stage. Preparation batch groups samples undergoing initial preparation; analytical batch groups samples analyzed together under identical conditions; extraction/digestion batches are specific to sample matrix processing. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether QC failures or deviations in this batch require formal corrective action per laboratory quality management system. Triggers corrective action workflow. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this QC batch record was first created in the data system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: duplicate_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for the duplicate sample based on RPD limits. Fail status may indicate sample heterogeneity or analytical imprecision. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: duplicate_relative_percent_difference
attributes.description: Calculated RPD between original and duplicate field samples. Measures precision of the entire analytical process including sample heterogeneity. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: duplicate_sample_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a duplicate field sample was analyzed in this batch. Duplicates assess overall analytical precision for unspiked samples. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: field_sample_count
attributes.description: Number of actual field samples (non-QC samples) included in this batch. Excludes method blanks, laboratory control samples, and other QC samples. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lcs_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for the LCS based on percent recovery limits. Fail status indicates systematic bias and may require corrective action or batch reanalysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lcs_expected_value
attributes.description: Known or true concentration of the analyte in the laboratory control sample. Used to calculate percent recovery. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lcs_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a laboratory control sample was included in this batch. LCS is a known-concentration standard used to verify method accuracy and instrument performance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lcs_measured_value
attributes.description: Analytical result obtained for the laboratory control sample. Compared against expected value to calculate percent recovery. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lcs_percent_recovery
attributes.description: Calculated percent recovery for the LCS: (measured_value / expected_value) * 100. Must fall within method-specific acceptance limits (typically 80-120%) to validate batch accuracy. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lims_batch_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Batch Identifier
attributes.description: External batch identifier from the laboratory information management system (LabWare or similar). Used for integration and cross-system traceability. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Batch Identifier

attributes.name: matrix_spike_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for the matrix spike based on percent recovery limits. Fail status may indicate matrix interference requiring method modification or result qualification. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: matrix_spike_duplicate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a matrix spike duplicate was included in this batch. MSD is a second spiked aliquot of the same sample used to assess analytical precision through relative percent difference (RPD) calculation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: matrix_spike_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a matrix spike sample was included in this batch. Matrix spike is a field sample spiked with known analyte concentration to assess matrix interference and method accuracy in real sample matrices. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: matrix_spike_percent_recovery
attributes.description: Calculated percent recovery for the matrix spike. Evaluates the effect of sample matrix on analytical accuracy. Acceptance limits are method-specific. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: method_blank_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for the method blank based on method-specific criteria. Fail status indicates contamination and may require batch reanalysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: method_blank_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a method blank (reagent blank) was included in this batch. Method blanks are required to detect contamination from reagents, glassware, or the analytical process. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: method_blank_result
attributes.description: Analytical result for the method blank. Should be below the method detection limit (MDL) to confirm no contamination. Elevated blank results may invalidate the entire batch. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this QC batch record was last modified. Tracks data changes for audit and quality assurance purposes. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: msd_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for the MSD based on RPD limits. Fail status indicates poor precision and may require investigation or reanalysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: msd_percent_recovery
attributes.description: Calculated percent recovery for the matrix spike duplicate. Used in conjunction with MS recovery to calculate relative percent difference. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: msd_relative_percent_difference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Matrix Spike Duplicate (MSD) Relative Percent Difference (RPD)
attributes.description: Calculated RPD between matrix spike and matrix spike duplicate: |MS - MSD| / ((MS + MSD) / 2) * 100. Measures analytical precision; must meet method-specific limits (typically <20%). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Matrix Spike Duplicate (MSD) Relative Percent Difference (RPD)

attributes.name: mvm_tier
attributes.description: The mvm tier value recorded for each qc batch in the laboratory domain.

attributes.name: overall_batch_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Final QC acceptance status for the entire batch based on all QC sample results. Accepted batches have all QC criteria met; rejected batches require reanalysis; conditional batches may have qualified results. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting QC issues, corrective actions taken, deviations from standard procedures, or explanations for conditional acceptance. Critical for audit trail and regulatory compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: surrogate_acceptance_status
attributes.description: QC acceptance status for surrogate standards based on recovery limits. Fail status may indicate sample preparation problems or matrix interference. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: surrogate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrogate standards were added to all samples in this batch. Surrogates are analyte-like compounds added before sample processing to monitor extraction and analytical efficiency. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: surrogate_percent_recovery
attributes.description: Average percent recovery for surrogate standards across the batch. Used to assess sample preparation and extraction efficiency. Method-specific acceptance limits apply. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each qc batch in the laboratory domain.

products.name: qc_sample
products.description: Record for each quality control sample included in a QC batch. Captures QC sample type (method blank, laboratory control sample LCS, matrix spike MS, matrix spike duplicate MSD, field duplicate, field blank, surrogate spike, certified reference material CRM), expected concentration, measured concentration, percent recovery, relative percent difference RPD, acceptance limits, and pass/fail status. Provides the QA/QC evidence trail required for data validation and laboratory accreditation.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: qc_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality control sample record. Primary key. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analyte_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific analyte or parameter being measured in this QC sample (e.g., lead, chlorine, pH, Total Organic Carbon (TOC), Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory instrument used for this QC sample analysis. Links to instrument calibration and maintenance records. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_sample_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated environmental or production sample when applicable (e.g., for matrix spike or field duplicate QC types). Null for method blanks and laboratory control samples. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: primary_qc_certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified laboratory analyst who performed the QC sample analysis. Required for chain of custody and accreditation compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the QC batch that contains this QC sample. Links to the parent batch for traceability. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical test method applied to this QC sample. Links to the standard operating procedure and method specifications. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the accreditation body or state certification program under which this QC sample was analyzed (e.g., state drinking water laboratory certification program, NELAP, A2LA). Required for regulatory reporting and audit trail. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date the QC sample was analyzed in the laboratory. Used to verify compliance with method-specific holding time requirements and to track batch chronology. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analysis_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the QC sample analysis was completed. Provides detailed audit trail for Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) integration and regulatory reporting. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the expected and measured concentration values. Common units include milligrams per liter (mg/L), micrograms per liter (ug/L), nanograms per liter (ng/L), parts per million (ppm), parts per billion (ppb), parts per trillion (ppt), Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU), Colony Forming Units per 100 milliliters (CFU/100mL), Most Probable Number per 100 milliliters (MPN/100mL), pH units, percent, and Standard Units (SU). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg/L|ug/L|ng/L|ppm|ppb|ppt|NTU|CFU/100mL|MPN/100mL|pH_units|percent|SU — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective action is required based on QC sample failure. True if the QC failure necessitates re-analysis, method adjustment, or other corrective measures; false otherwise. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective action taken in response to QC sample failure. May include re-analysis, instrument recalibration, method modification, or sample re-collection. Required for laboratory accreditation and audit trail. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this QC sample record was first created in the data warehouse. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: Method Detection Limit (MDL) for the analyte and test method at the time of analysis. Represents the minimum concentration that can be measured and reported with 99% confidence that the analyte is greater than zero. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: Dilution factor applied to the QC sample during preparation or analysis. A value of 1.0 indicates no dilution; values greater than 1.0 indicate the sample was diluted. Used to back-calculate original concentrations. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: expected_concentration
attributes.description: The known or target concentration value for the QC sample. For LCS and CRM, this is the certified value; for matrix spikes, this is the spiked amount plus the native sample concentration; for blanks, this is typically zero. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lims_sample_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample Number
attributes.description: Unique sample identifier assigned by the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), such as LabWare. Used for integration and cross-referencing between the data warehouse and the operational LIMS system. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample Number

attributes.name: lower_acceptance_limit
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable range for percent recovery or Relative Percent Difference (RPD). Defined by the analytical method, laboratory Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), or regulatory requirement. QC samples below this limit fail acceptance criteria. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: measured_concentration
attributes.description: The actual concentration value obtained from laboratory analysis of the QC sample. Used to calculate recovery and evaluate method performance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this QC sample record was last modified in the data warehouse. Tracks data lineage and supports audit trail requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: mvm_tier
attributes.description: The mvm tier value recorded for each qc sample in the laboratory domain.

attributes.name: native_concentration
attributes.description: Original concentration of the analyte in the sample before spiking, applicable to matrix spike and matrix spike duplicate QC types. Used in recovery calculations: recovery = (measured - native) / spike * 100. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: percent_recovery
attributes.description: Calculated percent recovery of the QC sample, computed as (measured_concentration / expected_concentration) * 100. Indicates the accuracy of the analytical method. Typically evaluated against acceptance limits defined in the method or laboratory QA plan. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: proficiency_test_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this QC sample is part of an external proficiency testing program (e.g., EPA Water Pollution Performance Evaluation Studies, AWWA proficiency testing). True if part of proficiency testing; false for routine internal QC.

attributes.name: proficiency_test_provider
attributes.description: Name of the external proficiency testing provider if this QC sample is part of a proficiency test (e.g., EPA, AWWA, Environmental Resource Associates). Null for routine internal QC samples.

attributes.name: qc_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments from the analyst or quality assurance officer regarding the QC sample. May include notes on anomalies, corrective actions taken, reasons for failure, or special handling procedures. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_sample_type
attributes.description: Type of quality control sample. Method blank verifies absence of contamination; Laboratory Control Sample (LCS) verifies method accuracy; Matrix Spike (MS) and Matrix Spike Duplicate (MSD) verify matrix interference and precision; field duplicate and field blank verify field collection procedures; surrogate spike verifies extraction efficiency; Certified Reference Material (CRM) verifies instrument calibration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: method_blank|laboratory_control_sample|matrix_spike|matrix_spike_duplicate|field_duplicate|field_blank|surrogate_spike|certified_reference_material — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_status
attributes.description: Pass/fail status of the QC sample based on comparison of percent recovery or Relative Percent Difference (RPD) against acceptance limits. Pass indicates the QC sample met all acceptance criteria; fail indicates one or more criteria were not met; warning indicates results are marginal; pending_review indicates awaiting quality assurance officer review; not_applicable for QC types without numeric acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: relative_percent_difference
attributes.description: Relative Percent Difference between duplicate QC samples (e.g., matrix spike and matrix spike duplicate, or field duplicates). Calculated as absolute difference divided by the mean, multiplied by 100. Measures precision and reproducibility of the analytical method. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reporting_limit
attributes.description: Reporting Limit (RL) or Practical Quantitation Limit (PQL) for the analyte and test method. The minimum concentration that can be reliably quantified and reported to regulatory agencies. Typically 3-5 times the Method Detection Limit (MDL). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date the QC sample results were reviewed and validated by the quality assurance officer. Part of the data validation and approval workflow. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: spike_concentration
attributes.description: Concentration of analyte added to the sample for matrix spike, matrix spike duplicate, or surrogate spike QC types. Null for other QC types. Used to calculate percent recovery in the presence of sample matrix. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: upper_acceptance_limit
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable range for percent recovery or Relative Percent Difference (RPD). Defined by the analytical method, laboratory Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), or regulatory requirement. QC samples above this limit fail acceptance criteria. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each qc sample in the laboratory domain.

products.name: certified_analyst
products.description: Master record for each laboratory analyst holding certifications relevant to water and wastewater analytical work. Captures analyst name, employee reference, certification type (state drinking water analyst certification, wastewater operator certification, NELAC signatory authority), certifying body, certification number, issue date, expiration date, renewal status, and approved test methods the analyst is qualified to perform. Distinct from the workforce domain employee record; this entity owns the laboratory-specific certification and method authorization data.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the certified laboratory analyst record. Primary key for the certified analyst entity. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee ID of the analysts direct supervisor or laboratory manager. Used for organizational hierarchy and approval workflows.

attributes.name: primary_certified_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record in the workforce domain. Links the laboratory certification record to the underlying employee master data. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analyst_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the certified laboratory analyst. Used for identification on laboratory reports and chain of custody documentation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analyst_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the certified laboratory analyst. Used for identification on laboratory reports and chain of custody documentation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analyst_middle_initial
attributes.description: Middle initial of the certified laboratory analyst. Optional field for complete name identification. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check or security clearance verification. Required for analysts working with sensitive data or in facilities subject to security regulations. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or grade of the certification indicating the complexity of analytical work the analyst is authorized to perform. Higher levels typically authorize more complex testing methods and supervisory responsibilities.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification number or license number issued by the certifying body. This is the official credential identifier that must be referenced on laboratory reports and regulatory submissions. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Active certifications authorize the analyst to perform regulated work; expired, suspended, or revoked certifications prohibit such work until reinstated. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of laboratory certification held by the analyst. Categories include state drinking water analyst certification, wastewater operator certification, NELAC (National Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Conference) signatory authority, laboratory director certification, quality assurance officer certification, or specialty method certification. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certifying_body

attributes.name: continuing_education_hours
attributes.description: Total number of continuing education hours or professional development units earned by the analyst in the current certification period. Required for certification renewal. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certified analyst record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the analyst. Used for official communications, training notifications, and certification renewal reminders. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and must be renewed. Critical for compliance tracking to ensure only currently certified analysts perform regulated analytical work. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: instrument_qualifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of laboratory instruments the analyst is trained and qualified to operate. attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: issue_date

attributes.name: laboratory_assignment
attributes.description: Name or code of the laboratory facility or work center where the analyst is primarily assigned. Examples include Central Laboratory, WTP (Water Treatment Plant) Lab, WWTP (Wastewater Treatment Plant) Lab, or Field Testing Unit. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certified analyst record was most recently updated. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: last_proficiency_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent proficiency testing event completed by the analyst. Used to track compliance with annual or semi-annual PT requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lims_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) User ID
attributes.description: User identifier for the analyst in the Laboratory Information Management System (LabWare or similar). Links the certification record to the analysts login and activity in the LIMS for audit trail and data integrity purposes. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) User ID

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the analysts certification or qualifications. May include restrictions, accommodations, or historical context. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: proficiency_testing_status
attributes.description: Status of the analysts participation in proficiency testing programs. Proficiency testing is required for NELAC accreditation and demonstrates the analysts ability to produce accurate results. Current status indicates successful completion of required PT samples. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: quality_control_role
attributes.description: Role of the analyst in the laboratorys quality assurance and quality control program. Roles include bench analyst, data reviewer, QA officer, or technical director with oversight responsibilities. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: record_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this certified analyst record originated. Examples include LIMS (LabWare), SAP HR, or manual certification tracking system. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was most recently renewed. Tracks the analysts compliance with continuing education and renewal requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: safety_training_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory safety training completion. Required annually for OSHA compliance and includes topics such as chemical hygiene, hazardous waste handling, and emergency response.

attributes.name: shift_assignment
attributes.description: Work shift to which the analyst is assigned. Relevant for 24/7 laboratory operations and emergency response coverage. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: signatory_authority
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the analyst has signatory authority to approve and sign laboratory reports for regulatory submission. Signatory authority is typically restricted to senior analysts or laboratory directors who meet specific qualification criteria. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: specialty_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical specialty areas or matrices the analyst is qualified to work with. Examples include drinking water microbiology, wastewater metals, organic compounds, radiochemistry, or specific contaminant groups such as PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances) or DBPs (Disinfection Byproducts). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag

products.name: lab_accreditation
products.description: Master record for the laboratorys accreditation and certification status with regulatory and accrediting bodies. Captures accrediting organization (state primacy agency, NELAC/TNI, A2LA, DoD ELAP), accreditation scope (list of accredited analytes and matrices), certificate number, accreditation status, initial accreditation date, current certificate expiry, last on-site assessment date, next assessment due date, and any conditions or deficiencies noted. Critical for demonstrating regulatory defensibility of analytical data.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_id

attributes.name: laboratory_id
