No existing FK from laboratory to lab_accre. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the accrediting body for this accreditation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_cost_usd
attributes.description: The total cost in US dollars for obtaining and maintaining this accreditation, including application fees, assessment fees, and proficiency testing costs. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the accreditation certificate and scope document. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the accreditation scope, including the list of accredited analytes, matrices, and test methods covered under this accreditation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accreditation (active, suspended, revoked, expired, pending, provisional). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: The type or program of accreditation granted (e.g., state primacy, NELAC/TNI, A2LA, DoD ELAP, ISO 17025).

attributes.name: conditions_or_deficiencies_noted
attributes.description: Any conditions, limitations, or deficiencies noted by the accrediting body during the last assessment. May include corrective action requirements. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which corrective actions must be completed and submitted to the accrediting body. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required to maintain or restore accreditation status. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was first created in the system. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: initial_accreditation_date
attributes.description: The date when the laboratory first received this accreditation from the accrediting body. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accreditation record was last updated in the system. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next on-site or surveillance assessment by the accrediting body. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each lab accreditation in the laboratory domain.

products.name: proficiency_test
products.description: Record of each proficiency testing (PT) study participation event required to maintain laboratory accreditation. Captures the PT provider (ERA, NERL, LGC), study name and round, analyte(s) tested, sample matrix, assigned value (true concentration), reported value, z-score or performance score, pass/fail determination, and submission deadline. Tracks the laboratorys ongoing demonstration of analytical competency as required by NELAC/TNI and state primacy agencies.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: proficiency_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proficiency testing study participation event. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analyte_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analyte or parameter tested (e.g., lead, pH, total coliform). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_analyst_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst who performed the proficiency test analysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lab_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory instrument used for the proficiency test analysis. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory that participated in this proficiency test. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: primary_proficiency_lab_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique sample identifier assigned by the proficiency test provider. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: proficiency_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance officer or supervisor who reviewed the proficiency test results.

attributes.name: proficiency_reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance officer or supervisor who reviewed the proficiency test results.

attributes.name: pt_provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the proficiency testing provider organization (ERA, NERL, LGC, etc.). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Reference to the analytical test method used for this proficiency test. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the proficiency testing provider organization (ERA, NERL, LGC, etc.). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Acceptance limits or criteria defined by the proficiency test provider (e.g., z-score ±2.0, recovery 80-120%). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_field
attributes.description: Field of accreditation or testing category this proficiency test supports (e.g., Drinking Water Chemistry, Microbiology). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: accreditation_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of this proficiency test result on laboratory accreditation status. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test sample was analyzed by the laboratory. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: assigned_value
attributes.description: True or reference concentration value assigned by the proficiency test provider. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes regarding the proficiency test participation, analysis, or results. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required due to proficiency test failure or unacceptable performance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proficiency test record was first created in the system. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this proficiency test record was last modified. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Number of laboratories that participated in this proficiency test round. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: peer_group_mean
attributes.description: Mean value reported by all participating laboratories in the peer group. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: peer_group_standard_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation of values reported by all participating laboratories in the peer group. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: percentile_rank
attributes.description: Percentile ranking of the laboratorys performance relative to all participants (0-100). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Alternative performance metric used by some proficiency test providers (e.g., percent recovery, bias). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: pt_round
attributes.description: Round or cycle identifier for the proficiency test (e.g., 2024-Q1, Round 45). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: pt_study_name
attributes.description: Name of the proficiency testing study or program (e.g., WP-123, DMR-QA). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: report_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the laboratory received the final proficiency test report from the provider. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reported_value
attributes.description: Concentration value reported by the laboratory for the proficiency test sample. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Pass/fail determination or acceptability status of the proficiency test result. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test results were reviewed and approved by quality assurance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: Type of sample matrix tested in the proficiency test. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drinking_water|wastewater|surface_water|groundwater|soil|sediment|sludge|biosolids|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: sample_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the proficiency test sample was received by the laboratory. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Actual date the laboratory submitted results to the proficiency test provider. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline date by which the laboratory must submit results to the proficiency test provider. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the assigned and reported values (e.g., mg/L, ug/L, NTU, pH units). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each proficiency test in the laboratory domain.

attributes.name: z_score
attributes.description: Statistical z-score calculated from the reported value, assigned value, and standard deviation, indicating performance relative to peer laboratories. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

products.name: result_validation
products.description: Record of the formal data validation review applied to a set of test results before release. Captures the validation level (level I through IV per EPA validation protocols), validator identity, validation datetime, validation criteria applied, findings (qualifiers applied, results rejected, flags raised), and final validation disposition (accepted, qualified, rejected). Ensures that all data released for regulatory reporting meets defensibility standards under SDWA, CWA, and NPDES requirements.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: result_validation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the result validation record. Primary key. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: analytical_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.analytical_result. Business justification: Laboratory's result_validation process validates quality domain's analytical_result records. Data validation workflow (Level II/III review) requires linking validation findings to final reported resul. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: primary_result_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst or data validator who performed the validation review. Must be a qualified individual per laboratory QA/QC protocols. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: result_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified analyst or data validator who performed the validation review. Must be a qualified individual per laboratory QA/QC protocols. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to a secondary reviewer or quality assurance officer who performed independent review of the validation. Used in laboratories with multi-tier validation protocols. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reviewer_id
attributes.description: Reference to a secondary reviewer or quality assurance officer who performed independent review of the validation. Used in laboratories with multi-tier validation protocols. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the test result record being validated. Links to the laboratory test result that underwent this validation review. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the validation batch if multiple results were validated together. Enables grouping of validation activities performed in a single review session. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this validation requires formal approval by a laboratory director or quality assurance manager before data release. True if approval is required, False if validator authority is sufficient. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation was formally approved for data release. Applicable when approval_required_flag is True. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: calibration_verification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether instrument calibration was current and verified at the time of analysis. True if calibration was valid, False if calibration issues were identified. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chain of custody documentation was complete and verified during validation. True if COC is intact and verified, False if discrepancies were found. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: data_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validated result was released for regulatory reporting, customer delivery, or internal use. Marks the completion of the validation and approval workflow. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: flags_raised_count
attributes.description: Number of quality flags or warnings raised during validation. Flags may indicate potential issues that do not necessarily result in rejection but require documentation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: holding_time_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample holding time requirements were met per EPA method specifications. True if compliant, False if holding time was exceeded. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: method_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the analytical method was performed in full compliance with the approved EPA or Standard Method protocol. True if compliant, False if deviations occurred. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this validation record. Audit trail field for tracking changes and maintaining data integrity. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes to validation decisions or documentation. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: qc_acceptance_criteria_met_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Control (QC) Acceptance Criteria Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all quality control acceptance criteria (blanks, duplicates, spikes, surrogates, calibration verification) were met for this result. True if all QC passed, False if any QC failure occurred. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

tag_set.value: Quality Control (QC) Acceptance Criteria Met Flag

attributes.name: qualifiers_applied
attributes.description: Data qualifiers or flags assigned to the result during validation. Common qualifiers include J (estimated value), U (non-detect), R (rejected), Q (quality control issue). Multiple qualifiers may be comma-separated. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: regulatory_defensibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the validated result meets the full defensibility standard required for regulatory reporting and potential legal proceedings. True if defensible, False if data quality issues compromise defensibility. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: The regulatory program or compliance framework under which this validation was performed. Examples: SDWA compliance monitoring, NPDES permit monitoring, CWA industrial pretreatment, state-specific programs. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: results_rejected_count
attributes.description: Number of individual test results rejected during this validation review. Used for quality metrics and laboratory performance tracking. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the secondary review was completed. Applicable when laboratory protocols require independent QA review of validation decisions. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_criteria_applied
attributes.description: Description of the specific validation criteria, checklists, or protocols applied during the review. May reference EPA method requirements, laboratory SOP numbers, or regulatory program-specific validation rules. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_disposition
attributes.description: Final outcome of the validation review. Accepted: result meets all quality criteria and is released without qualification. Qualified: result is usable but carries data qualifiers or flags. Rejected: result fails validation and cannot be used for regulatory reporting. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent performing the validation review. Used for laboratory productivity metrics and resource planning. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_findings
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of validation findings, issues identified, corrective actions taken, and rationale for the final disposition. Critical for regulatory audit trail and data defensibility. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_level
attributes.description: The EPA validation protocol level applied to this result. Level I: basic data verification; Level II: analytical QC review; Level III: method and holding time compliance; Level IV: full data package audit for regulatory defensibility. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations recorded by the validator during the review process. May include references to supporting documentation, communications with analysts, or special circumstances. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the validation process. Tracks whether the validation review is pending, in progress, completed, or on hold pending additional information. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation review was completed. Critical for establishing data release timeline and regulatory reporting deadlines. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validator_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the validator. Required for regulatory defensibility under SDWA and CWA compliance programs. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: validator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the validator who performed the review. Provides human-readable identification for audit trail and regulatory reporting. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: The vibe added flag value recorded for each result validation in the laboratory domain.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this validation record. Audit trail field for accountability and data governance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

products.name: reagent_standard
products.description: Master inventory record for laboratory reagents, chemical standards, and reference materials used in analytical testing. Captures reagent name, CAS number, supplier, lot number, concentration or purity, preparation date, expiry date, storage conditions, current stock quantity, reorder threshold, and associated test methods. Tracks the traceability of standards used in calibration and QC to ensure analytical data defensibility. Distinct from the supply domain which manages procurement; this entity owns the in-lab inventory and traceability record.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: LabWare LIMS; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: reagent_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory reagent or chemical standard record. Primary key for the reagent standard master inventory. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: QC/QA protocols require documented employee accountability for reagent preparation. Accreditation standards (TNI, NELAC) mandate traceable preparation records linking to qualified employees for method. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Reagents and certified reference materials are procured from chemical suppliers. Tracking vendor is essential for COA verification, lot traceability, reordering, and quality control. Replaces denormal. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: associated_test_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of analytical test method codes or names for which this reagent or standard is used. Supports traceability of reagents to specific analytical procedures and regulatory compliance demonstrations. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature. Used for unambiguous identification of reagents and standards. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: catalog_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier catalog number for the reagent or standard. Used for reordering and traceability to supplier specifications. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of analysis or certificate of conformance number provided by the manufacturer or certifying body. Documents the certified properties and traceability of the standard. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: certified_reference_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this standard is a certified reference material with traceability to national or international measurement standards. True if CRM, false otherwise. CRMs are required for certain regulatory compliance testing. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the concentration or purity value: milligrams per liter (mg/L), micrograms per liter (ug/L), percent (%), parts per million (ppm), parts per billion (ppb), molarity (M), or normality (N). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mg_l|ug_l|percent|ppm|ppb|molarity|normality — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: concentration_value
attributes.description: Numeric concentration or purity of the reagent or standard as certified by the manufacturer or as prepared in the laboratory. Used in calibration calculations and quality control verification. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reagent standard record was first created in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Part of the audit trail. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: current_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of the reagent or standard available in laboratory inventory. Updated as material is consumed or replenished. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Approved method for disposing of expired or unused reagent or standard, such as chemical waste collection, neutralization, incineration, or return to supplier. Ensures compliance with environmental and safety regulations. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the reagent or standard should no longer be used for analytical testing due to potential degradation or loss of certified properties. Determined by manufacturer specifications or laboratory stability studies. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Safety hazard classification of the reagent according to Globally Harmonized System (GHS) or OSHA Hazard Communication Standard. Examples include flammable, corrosive, toxic, oxidizer, or non-hazardous.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this standard was last used for instrument calibration or quality control verification. Supports traceability and audit trail for analytical data defensibility. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned lot or batch number for the reagent or standard. Essential for traceability in the event of quality issues or recalls and for demonstrating chain of custody in regulatory audits. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this reagent standard record in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Supports accountability and audit compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reagent standard record was last modified in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Supports change tracking and audit compliance. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, observations, or special handling instructions related to the reagent or standard. May include stability observations, usage restrictions, or audit findings. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: preparation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reagent or standard was prepared or diluted in the laboratory. For commercially prepared standards, this is the manufacture date. Critical for determining shelf life and expiry. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reagent_name
attributes.description: Full chemical or commercial name of the reagent, standard, or reference material as provided by the manufacturer or as catalogued in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reagent_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reagent or standard: active (in use), expired (past expiry date), depleted (stock exhausted), quarantined (under investigation or hold), or disposed (removed from inventory). Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reagent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the chemical material by its intended laboratory use: reagent for general analytical work, standard for calibration, reference material for quality control, buffer for pH adjustment, indicator for endpoint detection, or solvent for dilution and extraction. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: reorder_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum stock quantity that triggers a reorder alert or procurement action. Ensures continuous availability of critical reagents and standards for analytical operations. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file location for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this reagent. SDS provides hazard information, handling instructions, and emergency procedures. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: stock_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the stock quantity: milliliters (mL), liters (L), grams (g), kilograms (kg), units, or vials. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for storing the reagent or standard to maintain stability and integrity: ambient temperature, refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (<0°C), protected from light (dark), or under inert atmosphere. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location within the laboratory where the reagent or standard is stored, such as refrigerator ID, cabinet number, or shelf designation. Supports inventory management and retrieval. Ref: LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the laboratory supervisor or quality assurance officer who verified the preparation or receipt of the reagent or standard. Ensures independent quality control.

products.name: analyte
products.description: Reference catalog of all chemical, biological, and physical parameters that the laboratory is capable of or required to measure. products.name: method_detection_limit
products.description: Record of Method Detection Limit (MDL) and Minimum Reporting Level (MRL) determinations performed for each analyte-method-instrument combination in the laboratory. Captures the study date, number of replicates, spike concentration, calculated MDL, calculated MRL/PQL, analyst, instrument used, and regulatory acceptance status. MDL studies must be conducted annually or when method or instrument conditions change, per EPA MDL procedure (40 CFR Part 136 Appendix B).

products.name: analyst_method_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between certified analysts and test methods in the laboratory quality assurance program. It captures the formal qualification of each analyst to perform specific analytical test methods, including certification dates, proficiency testing results, and signatory authority. Each record links one certified analyst to one test method with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship. The laboratory quality manager actively manages this matrix of qualifications, tracking expiration dates, proficiency test results, and signatory authority for each analyst-method combination.

products.description: This association product represents the completion event between certified_analyst and training_course. It captures the regulatory compliance and continuing education tracking required for laboratory analyst certification maintenance. Each record links one certified_analyst to one training_course with completion dates, CEU credits earned, and certification issuance details that exist only in the context of this specific training completion.. Existence Justification: In water utility laboratory operations, certified analysts must complete multiple training courses over their careers to maintain certifications, earn continuing education credits, and stay current with regulatory requirements and analytical methods. Each training course is completed by multiple analysts across the organization. The business actively manages these training completion records to ensure regulatory compliance, track CEU credit accumulation toward certification renewals, and maintain analyst authorization for specific test methods.

domains.description: Regulatory compliance management including permit tracking (NPDES, IUP, state primacy agency permits), MOR/DMR preparation and submission, violation management, enforcement action tracking, audit trails, environmental reporting, SDWA and CWA compliance, CCR publication tracking, and regulatory correspondence. Ensures adherence to all federal, state, and local water and wastewater regulations.

products.name: compliance_permit
products.description: Master record for all regulatory operating permits held by the utility, including NPDES discharge permits, state drinking water permits, IUPs (Industrial User Permits), air quality permits, and stormwater permits. Tracks permit number, issuing authority (EPA, state primacy agency, NPDES), permit type, facility covered, effective and expiration dates, permitted limits, renewal status, and associated regulatory program (SDWA, CWA). Serves as the authoritative registry of all regulatory authorizations required to operate water and wastewater facilities. [SSOT: Canonical source of truth for this concept across domains.] SSOT master for permits.

products.name: permit_condition
products.description: Individual enforceable conditions and limitations attached to a regulatory permit, including effluent limits (BOD, TSS, TDS, pH, COD), monitoring frequencies, reporting requirements, technology-based standards, and narrative conditions. Each condition is linked to its parent permit and tracks the parameter, limit type (daily max, monthly average), numeric threshold, units, monitoring location, and compliance evaluation method. Enables automated compliance checking against actual discharge monitoring results.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: EPA SDWA; NPDWR

attributes.name: permit_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the permit condition record. Primary key. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: analyte_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.analyte. Business justification: Permit conditions regulate specific contaminants. Direct link to analyte master enables automated compliance limit evaluation, eliminates denormalized parameter_name, and ensures consistent contaminan. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance permit referenced by each permit condition record in the compliance domain.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.test_method. Business justification: Permit conditions specify required analytical methods (e.g., EPA 200.8 for metals). Direct link enables automated validation that laboratory results used approved methods for regulatory compliance eva. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: treatment_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.treatment_permit. Business justification: Permit conditions define operational limits enforced at treatment facilities. Business process: permit compliance tracking where specific numeric limits (turbidity <0.3 NTU, CT >15 mg-min/L, flow <10. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: analytical_method
attributes.description: The specific EPA-approved or Standard Methods analytical procedure required for measuring this parameter (e.g., 'EPA Method 1664A', 'Standard Methods 5210B', 'EPA Method 200.8', 'EPA Method 537.1 for PFAS', 'SM 2540D for TDS', 'SM 4500-H+ for pH'). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_evaluation_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine compliance with this condition: single value comparison (each result compared to limit), rolling average (moving average over specified period), statistical analysis (percentile or confidence interval), narrative assessment (qualitative evaluation), or best professional judgment (case-by-case determination).

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition is subject to a compliance schedule (phased implementation plan) that allows the permittee additional time to achieve full compliance. True if a compliance schedule is in effect, False otherwise. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_milestone
attributes.description: Description of the compliance schedule milestone associated with this condition (e.g., 'Submit engineering plans by 2024-06-30', 'Complete construction by 2025-12-31', 'Achieve interim limit of 30 mg/L BOD by 2024-12-31'). Null if no compliance schedule applies. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: condition_number
attributes.description: The official condition number or identifier as stated in the permit document (e.g., 'I.A.1', 'II.B.3', 'Condition 5'). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the permit condition: active (currently enforceable), suspended (temporarily not enforced due to variance or stay), superseded (replaced by modified condition), expired (no longer in effect), or under appeal (contested by permittee). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: condition_text
attributes.description: The full verbatim text of the permit condition as written in the permit document. Includes all narrative requirements, qualifications, and regulatory language. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permit condition: effluent limit (numeric discharge limit), monitoring requirement (sampling frequency and method), reporting requirement (MOR/DMR submission), technology-based standard (treatment technology mandate), narrative condition (qualitative requirement), or best management practice (operational control). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this permit condition record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance tracking. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: detection_limit_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum detection limit (MDL) or practical quantitation limit (PQL) required for the analytical method. Ensures that the laboratory can measure the parameter at levels sufficiently below the permit limit to demonstrate compliance. Null if no specific detection limit is mandated. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition becomes enforceable. May differ from the parent permit effective date if the condition has a phased implementation schedule. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: enforcement_priority
attributes.description: The priority level assigned by the regulatory agency for enforcement of this condition. Critical conditions (e.g., public health parameters like coliform, lead, PFAS) trigger immediate enforcement action upon violation. High priority conditions (e.g., BOD, TSS, pH) require prompt corrective action. Medium and low priority conditions may allow for compliance schedules. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition expires or is superseded. Typically aligns with the parent permit expiration date unless the condition is time-limited or subject to modification. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Active flag. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: The statistical basis for the effluent limit: daily maximum (highest single-day value), monthly average (arithmetic mean over calendar month), weekly average (arithmetic mean over 7-day period), instantaneous maximum (single grab sample), annual average, or minimum (for parameters like dissolved oxygen). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: limit_unit
attributes.description: Limit unit. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: limit_value
attributes.description: Limit value. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mixing_zone_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mixing zone (limited area where discharge is allowed to exceed water quality standards before achieving full dilution and compliance) is authorized for this condition. True if mixing zone is allowed, False if end-of-pipe compliance is required. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mixing_zone_description
attributes.description: Description of the authorized mixing zone including dimensions, boundaries, and compliance monitoring points (e.g., '100 meters downstream of Outfall 001', 'Within 50-foot radius of discharge point', 'Compliance measured at edge of mixing zone'). Null if no mixing zone is allowed. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this permit condition was last modified through permit amendment, administrative order, or consent decree. Null if the condition has never been modified since the original permit issuance. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the most recent modification to this condition (e.g., 'Updated water quality standards', 'New analytical method approved', 'Compliance schedule adjustment', 'Facility upgrade completed', 'Enforcement action settlement', 'Anti-backsliding provision waiver'). Null if never modified. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for monitoring or sampling this parameter: continuous (real-time SCADA monitoring), daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, or as needed (event-driven). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: monitoring_location
attributes.description: The specific location where monitoring or sampling must occur (e.g., 'Outfall 001', 'Effluent Discharge Point A', 'Influent to Primary Treatment', 'Final Effluent'). May reference a specific outfall, sampling point, or monitoring station. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or operational guidance related to this permit condition. May include cross-references to other permit sections, special instructions for compliance staff, or historical context. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: numeric_limit
attributes.description: The numeric threshold value for the effluent limit or monitoring requirement. Null for narrative conditions or qualitative requirements. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parameter
attributes.description: Regulated parameter. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the regulated parameter (e.g., '00310' for BOD, '00530' for TSS, '00400' for pH, '00600' for TDS). Uses EPA STORET or equivalent parameter coding system. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: public_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether violations of this condition require public notification (e.g., inclusion in Consumer Confidence Report (CCR), public notice in local newspaper, notification to downstream water users). True if public notification is required, False otherwise. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_requirement
attributes.description: Specific quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements for monitoring and sampling (e.g., 'EPA Method 1664A for FOG', 'Standard Methods 5210B for BOD', 'EPA Method 200.8 for metals', 'Chain of custody required', 'Laboratory must be state-certified', 'Duplicate samples required quarterly'). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: receiving_water_body
attributes.description: The name of the receiving water body (river, stream, lake, estuary, ocean, groundwater) into which the discharge occurs and for which this condition is designed to protect water quality (e.g., 'Mississippi River', 'Lake Michigan', 'Chesapeake Bay', 'Atlantic Ocean', 'Groundwater Aquifer Zone IIA'). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: record_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days that monitoring records, laboratory results, and compliance documentation for this condition must be retained by the permittee. Typically 3 years (1095 days) for NPDES permits, but may be longer for certain parameters or enforcement actions. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Record lifecycle status. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The legal or regulatory authority for this condition (e.g., 'Clean Water Act Section 301', 'SDWA Section 1412', '40 CFR 122.44', 'State Water Quality Standard Chapter 62-302', 'Technology-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Water Quality-Based Effluent Limitation', 'Best Available Technology (BAT)', 'Best Conventional Pollutant Control Technology (BCT)'). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for reporting monitoring results to the regulatory agency via Monthly Operating Report (MOR) or Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR): monthly, quarterly, annually, event-based (for spills or exceedances), or not required (internal monitoring only). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The type of sample required for compliance monitoring: grab (single instantaneous sample), composite (time-weighted or flow-weighted composite over specified period), continuous (real-time monitoring), or flow-weighted (proportional to flow rate). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: seasonal_period
attributes.description: The time period during which seasonal variations apply (e.g., 'May 1 - September 30', 'Winter: November 1 - March 31', 'Low Flow Season: June - August'). Null if no seasonal variation applies. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: seasonal_variation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition has seasonal variations in limits or monitoring requirements (e.g., more stringent limits during low-flow summer months, reduced monitoring during winter). True if seasonal variations apply, False otherwise. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: technology_requirement
attributes.description: Specific treatment technology or operational practice mandated by this condition (e.g., 'Secondary Treatment', 'Ultraviolet (UV) Disinfection', 'Granular Activated Carbon (GAC) Filtration', 'Reverse Osmosis (RO)', 'Microfiltration (MF)', 'Ultrafiltration (UF)', 'Fats Oils and Grease (FOG) Pretreatment', 'Best Management Practice (BMP) for Stormwater'). Null for non-technology-based conditions. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the numeric limit (e.g., 'mg/L' for milligrams per liter, 'ug/L' for micrograms per liter, 'NTU' for Nephelometric Turbidity Units, 'SU' for Standard Units (pH), 'MPN/100mL' for Most Probable Number per 100 milliliters, 'lbs/day' for pounds per day, 'MGD' for Million Gallons per Day). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this permit condition record was last updated in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance tracking. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: violation_threshold
attributes.description: The numeric value at which a violation is triggered. May differ from the numeric limit if the permit allows for measurement uncertainty, rounding conventions, or compliance margins. Null for narrative conditions. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: water_quality_standard_basis
attributes.description: The specific water quality standard or criterion that this condition is designed to protect (e.g., 'Aquatic Life Chronic Criterion', 'Human Health - Fish Consumption', 'Drinking Water Maximum Contaminant Level (MCL)', 'Recreational Water Quality Standard', 'Anti-Degradation Policy Tier II'). Null for technology-based conditions. Ref: EPA SDWA.

products.name: regulatory_requirement
products.description: Catalog of all applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements that the utility must comply with, including SDWA rules (LCRR, DBP rules, Surface Water Treatment Rule), CWA requirements, EPA MCLs/MCLGs, state primacy agency rules, NPDES general permits, and local pretreatment standards. Tracks the regulation citation, regulatory program, effective date, compliance deadline, applicable facility types, and the specific operational or reporting obligation imposed. Serves as the master compliance obligation registry.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: EPA SDWA; NPDWR

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory requirement record. Primary key. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: analyte_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.analyte. Business justification: Regulatory requirements define which contaminants must be monitored (e.g., SDWA MCLs). Direct link to analyte master is foundational for compliance program design and eliminates denormalized contamina. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_id
attributes.description: Governing agency. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: required_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Many regulatory requirements mandate specific position types (e.g., Grade IV operator for large systems, certified backflow tester). Links regulatory mandates to workforce planning and ensures proper. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: test_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.test_method. Business justification: Regulations specify approved analytical methods for compliance monitoring. Essential for laboratory method selection, accreditation scope definition, and ensuring regulatory defensibility of analytica. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: applicable_facility_type
attributes.description: Type of facility or system to which this requirement applies. WTP = Water Treatment Plant, WWTP = Wastewater Treatment Plant, STP = Sewage Treatment Plant. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: applicable_system_size
attributes.description: System size classification to which this requirement applies (e.g., large system >50,000 population, medium system 3,301-50,000, small system <=3,300). Null if applies to all sizes. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: ccr_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Confidence Report (CCR) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requirement must be included in the annual Consumer Confidence Report (CCR). Ref: EPA SDWA.

tag_set.value: Consumer Confidence Report (CCR) Reporting Required Flag

attributes.name: citation
attributes.description: Regulatory citation. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the utility must achieve full compliance with the requirement. Null if no specific deadline or if compliance is ongoing. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the utility with respect to this regulatory requirement. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory requirement record was first created in the system. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: directive_reference
attributes.description: Specific directive or regulation reference number (e.g. 2020/2184, 2000/60/EC, 91/271/EEC, 40 CFR 141). Used for EU and international regulatory cross-referencing. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory requirement became or will become effective and enforceable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: enforcement_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned by the utility or regulator for enforcement and compliance tracking. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: eu_directive_article
attributes.description: Specific article/annex reference within EU directives (e.g. Annex I Part B of DWD 2020/2184, Article 5 of WFD 2000/60/EC). NULL for non-EU requirements. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: eu_directive_reference
attributes.description: EU Directive reference (e.g., 2020/2184 Drinking Water Directive). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: eu_parametric_value
attributes.description: EU Drinking Water Directive parametric value equivalent to US MCL. Stored separately to support dual-jurisdiction compliance for utilities operating under both US EPA and EU/national frameworks (ANSES, DWI, UBA). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: eu_parametric_value_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the EU parametric value (e.g. ug/L, mg/L, Bq/L). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: internal_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the utility's internal policy, procedure, or standard operating procedure (SOP) that implements this regulatory requirement. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: international_standard_reference
attributes.description: ISO or WHO guideline reference

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory requirement is currently active and enforceable. False if the requirement has been superseded, repealed, or is no longer applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or agency that issued the regulatory requirement (e.g., EPA, state primacy agency, local municipality, AWWA, WEF, OSHA, ISO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPA|state_primacy_agency|local_municipality|AWWA|WEF|OSHA|ISO — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issuing_body_reference
attributes.description: Issuing regulatory body per region: ANSES; DWI; ECHA; EPA; European Commission; UBA. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic or administrative jurisdiction to which this requirement applies (e.g., federal, state name, county, municipality). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or regional code (e.g. US, EU, GB, DE, FR) identifying the regulatory jurisdiction. Supports multi-national regulatory frameworks including US EPA SDWA, EU Drinking Water Directive 2020/2184, and Water Framework Directive 2000/60/EC.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_framework
attributes.description: Governing framework for the region. Refs: US SDWA/NPDWR/LCRR (EPA); EU Drinking Water Directive 2020/2184; REACH PFAS restriction (ECHA); Water Framework Directive 2000/60/EC; Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive 91/271/EEC; FR ANSES national implementation; UK DWI national implementation; DE UBA national implementation

attributes.name: jurisdiction_region_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Jurisdiction region code (US, EU, FR, UK, DE, etc.)
attributes.description: ISO region code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (e.g. US, EU, FR, UK, DE). Enables parallel US/EU/international regulatory coverage per DWD 2020/2184, WFD 2000/60/EC, UWWTD 91/271/EEC.

tag_set.value: Jurisdiction region code (US, EU, FR, UK, DE, etc.)

attributes.name: last_compliance_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent internal or external compliance assessment or audit for this requirement. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory requirement record was last updated or modified. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mcl_unit

attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MCL value (e.g., mg/L, ug/L, pCi/L, NTU). Null if not applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mcl_value
attributes.description: The enforceable maximum contaminant level (MCL) specified by the requirement. Null if not applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mclg_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Contaminant Level Goal (MCLG) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the MCLG value (e.g., mg/L, ug/L, pCi/L). Null if not applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: mclg_value
attributes.description: The non-enforceable maximum contaminant level goal (MCLG) specified by the requirement. Null if not applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of monitoring or sampling for compliance (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually). Null if not applicable. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: national_regulation_reference
attributes.description: National-level (FR/UK/DE) regulation reference; e.g. ANSES, DWI, UBA guidance. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: national_transposition_reference
attributes.description: Reference to national law transposing EU directive or national-specific regulation (e.g., French Code de la sante publique, German TrinkwV, UK Water Supply Regulations). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: next_compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or assessment of this requirement. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the regulatory requirement, including implementation challenges, variances granted, or special conditions. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parametric_value_eu
attributes.description: EU Drinking Water Directive parametric value equivalent to US MCL. Stored alongside mcl_value for cross-jurisdictional comparison.

attributes.name: wfd_environmental_quality_standard
attributes.description: Numeric Environmental Quality Standard (EQS) value as defined under EU WFD Annex V or Priority Substances Directive 2013/39/EU. EQS are expressed as annual average (AA-EQS) or maximum allowable concentration (MAC-EQS), differing from US water quality criteria which use CMC/CCC terminology. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: wfd_quality_element_category

attributes.name: wfd_surface_water_status_class
attributes.description: EU WFD ecological status classification: High, Good, Moderate, Poor, Bad. Under WFD Article 4, member states must achieve Good status for all water bodies. products.name: obligation
products.description: Operational compliance task or obligation derived from a regulatory requirement or permit condition, assigned to a specific facility, system, or organizational unit. Tracks the obligation type (monitoring, reporting, operational, training, inspection), responsible party, due date, recurrence schedule, associated regulatory requirement or permit condition, completion status, and evidence of fulfillment. Bridges the gap between abstract regulatory requirements and day-to-day compliance activities.

products.name: dmr

Tracks the permit number, outfall or monitoring point, reporting period (monthly, quarterly), parameter results (BOD, TSS, pH, flow in MGD), exceedance flags, submission date, submission method (NetDMR, paper), preparer, and certifying official. Core regulatory reporting artifact for WWTP and WTP discharge compliance under CWA/NPDES.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual parameter measurement result recorded on a Discharge Monitoring Report. Primary key for granular compliance tracking at the parameter level. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Permit ID
attributes.description: Reference to the NPDES permit under which this discharge monitoring result is reported. Establishes the regulatory framework and limits applicable to this measurement. Ref: EPA SDWA.

tag_set.value: National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Permit ID

attributes.name: dmr_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this record. Required for regulatory audit trails and accountability in compliance reporting. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: dmr_id
attributes.description: Parent DMR. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: dmr_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this record. Required for regulatory audit trails and accountability in compliance reporting. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: dmr_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent DMR submission that contains this parameter result. Links the individual measurement to the overall monthly or quarterly discharge report. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: finished_water_production_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treatment.finished_water_production. Business justification: DMR results report finished water quality parameters from treatment production records. Business process: NPDES discharge monitoring where finished water quality data (turbidity, chlorine residual, pH. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: lab_sample_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the laboratory to this sample. Enables traceability to laboratory records, chain of custody documentation, and quality control data. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified laboratory that performed the analysis. Required for audit trails and quality assurance verification. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: outfall_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific discharge outfall or monitoring point where this sample was collected. Critical for tracking location-specific compliance. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certified laboratory that performed the analysis. Required for audit trails and quality assurance verification. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date on which the laboratory analysis was performed. Used to verify compliance with holding time requirements for various parameters. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: analytical_method
attributes.description: The EPA-approved analytical method used to measure this parameter (e.g., SM 5210B for BOD, EPA 410.4 for COD, SM 2540D for TSS, EPA 300.0 for nitrate). Ensures measurement accuracy and regulatory acceptance. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance determination for this parameter result (compliant, non-compliant, not applicable, pending review). Drives enforcement workflows and regulatory reporting. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DMR result record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Internal quality assurance flag indicating the reliability of this measurement result (valid, suspect, invalid, pending review). Used for data validation workflows before regulatory submission. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum concentration that can be reliably detected by the analytical method used. Important for interpreting results below detection limits and assessing method adequacy. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: enforcement_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this result triggers a mandatory enforcement action under the permit or regulatory framework. True initiates enforcement workflows. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measured value exceeded the permit limit. True indicates a violation requiring reporting and potential enforcement action. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: exceedance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage by which the measured value exceeded the permit limit, calculated as ((measured_value - permit_limit) / permit_limit) * 100. Quantifies the severity of violations. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: is_violation
attributes.description: Violation flag. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Measured value. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this parameter is required to be monitored under the permit (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, continuous). Determines sampling schedule and compliance evaluation periods. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric value measured for this parameter during the monitoring period. Precision supports a wide range of parameter types from trace contaminants to high-volume flow measurements. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this DMR result record was last modified. Tracks data quality corrections, resubmissions, and audit trail requirements. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: monitoring_location_code
attributes.description: The specific monitoring point or location code as designated in the NPDES permit. May differ from outfall_id for internal monitoring points or upstream/downstream reference locations. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: nodi_code
attributes.description: EPA code indicating why no measurement data is reported for a required parameter (e.g., 9 for no discharge, C for facility not operational, Q for quality assurance issue). Used when measurement_value is null. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: number_of_exceedances
attributes.description: The count of individual samples that exceeded the permit limit during the reporting period. Used for compliance tracking and violation severity assessment. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: number_of_samples
attributes.description: The total number of individual samples collected and analyzed during the reporting period for this parameter. Used to calculate statistical bases like monthly averages. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parameter
attributes.description: Parameter. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific effluent parameter being measured (e.g., 00310 for BOD, 00340 for COD, 00530 for TSS, 00600 for TDS, 00400 for pH, 50050 for flow, 31616 for fecal coliform, 00620 for nitrate, 00665 for phosphorus). Uses EPA parameter codes from the STORET database. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the effluent parameter being measured (e.g., Biochemical Oxygen Demand, Chemical Oxygen Demand, Total Suspended Solids, Total Dissolved Solids, pH, Flow, Fecal Coliform, Nitrate, Phosphorus). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: permit_limit_type
attributes.description: The type of limit specified in the permit (maximum concentration, minimum value, acceptable range, or narrative standard). Determines how compliance is evaluated. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: permit_limit_value
attributes.description: The numeric limit specified in the NPDES permit for this parameter and statistical base. Used for direct comparison with the measured value to determine compliance status.

attributes.name: qa_qc_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting quality assurance or quality control issues, corrective actions, or special circumstances affecting this measurement. Supports audit trails and regulatory inquiries. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: qualifier_code
attributes.description: Code indicating special conditions affecting the measurement (e.g., < for below detection limit, > for above quantification limit, E for estimated value, J for value below reporting limit but above detection limit). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: quantification_limit
attributes.description: The minimum concentration that can be reliably quantified by the analytical method. Typically higher than the detection limit and used for regulatory compliance evaluation. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Record lifecycle status. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the monitoring period covered by this DMR result (typically the last day of the month for monthly reporting). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the monitoring period covered by this DMR result (typically the first day of the month for monthly reporting). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sample was collected from the outfall for laboratory analysis or field measurement. Critical for tracking temporal compliance patterns. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: sample_collection_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the sample was collected. Important for grab samples and instantaneous measurements where timing affects results. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: The type of sample collected for this measurement (grab sample, composite sample, or continuous monitoring). Affects data interpretation and compliance evaluation. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: statistical_base
attributes.description: The statistical qualifier or basis for the reported value (e.g., daily maximum, monthly average, weekly average, annual average, instantaneous, geometric mean). Determines how the measurement is compared against permit limits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily_maximum|daily_minimum|monthly_average|weekly_average|annual_average|instantaneous|geometric_mean — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this result was submitted to the regulatory agency through NetDMR or other electronic reporting system. Establishes the official compliance record timestamp. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: submitted_to_regulator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this result has been officially submitted to the regulatory agency as part of the DMR. True indicates the data is part of the official compliance record. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measurement value is expressed (e.g., mg/L for BOD/COD/TSS/TDS, standard units for pH, MGD or GPM for flow, MPN/100mL for fecal coliform, mg/L as N for nitrate, mg/L as P for phosphorus). Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record update timestamp. Ref: EPA SDWA.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the type of violation if non-compliant (effluent limit exceedance, monitoring frequency violation, reporting violation, or none). Used for enforcement prioritization and trend analysis. Ref: EPA SDWA.

products.name: mor
products.description: Monthly Operating Report (MOR) submitted to the state primacy agency documenting drinking water treatment plant operations, including treatment process performance, chemical dosing, CT (Contact Time for Disinfection) calculations, turbidity (NTU) compliance, disinfection residuals, source water quality, and operational events. Tracks the WTP facility, reporting month, preparer, submission date, certification status, and key operational parameters required by the state drinking water program under SDWA.

products.name: compliance_violation
products.description: Formal record of a regulatory violation identified at a utility facility or in a regulatory submission, including MCL exceedances, permit limit violations, monitoring and reporting violations (MRVs), treatment technique violations, and public notification failures. products.name: enforcement_action
products.description: Formal enforcement action initiated by a regulatory agency (EPA, state primacy agency, NPDES authority) against the utility in response to violations, including Notices of Violation (NOVs), Administrative Orders (AOs), Consent Orders, Compliance Schedules, civil penalties, and criminal referrals. Tracks the issuing agency, action type, associated violations, compliance schedule milestones, penalty amounts, response deadlines, legal counsel assigned, and resolution outcome. Drives the utility's formal regulatory response process.

products.name: regulatory_submission
products.description: Master record of all formal regulatory submissions made by the utility to regulatory agencies, serving as the single audit trail for submission compliance. Covers DMR submissions (via NetDMR), MOR submissions, CCR certifications, annual compliance reports, pretreatment program reports, SSO/CSO notifications, PFAS reporting, LCRR service line inventory submissions, and Lead Service Line Replacement (LSLR) progress reports. Tracks submission type, receiving agency, submission date, submission method (NetDMR, state portal, paper, email), reporting period, submitter, certifying official, certification status, acknowledgment receipt, late submission flags, and resubmission history. Enables monitoring of submission timeliness — a key compliance metric tracked by state primacy agencies.

products.name: industrial_user
products.description: Master record of industrial and commercial users subject to the utility's pretreatment program, including Significant Industrial Users (SIUs), Categorical Industrial Users (CIUs), and non-significant industrial users. Tracks the business name, facility address, SIC/NAICS code, industrial user classification, assigned IUP, discharge connection point, estimated discharge volume (GPD), key pollutants of concern (FOG, heavy metals, BOD, TSS), inspection frequency, and compliance history. products.name: permit_vendor_service
products.description: This association product represents the service contract between compliance_permit and vendor. It captures the specific services provided by vendors in support of regulatory permit compliance, including engineering consulting, legal counsel, laboratory testing, environmental monitoring, and permit application preparation. Each record links one compliance_permit to one vendor with attributes that describe the service relationship, contract terms, deliverables, and performance metrics specific to that permit-vendor engagement.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, regulatory permits require multiple specialized vendors providing distinct services: engineering consultants for permit applications, legal counsel for regulatory compliance, laboratories for water quality testing, and environmental monitoring firms for ongoing compliance reporting. Each permit-vendor relationship represents a specific service engagement with its own contract terms, deliverables, scope, and performance metrics. Conversely, vendors (especially specialized consulting firms and testing laboratories) serve multiple permits across different facilities and regulatory programs (NPDES, SDWA, air quality). The utility actively manages these service relationships, tracking contract dates, deliverable status, and vendor performance for each permit-vendor engagement.

products.name: material_compliance_certification
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance certification relationship between regulatory requirements and materials/chemicals used in water treatment. It captures the NSF/ANSI 60/61 certification status, state approvals, and regulatory compliance documentation for each material-requirement pair. Each record links one regulatory requirement to one material with certification dates, approval status, and applicable standards that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, regulatory requirements (such as Lead and Copper Rule, DBP rules, SDWA MCLs, PFAS standards) apply to multiple treatment chemicals and materials, and each chemical/material must comply with multiple regulatory requirements. Utilities actively manage NSF/ANSI 60/61 certifications, state approvals, and regulatory compliance status for each material-requirement pair as a distinct operational record with certification dates, approval status, expiration tracking, and dosage limits. This is a genuine operational M:N relationship where compliance officers create, monitor, and renew certifications as part of regulatory compliance workflows.

products.name: permit_grant_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the funding allocation between compliance permits and grants in water utilities. It captures the financial relationship where grants fund permit-related compliance activities and capital improvements. Each record links one compliance permit to one grant with allocation amounts, eligible activities, drawdown schedules, compliance milestones, and reporting periods that exist only in the context of this funding relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, compliance permits frequently require capital improvements and ongoing compliance activities funded by multiple grants (e.g., a NPDES discharge permit may receive funding from both CWSRF for treatment upgrades and EPA grants for monitoring equipment). Conversely, single grants commonly fund compliance activities across multiple permits (e.g., a DWSRF loan funds upgrades for both drinking water permits and NPDES permits at the same facility). Utilities actively manage these allocations, tracking specific dollar amounts, eligible activities, drawdown schedules, compliance milestones, and reporting periods for each permit-grant pairing to ensure grant compliance and audit readiness.

products.name: crew_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between compliance_obligation and crew. It captures the operational assignment of field service crews to specific compliance obligations, tracking crew-specific progress, effort allocation, and role in fulfilling regulatory requirements. Each record links one compliance_obligation to one crew with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, complex compliance obligations (such as system-wide valve exercising programs, annual hydrant flushing campaigns, or multi-site NPDES monitoring) routinely require multiple specialized crews working concurrently or sequentially, each contributing specific expertise or covering different geographic areas. Simultaneously, field service crews are assigned to multiple compliance obligations throughout the year, balancing regulatory work with emergency response and routine maintenance. The business actively manages these assignments, tracking crew-specific progress, effort allocation, roles, and completion status for regulatory reporting and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount

attributes.name: renewal_fee_paid_date

attributes.name: revocation_date

attributes.name: revocation_reason

attributes.name: suspension_end_date

attributes.name: suspension_reason

products.name: certification
products.description: Tracks professional certifications, safety credentials, technical qualifications, and operational competencies for utility employees beyond state operator licenses. Includes OSHA 10/30, confined space entry, CDL, backflow prevention tester, HAZWOPER, first aid/CPR, forklift, AWWA-recognized credentials, and operational skill proficiencies (SCADA operation, pipe repair, chemical handling, GIS mapping). Captures certifying body or assessor, certificate number, issue date, expiration date, proficiency level (trainee, qualified, expert), CEU requirements, renewal tracking, and qualification type discriminator. Enables compliance tracking, skills-based crew assignment, and workforce development gap analysis.

products.name: shift_assignment
products.description: Comprehensive shift management product for 24/7 utility operations covering both schedule templates and individual employee shift assignments. Schedule template aspects capture shift type (day/evening/night/on-call/split), rotation pattern (fixed, rotating, 12-hour continental, Panama), start/end times, facility or DMA zone assignment, minimum staffing requirements, and effective date ranges. Assignment aspects capture individual employee, assigned date, start/end datetime, role during shift (lead operator, assistant, on-call primary/backup), overtime flag, assignment status (scheduled, confirmed, swapped, absent), on-call activation history, and coverage gap alerts. Supports WTP, WWTP, distribution, collection, and field service crew staffing continuity including emergency response roster management and mutual aid callout coordination.

attributes.description: Current delivery fulfillment status of this line item. Tracks progress from order placement through complete goods receipt. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a goods receipt is required for this line item. True for materials requiring physical receipt confirmation; false for services or non-stock items. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_quantity
