attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of goods received against this line item to date. Updated as goods receipts are posted. Used to track delivery fulfillment and outstanding quantities. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: invoice_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced against this line item to date. Used for invoice verification and to identify discrepancies between ordered, received, and invoiced quantities. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an invoice is expected for this line item. Used to control invoice verification and three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in accounts payable processing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement line item type. Determines procurement processing rules, inventory treatment, and account assignment behavior. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this line item record. Tracks changes to quantities, prices, delivery dates, or other line item attributes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and position of this item in the multi-line PO document. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number. Critical for spare parts procurement to ensure compatibility with existing equipment in treatment plants and distribution infrastructure. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Material group classification code for procurement analytics and spend categorization. Groups similar materials (e.g., all treatment chemicals, all pipe fittings, all electrical components) for supplier performance analysis and contract management. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material being procured. Alphanumeric code used across procurement, inventory, and operations to identify chemicals (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride), spare parts, equipment, or services. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total net value for this line item, calculated as quantity_ordered multiplied by net_price, adjusted for price_unit. Excludes taxes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Net price per unit of measure for this line item, excluding taxes and discounts. Used to calculate line item total value. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Allowable percentage by which the vendor may over-deliver beyond the ordered quantity without requiring approval. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the receiving plant or facility. Typically represents a Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), or warehouse location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Number of units to which the net price applies. For example, if price is $100 per 10 gallons, price_unit would be 10. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the source purchase requisition. Used in conjunction with purchase_requisition_number for complete requisition-to-PO traceability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the buyer or purchasing team responsible for this procurement. Used for workload distribution and buyer performance tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service ordered on this line item. Expressed in the unit of measure specified for this line. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that originated the purchase requisition leading to this PO line item. Used for procurement tracking and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being procured on this line. Provides human-readable context for the line item, especially useful for non-stock materials or services. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code within the plant where material will be received and stored. Used for warehouse management and inventory tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code determining applicable sales tax, use tax, or VAT for this line item. Used for tax calculation and compliance reporting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Allowable percentage by which the vendor may under-deliver below the ordered quantity without penalty. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.00 for 2%). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Common units include EA (each), GAL (gallons) for chemicals, LB (pounds), KG (kilograms), HR (hours) for services, TON for bulk materials. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|LB|GAL|KG|L|M|FT|TON|CY|HR|DAY — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: Vendor's own material or catalog number for the item being procured. Used for cross-reference and to ensure correct item is supplied, especially critical for chemical procurement (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project assignment. Used to track Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for infrastructure projects such as treatment plant upgrades, distribution network expansion, or asset renewal. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Records the physical receipt of materials, chemicals, or services at a utility facility (WTP, WWTP, warehouse, field location) against a purchase order. Captures GR document number, posting date, delivery note number, received quantity, storage location, batch/lot number, supplier lot number for chemicals, certificate of analysis reference, quality inspection flag, acceptance status, storage tank or container assigned, delivery vehicle, SDS version, and movement type. Triggers inventory update and three-way match for invoice verification. Supports chemical traceability and regulatory compliance for treatment chemical receipts. Aligns with SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO/MSEG).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt transaction. Primary key for the goods receipt record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility facility where the goods were received. May be a Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), warehouse, or field location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Goods receipts post to GL accounts for inventory valuation and expense recognition in direct-charge scenarios. Required for three-way match accounting and inventory-to-GL reconciliation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the person who received the goods. Links to workforce management systems. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the item received. Links to chemicals, spare parts, equipment, or other materials. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_material_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the item received. Links to chemicals, spare parts, equipment, or other materials. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line_item. Business justification: Goods receipts are posted against specific PO line items, not just the header. This is critical for three-way matching (PO line, GR, Invoice) in accounts payable. Currently uses denormalized purchase_. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which goods or services were received. Links to the originating procurement document. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: receiving_personnel_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the person who received the goods. Links to workforce management systems. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who delivered the goods or services. Links to the vendor master record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse_location. Business justification: Goods receipts post inventory to specific warehouse locations. Currently uses denormalized storage_location_code STRING; should be proper FK to enable location-based inventory tracking and capacity ma. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned to the received material, particularly important for chemicals (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride) for traceability and quality control. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The system user ID who created this goods receipt record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for US-based water utilities.

attributes.name: delivery_condition
attributes.description: The physical condition of the delivered goods at the time of receipt. Good indicates acceptable condition, damaged indicates physical damage, partial indicates incomplete delivery, incorrect indicates wrong items, contaminated indicates quality issues. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The delivery note or packing slip number provided by the vendor at the time of delivery. Used for cross-referencing with vendor documentation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by receiving personnel regarding the delivery. May include observations about packaging, condition, discrepancies, or special handling. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gr_document_date
attributes.description: The date on the goods receipt document, typically the date of physical receipt or delivery note date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known goods receipt document number generated by the ERP system. Used for tracking and audit purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gr_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the goods receipt was posted in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for inventory valuation and financial accounting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the goods receipt transaction in its lifecycle. Posted indicates successful receipt, reversed indicates cancellation, pending inspection indicates awaiting QC, completed indicates fully processed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number created for this goods receipt if quality inspection is required. Links to quality management records. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor invoice was verified and matched against this goods receipt. Null if invoice not yet received or verified. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The system user ID who last modified this goods receipt record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this goods receipt record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt material document was created. Used as part of the document key in SAP MM. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that classifies the type of goods receipt transaction. Common types: 101 (GR for PO), 103 (GR into blocked stock), 105 (GR from release order), 161 (GR for returnable transport packaging), 501 (GR without PO), 511 (GR from delivery without PO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|103|105|161|501|511|Z01|Z02 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material requires quality inspection before it can be released for use. True if inspection is required, False otherwise. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service received and accepted. Measured in the base unit of measure for the material. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: receiving_personnel_name
attributes.description: The name of the warehouse or operations personnel who physically received and verified the goods. Used for accountability and audit purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date when this goods receipt was reversed or cancelled. Null if not reversed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was cancelled. Used for audit trail and reconciliation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. True if reversed, False if active. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this goods receipt was reversed. Examples include incorrect quantity, wrong material, damaged goods, vendor return. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types such as consignment stock, returnable packaging, or project stock. Blank for standard stock. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The type of stock into which the material was received. Unrestricted stock is available for use, quality inspection stock is pending QC, blocked stock is not available, restricted stock has limited use. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Matched indicates all documents agree, variance indicates discrepancies, blocked indicates payment hold. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The total value of the goods receipt calculated as received quantity multiplied by unit price. Used for financial posting and invoice verification. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the received quantity. Common units include EA (each), GAL (gallons) for chemicals, LB (pounds), KG (kilograms), L (liters), TON (tons), DRUM, CYL (cylinder). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|LB|GAL|KG|L|M|FT|TON|BAG|DRUM|PAIL|CYL|BOX — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of measure for the received material as per the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and three-way match. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific physical location or dock where the goods were unloaded at the facility. Used for logistics tracking and facility management. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The valuation type used for split valuation of materials with different prices or qualities. Used when the same material is valued differently based on source or quality. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number provided by the vendor on the delivery documentation. Used for vendor traceability and quality issues. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: inventory_stock
products.description: Current stock levels for all materials and chemicals held across utility warehouses, treatment plant storage, and field storerooms. Captures material number, storage location, plant, unrestricted stock quantity, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, reserved quantity, reorder point, maximum stock level, safety stock level, days of supply remaining, last physical inventory date, book vs counted quantity (for physical inventory reconciliation), chemical-specific attributes (tank ID, expiry date, hazmat classification), and last replenishment date. Supports chemical dosing continuity, maintenance spare parts availability, and physical inventory audit. Aligns with SAP MM stock overview (MARD/MMBE) and physical inventory (IKPF/ISEG).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: inventory_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory stock record. Primary key for the inventory stock data product. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: inventory_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant or facility where the storage location resides. Links to WTP, WWTP, or operations center. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: inventory_wtp_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant or facility where the storage location resides. Links to WTP, WWTP, or operations center. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record. Links to the material being stocked (chemicals, spare parts, equipment, consumables). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location where the material is held. Links to warehouse, chemical storage facility, or field storeroom. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A = high-value/critical items requiring tight control; B = moderate-value items; C = low-value items with relaxed controls. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for new consumption or reservation. Calculated as unrestricted stock minus reserved quantity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: average_daily_consumption
attributes.description: Average quantity consumed per day based on historical usage. Used for demand forecasting and reorder point calculation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: batch_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is managed at the batch level. True for chemicals and materials requiring lot tracking for quality, expiration, or regulatory compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material blocked from use due to quality issues, expiration, damage, or regulatory hold. Cannot be issued until block is removed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: consignment_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock is held on consignment from a vendor. Consignment stock remains vendor-owned until consumed, reducing carrying costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory stock record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cycle_count_indicator
attributes.description: Frequency classification for cycle counting. A = high-frequency (monthly); B = medium-frequency (quarterly); C = low-frequency (annual); X = excluded from cycle counting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: days_of_supply
attributes.description: Number of days the current available stock will last based on average daily consumption. Calculated as available quantity divided by average daily consumption. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: expiration_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material has a limited shelf life and requires expiration date tracking. True for chemicals, reagents, and time-sensitive consumables. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and regulatory compliance (e.g., chlorine gas, sodium hypochlorite, acids). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock for this material at this location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock for this material at this location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory stock record was last updated. Tracks any change to stock quantities, valuation, or master data attributes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count for this material at this storage location. Used to track inventory accuracy and compliance with audit requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_stock_adjustment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent manual stock adjustment or inventory correction transaction for this material at this location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Planned delivery time in days from purchase requisition creation to goods receipt. Used for reorder point calculation and procurement planning. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material for identification and reporting purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum quantity to be maintained in stock. Used for inventory optimization and to prevent overstocking of chemicals with limited shelf life or high carrying costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure used for automatic replenishment. PD = MRP; VB = manual reorder point; VM = forecast-based planning; ND = no planning. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility (e.g., WTP1, WWTP2, DIST). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured. External = purchased from vendors; In-house = manufactured or produced internally; Both = can be procured either way. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently under quality inspection. Stock is on hold pending laboratory testing or quality assurance approval before release to unrestricted use. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum stock level that triggers automatic replenishment. When available quantity falls below this threshold, a purchase requisition is generated. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of unrestricted stock reserved for specific work orders, maintenance activities, or planned consumption. Reserved stock is committed but not yet issued. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock maintained to protect against stockouts due to demand variability or supply delays. Critical for chemicals required for continuous treatment operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: serial_number_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is managed at the serial number level. True for high-value equipment and assets requiring individual unit tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current status of stock availability. Derived from comparison of available quantity against reorder point and maximum stock level thresholds.

attributes.name: stock_turnover_ratio
attributes.description: Number of times inventory is consumed and replenished during a period. Indicates inventory efficiency and demand velocity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of stock ownership and purpose. Distinguishes between utility-owned stock, vendor consignment, project-specific stock, and other special stock categories. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of unrestricted stock at this location. Calculated as unrestricted quantity multiplied by material standard price or moving average price. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the storage location (e.g., WTP chemical storage, WWTP chemical storage, central warehouse, field storeroom). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for stock quantities (e.g., EA for each, LB for pounds, GAL for gallons, KG for kilograms, L for liters). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unrestricted_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for unrestricted use. This stock is available for consumption, transfer, or issue to work orders and operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for stock valuation (e.g., USD for United States Dollar).

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement including goods receipts, goods issues to work orders, transfers between storage locations, returns to vendor (movement type 122/161), physical inventory adjustments, and scrap postings. Captures movement type, material, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination storage location, posting date, reference document (work order, PO, reservation), movement reason, return reason code, and vendor reference for returns. Provides full material ledger traceability. Aligns with SAP MM Material Document (MSEG/MKPF).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Ten-character cost center code to which the material movement cost is charged. Used for internal consumption and expense allocation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: from_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse_location. Business justification: Stock movements track transfers between warehouse locations. Currently uses denormalized storage_location_from STRING; should be proper FK. Label prefix 'from_' distinguishes source location from dest. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Ten-digit general ledger account number to which the material movement value is posted. Determines the financial accounting impact. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: Stock movements of type 'goods receipt' should link to the originating goods_receipt record for full traceability. Currently uses denormalized goods_receipt_slip_number STRING; should be proper FK. En. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_requisition. Business justification: Stock movements for material issues to work orders should link to the material requisition/reservation that authorized the issue. Currently uses denormalized reservation_number STRING; should be prope. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Stock movements related to procurement should link to the originating purchase order for cost tracking and audit trail. Currently uses denormalized purchase_order_number STRING; should be proper FK. C. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being moved. Links to the material master record for chemicals, spare parts, or other inventory items. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: stock_material_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being moved. Links to the material master record for chemicals, spare parts, or other inventory items. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor from whom material was received (for goods receipt movements). Null for internal movements and issues. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: amount_in_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary value of the material movement in the local currency of the plant (typically USD for U.S. water utilities). Calculated as quantity × unit price. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number if this material movement is capitalized as part of an asset acquisition or improvement. Links to asset management for depreciation tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the batch or lot of material being moved. Critical for chemicals (chlorine, coagulants, polymers) to track expiration, quality, and traceability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The created timestamp associated with each stock movement record in the supply domain.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: External document number from the vendor's delivery note or packing slip. Used for goods receipt reconciliation and proof of delivery. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the external document (e.g., delivery note, packing slip, invoice) that accompanies the material movement. May differ from posting date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material document was created in the system. Audit timestamp for record creation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material document was created in the system. Provides precise audit trail for transaction timing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this material movement transaction in the ERP system. Serves as the business identifier for traceability and audit. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Part of the compound key in SAP MM along with material document number. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character indicator for special movement scenarios: B=Goods Movement for Purchase Order, H=Reversal Movement, F=Goods Movement for Production Order, E=Goods Movement for Sales Order, L=Goods Movement for Delivery. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material movement transaction: posted=Successfully posted to inventory and accounting, pending=Awaiting approval or verification, cancelled=Reversed or voided, error=Failed posting requiring correction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Three-digit code classifying the type of inventory movement (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Work Order, 311=Transfer Posting, 122=Return to Vendor, 701=Physical Inventory Adjustment). Determines the accounting and inventory impact. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the physical inventory count document if this movement is an inventory adjustment resulting from a cycle count or annual physical inventory. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility where the material movement occurred (e.g., WTP1=Water Treatment Plant 1, WWTP=Wastewater Treatment Plant). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material movement was posted to inventory and financial accounting. Represents the business event date for the transaction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Ten-character profit center code for internal management accounting and segment reporting. Used to allocate costs and revenues to business units or service areas. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_order_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order that this goods receipt fulfills. Typically a sequential integer (10, 20, 30, etc.). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved in this transaction, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code explaining the reason for the material movement (e.g., MAINT=Maintenance Consumption, EMER=Emergency Issue, QUAL=Quality Hold, SCRAP=Scrap/Disposal, RETN=Return to Vendor). Provides additional context beyond movement type. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this material movement is a reversal (cancellation) of a previous movement. True if this is a reversal transaction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number of the original transaction that this movement reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code for special stock types: E=Sales Order Stock, K=Consignment Stock, O=Project Stock, Q=Quality Inspection Stock, W=Returnable Packaging. Blank for standard unrestricted stock. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: storage_location_to
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the destination storage location to which material was moved. Null for goods issues to external consumption. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: text_header
attributes.description: Free-form text field at the document header level providing additional context, notes, or instructions for the entire material movement transaction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: text_item
attributes.description: Free-form text field at the line item level providing specific notes or details about this particular material movement (e.g., condition observed, special handling instructions). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=Each, GAL=Gallon, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter). Aligns with ISO unit codes.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Physical location or dock where material was received or issued. Provides granular location tracking within a plant or warehouse. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: System user ID of the person who created or posted the material movement transaction. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Code used to differentiate materials with the same material number but different valuations (e.g., different procurement sources, quality grades). Enables split valuation for inventory accounting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project WBS element code to which the material movement cost is allocated. Used for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project tracking and CAPEX accounting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Twelve-digit work order number to which material was issued (for goods issue movements). Links the material consumption to maintenance or operations activities. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master data for all physical storage locations within the utility's warehouse and field storeroom network. Captures location code, description, facility type (central warehouse, WTP chemical store, WWTP chemical store, field storeroom), address, storage conditions (temperature-controlled, hazmat-rated, outdoor), capacity, responsible custodian, and SAP MM plant/storage location assignment. Enables inventory segregation and chemical safety compliance.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse location record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: access_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours or access schedule for the warehouse location. May be 24/7, business hours only, or by appointment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the warehouse location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building, suite, or unit number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: available_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Currently available storage capacity in square feet. Updated based on inventory levels and space allocation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for capacity reporting. Supports square feet, square meters, cubic feet, cubic meters, or pallet positions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the warehouse location is situated. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the warehouse location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse location record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: custodian_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the warehouse custodian. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: custodian_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the warehouse custodian. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse location was decommissioned or ceased operations. Null for active locations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse location became operational and available for inventory storage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse facility based on its operational purpose. Central warehouse serves enterprise-wide inventory; WTP (Water Treatment Plant) and WWTP (Wastewater Treatment Plant) chemical stores hold treatment chemicals; field storerooms support distribution network maintenance; maintenance depots support asset management; emergency stockpiles hold critical spare parts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed at the warehouse location. Critical for chemical storage safety and insurance compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is certified for storage of hazardous materials such as chlorine, coagulants, polymers, and other treatment chemicals. Required for chemical procurement and FOG (Fats Oils and Grease) management compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the warehouse location and its contents. Business-sensitive financial data. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: inventory_cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency for physical inventory cycle counts at this location. Supports inventory accuracy and audit compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or compliance inspection of the warehouse location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the warehouse location record was last updated. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the warehouse location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration and logistics optimization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the warehouse location. Unique alphanumeric code used in SAP MM and operational systems for inventory transactions and storage location assignment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the warehouse location, including purpose, layout, and special characteristics. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the warehouse or storeroom location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the warehouse location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS integration and logistics optimization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next safety or compliance inspection of the warehouse location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or operational notes about the warehouse location. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the warehouse location. Indicates whether the location is available for inventory storage and transactions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the warehouse location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_custodian
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role responsible for managing and securing the warehouse location. Accountable for inventory accuracy and safety compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP MM plant code to which this warehouse location is assigned. Links warehouse location to the SAP organizational structure for materials management and procurement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP MM storage location code within the plant. Used for inventory transactions, goods receipts, and goods issues in SAP ERP. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Physical security classification of the warehouse location. Determines access control requirements and monitoring protocols. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: spill_containment_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location has spill containment infrastructure for chemical storage. Required for EPA SPCC (Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasure) compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the warehouse is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Environmental and safety classification of the storage location. Indicates whether the location is temperature-controlled, hazmat-rated for chemical storage, or outdoor. Critical for chemical procurement compliance and inventory safety. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|temperature_controlled|refrigerated|hazmat_rated|outdoor_covered|outdoor_uncovered|climate_controlled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: temperature_control_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location has active temperature control systems (HVAC). Required for certain chemical and equipment storage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum temperature maintained at the warehouse location in degrees Fahrenheit. Relevant for temperature-controlled storage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum temperature maintained at the warehouse location in degrees Fahrenheit. Relevant for temperature-controlled storage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the warehouse location measured in square feet. Used for space utilization analysis and capacity planning. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: ventilation_type
attributes.description: Type of ventilation system in the warehouse. Important for chemical storage safety and worker health compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: procurement_contract
products.description: Long-term supply agreements and blanket purchase orders negotiated with vendors for recurring procurement of chemicals, materials, and services. Captures contract number, vendor, contract type (value contract, quantity contract, framework agreement), validity period, total contract value, pricing conditions, payment terms, renewal terms, performance clauses, and associated commodity categories. Supports chemical supply continuity and OPEX/CAPEX budget management. Aligns with SAP MM Outline Agreement (EKKO with doc type MK/WK).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement contract record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Contracts reserve multi-year budget allocations for long-term planning. Critical for contract budgeting, ensuring multi-year commitments have appropriated budget authority across fiscal years. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Contracts encumber multi-year fund commitments for long-term budget planning. Critical for governmental accounting, ensuring multi-year contracts reserve appropriate fund balances per GASB standards. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor party with whom this contract is established. Links to the vendor master data. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The total number of amendments or modifications made to the contract since its original execution. Used to track contract stability and change frequency. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the goods or services covered by this contract. Chemicals include chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride, and other treatment chemicals. Other categories support infrastructure maintenance, capital projects, and operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: chemicals|pipes_fittings|pumps_motors|valves_actuators|meters_instrumentation|electrical_components|laboratory_supplies|vehicles_equipment|professional_services|maintenance_services — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of regulatory, environmental, safety, or quality compliance obligations imposed on the vendor, such as EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) chemical handling standards, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) safety requirements, AWWA (American Water Works Association) product certifications, or NSF (National Sanitation Foundation) approval for water treatment chemicals.

attributes.name: contract_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was formally approved by the authorized signatory or approval authority, such as the procurement director, CFO, or board of directors for high-value contracts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_description
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the contract scope, including the types of goods or services covered, key terms, and any special conditions. Provides context for users reviewing the contract in procurement or financial systems. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: The file path or URL to the signed contract document stored in the document management system or contract repository. Enables quick access to the full legal agreement for review and audit purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the procurement contract, typically assigned by the procurement system or legal department. Used for vendor communication and reference in purchase orders. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the procurement professional or contract manager responsible for administering this contract, including renewals, amendments, and vendor performance monitoring. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which both parties executed the contract, making it legally binding. May differ from the effective start date if the contract includes a future commencement provision. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current state of the contract in its lifecycle. Draft contracts are being prepared, pending approval contracts await authorization, active contracts are in force, suspended contracts are temporarily halted, expired contracts have passed their validity period, terminated contracts were ended early, and closed contracts are completed and archived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract based on its structure and commitment mechanism. Value contracts specify total monetary value, quantity contracts specify total quantity, framework agreements establish terms without commitment, blanket orders cover recurring purchases, service contracts cover maintenance or professional services, and chemical supply agreements are specialized for treatment chemicals. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract record was first created in the procurement system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and pricing terms. Typically USD for domestic US water utilities, but may vary for international suppliers or multi-currency organizations.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: The default delivery destination for goods or services under this contract, typically a Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP), warehouse, or central receiving facility. May reference a facility code or address. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) defining the responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer. FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), EXW (Ex Works), and FCA (Free Carrier) are common in chemical and materials procurement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract expires and no further releases or purchases can be made unless renewed. Nullable for open-ended contracts or contracts with automatic renewal clauses. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the contract terms become binding and procurement can begin releasing orders against this contract. Aligns with contract execution date or a future commencement date specified in the agreement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of the insurance coverage the vendor must maintain, including general liability, product liability, workers compensation, and environmental liability. Specifies minimum coverage amounts and certificate of insurance requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment or modification to the contract terms, such as price adjustments, scope changes, or term extensions. Nullable if no amendments have been made. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: minority_business_enterprise
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise, supporting diversity and inclusion goals in procurement. Used for compliance reporting and supplier diversity tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who last modified this contract record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract record was last updated in the procurement system. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or internal notes about the contract that do not fit in other structured fields. May include historical context, negotiation outcomes, or operational considerations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism by which payments will be made to the vendor under this contract. ACH (Automated Clearing House) and wire transfers are common for large chemical suppliers, checks for smaller vendors, and procurement cards for low-value recurring purchases. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions. Examples include NET30 (net 30 days), 2/10NET30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30), or custom terms negotiated with the vendor. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: performance_clause
attributes.description: Description of performance standards, service level agreements (SLAs), quality requirements, and penalties or incentives tied to vendor performance. May include delivery time commitments, product quality specifications, and response time requirements for emergency chemical deliveries. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Details of any provisions allowing the vendor to adjust prices during the contract term, including triggers (e.g., CPI increases, raw material cost changes), frequency of adjustments, and caps on increases. Critical for budget forecasting and OPEX management. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pricing_condition
attributes.description: The pricing structure defined in the contract. Fixed price remains constant, variable price adjusts based on market conditions or volume, cost-plus adds a markup to vendor costs, index-linked ties pricing to a commodity index, and tiered pricing offers volume discounts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: The buyer group or team within the purchasing organization responsible for this contract. Typically organized by commodity category (e.g., chemicals, equipment, services). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this contract. In multi-site utilities, different purchasing organizations may handle different regions or commodity categories. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: remaining_contract_value
attributes.description: The remaining monetary value available for future releases under this contract, calculated as total contract value minus total released value. Used for budget planning and procurement decision-making. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Free-text description of the renewal provisions, including automatic renewal clauses, notice periods for non-renewal, and conditions for extension. Critical for ensuring continuity of chemical supply and avoiding service interruptions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: small_business_enterprise
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Small Business Enterprise, supporting local economic development and small business participation goals. Used for compliance reporting and procurement policy adherence. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Summary of the conditions under which either party may terminate the contract early, including notice periods, penalties, and force majeure provisions. Important for risk management and vendor relationship governance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The maximum monetary value committed under this contract for value contracts, or the estimated total spend for quantity and framework agreements. Used for budget tracking and OPEX (Operating Expenditure) or CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) allocation. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in contract terms. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_released_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of goods or services released against this contract to date, measured in the contract's unit of measure. Used to track contract utilization for quantity contracts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_released_value
attributes.description: The cumulative monetary value of all purchase orders or releases issued against this contract to date. Used to track contract utilization and remaining available value for value contracts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the system user who created this contract record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: vendor_invoice
products.description: Vendor-submitted invoice for goods delivered or services rendered, processed through the three-way match (PO, GR, invoice) workflow. Captures invoice number, vendor, invoice date, posting date, gross amount, tax amount, currency, payment due date, payment block status, matched PO and GR references, and exception reason codes. Feeds accounts payable in SAP FI. Aligns with SAP MM Invoice Verification (RBKP/RSEG — Logistics Invoice Verification).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor invoice record. Primary key. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the goods receipt document confirming delivery of materials or services, used in three-way match validation. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line_item. Business justification: Vendor invoices are matched at line-item level for three-way matching (PO line, GR, Invoice). Currently vendor_invoice only links to purchase_order header; adding line-item FK enables precise matching. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the purchase order against which this invoice is matched in the three-way match workflow (PO, GR, invoice). Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor who submitted this invoice. Links to the vendor master record. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID of the manager or authorized approver who approved the invoice for payment. Used for segregation of duties and audit compliance. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the invoice was approved for payment. Used for approval workflow tracking and compliance reporting. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment term configuration. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or utility district that is the invoice recipient and payer. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the invoice amount is charged for internal cost accounting and budget tracking. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and processing time analysis. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount amount available if payment is made within the discount period per payment terms. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice document was received or entered into the system. Used for document control and audit trail. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of exception or discrepancy detected during three-way match (e.g., price variance, quantity variance, no PO match, no GR match). Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the invoice exception or discrepancy requiring resolution before payment can be released. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for monthly financial reporting. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for financial reporting and period closing. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number to which the invoice is posted in the chart of accounts. Determines financial statement classification. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before tax. Sum of all line item amounts for goods and services. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor issued the invoice. Used for aging analysis and payment term calculation. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned invoice number as printed on the invoice document. Business identifier for external reference. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the physical or electronic invoice was received by the accounts payable department. Used for processing time metrics. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|posted|blocked|approved|paid|cancelled|disputed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the last person who modified the invoice record. Used for change tracking and accountability. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail and version control. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount including tax. Gross amount plus tax amount. The amount payable to the vendor. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if payment is blocked and the reason (e.g., price variance, quantity variance, quality issue, missing documentation). Blank if no block. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the invoice payment is blocked. Used for exception management and resolution tracking. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was fully paid and cleared from open items. Used for cash flow analysis and vendor payment performance. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the payment transaction that cleared this invoice. Used to link invoice to payment for reconciliation. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made to the vendor per the agreed payment terms. Used for cash flow planning and avoiding late payment penalties. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the method by which payment will be made (e.g., check, wire transfer, ACH, credit card). Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_run_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was included in an automatic payment run. Null if not yet paid or paid manually. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Defines due date and discount conditions. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the water treatment plant (WTP) or wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) or facility receiving the goods or services. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was posted to the financial ledger in SAP FI. Determines the fiscal period for accounting purposes. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to related documents such as contract number, service entry sheet, or delivery note. Used for audit trail and document linkage. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice. Includes sales tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction applicable to this invoice (state, county, city). Used for tax compliance and reporting. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code if the invoice is charged to a capital improvement program (CIP) project. Used for CAPEX tracking. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the invoice payment per tax regulations. Remitted directly to tax authority. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the accounts payable clerk or system user who created the invoice record in the system. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

products.name: vendor_performance
products.description: Periodic evaluation records of vendor performance against contractual and operational KPIs including on-time delivery rate, order fill rate, chemical quality conformance, certificate of analysis compliance, pricing accuracy, and responsiveness. Captures evaluation period, vendor, commodity category, individual KPI scores, overall performance rating, corrective action flags, and evaluator. Supports vendor qualification decisions and contract renewals. Aligns with SAP MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61/ME6B).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor performance evaluation record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the procurement or supply chain professional who conducted the vendor performance evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the master contract or blanket purchase agreement under which the vendor was evaluated. Links to contract management system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master record in SAP MM. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or procurement director who approved the vendor performance evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor performance evaluation was formally approved by management. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: coa_compliance_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Analysis (COA) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of chemical deliveries accompanied by valid Certificate of Analysis (COA) documentation meeting regulatory and quality standards. Essential for water treatment chemicals to ensure Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) compliance. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Certificate of Analysis (COA) Compliance Rate Percentage

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: Category of goods or services procured from the vendor during the evaluation period (e.g., chemicals for water treatment such as chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride; equipment; spare parts; construction services). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions required from the vendor to address performance deficiencies identified during the evaluation period. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor performance deficiencies require formal corrective action plan. True if corrective action is required, False otherwise. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total order value (e.g., USD for United States Dollar).

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor performance evaluation was conducted and finalized. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the evaluator providing additional context, observations, or qualitative feedback about vendor performance during the evaluation period. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor performance evaluation, typically generated by SAP MM or procurement system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this vendor performance evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this vendor performance evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the vendor performance evaluation record (e.g., draft, submitted for approval, approved, rejected, closed). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement or supply chain professional who conducted the vendor performance evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was last updated or modified. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the scheduled delivery date during the evaluation period. Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for vendor reliability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: order_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase order line items delivered in full (complete quantity) during the evaluation period. Measures vendor ability to fulfill orders completely. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: overall_performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite rating summarizing vendor performance across all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) during the evaluation period. Used for vendor qualification decisions and contract renewals. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite score (typically 0-100 scale) calculated from weighted individual Key Performance Indicator (KPI) scores. Supports quantitative vendor comparison and ranking.

attributes.name: pricing_accuracy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices that matched contracted pricing without discrepancies during the evaluation period. Measures vendor adherence to contract terms and billing accuracy. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quality_conformance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of delivered goods or services that met quality specifications and acceptance criteria during the evaluation period. Critical for chemical procurement (chlorine, coagulants, polymers, fluoride) where quality directly impacts water treatment efficacy. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Evaluator recommendation for future business relationship with the vendor based on performance evaluation results (e.g., continue current relationship, renew contract, renegotiate terms, place on probation, discontinue). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Qualitative score (typically 1-5 or 1-10 scale) rating vendor responsiveness to inquiries, issue resolution, and communication timeliness during the evaluation period. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all purchase orders from the vendor during the evaluation period. Provides spend context for vendor importance and risk assessment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_orders_evaluated
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders from the vendor included in this performance evaluation period. Provides context for the statistical significance of Key Performance Indicator (KPI) scores. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: material_requisition
products.description: Reservation or issue request for materials from warehouse stock to support a specific work order, maintenance activity, or treatment operation. Captures reservation number, requesting department, work order or project reference, material, required quantity, required date, issue status, issuing warehouse location, and issued quantity. Bridges the asset/maintenance domain demand with supply domain fulfillment. Aligns with SAP MM Reservation (RESB/RKPF).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: material_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material requisition record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project if the requisition supports capital work. Null for Operations and Maintenance (O&M) activities. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center to which the material consumption will be charged. Used for financial tracking and budget allocation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Material issues may charge specific funds to distinguish capital vs operating expenses. Relevant for CIP work orders where materials charge capital project funds per GASB requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: General ledger account to which the material cost is posted. Used for financial accounting and expense tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or equipment for which the material is being requisitioned. Links to asset registry for maintenance context. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or equipment for which the material is being requisitioned. Links to asset registry for maintenance context. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: primary_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record being requisitioned. Links to inventory item, spare part, or chemical. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order for which materials are being requisitioned. Links maintenance demand to supply fulfillment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the material being requisitioned. Critical for chemicals and materials requiring traceability for quality and regulatory compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material requisition record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: deleted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation has been marked for deletion. Deleted reservations are retained for audit purposes but excluded from active processing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: final_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation is marked for final issue. When true, no further material withdrawals are expected and the reservation can be closed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was physically issued from the warehouse. Null if not yet issued. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issued_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the warehouse personnel who fulfilled the requisition and issued the material. Null if not yet issued. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material actually issued from warehouse to fulfill this requisition. May differ from requested quantity due to stock availability or adjustments. Ref: AWWA.
