attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material being requisitioned. Provides human-readable context for the item. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number generated upon goods issue. Links the requisition to the actual inventory transaction in SAP MM. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document. Used in combination with material document number for unique identification. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material in the source system. Stock keeping unit or material code. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material requisition record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that defines the nature of the material transaction: goods issue, return, scrap, etc. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the material requisition. May include special handling instructions, substitution approvals, or issue explanations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be issued. Calculated as requested quantity minus issued quantity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the material will be consumed. Aligns with Water Treatment Plant (WTP) or Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) organizational structure. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Urgency level of the material requisition. Emergency requisitions support critical failures; high priority supports urgent maintenance; normal and low support planned work. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who created the material requisition. Typically a maintenance planner, operator, or project manager. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material requested for reservation. Original demand quantity before any adjustments or partial issues. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit that initiated the material requisition. Typically the maintenance, operations, or project team. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: required_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material is needed to support the work order or operation. Drives warehouse picking and fulfillment priority. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material requisition: open (not yet fulfilled), partially issued (some materials released), fully issued (complete), cancelled, or closed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition based on its purpose: maintenance work, treatment operations, capital improvement program, emergency response, or planned activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reservation_date
attributes.description: Date when the material reservation was created in the system. Represents the business event timestamp for demand registration. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reservation_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the reservation document. Identifies individual material line within a multi-line reservation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material reservation in the source system. Externally-known unique code for tracking and reference. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator for special stock types such as consignment, project stock, or vendor-managed inventory. Blank for standard warehouse stock. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the material quantity is expressed: gallons, pounds, each, feet, etc. Aligns with material master base unit. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Material valuation category used for inventory accounting. Distinguishes between different stock types or procurement sources. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warehouse_location
attributes.description: Warehouse or storage location from which the material will be issued. Identifies the physical inventory source. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element for Capital Improvement Program (CIP) projects. Enables project cost tracking and reporting. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation issued to one or more vendors to solicit competitive pricing for materials or services, and the vendor responses received. Captures RFQ number, issue date, closing date, commodity description, quantity, delivery requirements, evaluation criteria, invited vendors, vendor-submitted pricing, delivery lead times, payment terms, technical compliance notes, bid comparison scores, and award decision. Supports the full solicitation-to-award lifecycle for chemicals, equipment, and construction services. Aligns with SAP MM RFQ/Quotation (EKKO doc type AN / ME41-ME49).
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the request for quotation record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: awarded_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor selected and awarded the contract resulting from this RFQ. Populated when rfq_status = 'awarded'. Links to supply.vendor. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: RFQs for project-specific equipment, materials, or services must track the driving CIP project for sourcing decisions, budget validation, and procurement documentation. Water utilities issue project-s. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: RFQs validate budget before solicitation for procurement planning. Budget control ensuring competitive solicitations only proceed when budget exists, preventing unauthorized commitments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: RFQs verify fund availability before solicitation to ensure budget exists. Procurement control preventing solicitations for purchases without appropriated funds in governmental accounting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record if this RFQ is for a specific cataloged material or spare part. Links to supply.material_master for materials procurement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_category. Business justification: RFQs are classified by procurement category for routing to appropriate buyers and compliance with category-specific sourcing rules. Currently uses denormalized procurement_category STRING; should be p. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_requisition. Business justification: RFQs are often created FROM purchase requisitions to source materials or services. Currently uses denormalized requisition_number STRING; should be proper FK to trace sourcing back to business need. C. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: awarded_amount
attributes.description: Total contract value or purchase order amount awarded to the selected vendor. Confidential business data. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: awarded_date
attributes.description: Date the RFQ was awarded to the selected vendor and purchase order was issued or contract was executed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bonding_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must provide bid bonds, performance bonds, or payment bonds. Common for construction and large equipment procurements. True if bonding is required. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: buyer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the buyer for vendor inquiries and communication. Confidential organizational contact information. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement specialist or buyer responsible for managing this RFQ process, vendor communication, and quote evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: buyer_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the buyer for vendor inquiries. Confidential organizational contact information. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the RFQ was cancelled if rfq_status = 'cancelled'. Examples: 'Insufficient vendor response', 'Budget unavailable', 'Requirements changed', 'Procurement method changed'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which vendors must submit their quotations. After this date, the RFQ is typically closed to new submissions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: closing_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp (date and time) when the RFQ closes for quote submissions. Used when exact time matters for competitive bidding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: competitive_bidding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ is part of a formal competitive bidding process requiring multiple vendor quotes. True if competitive bidding is required, False if sole-source or limited competition. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or department code responsible for this procurement. Used for budget tracking and financial reporting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the RFQ and expected quotations (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where materials or equipment should be delivered, or where services should be performed (e.g., 'Main WTP', 'North WWTP', 'Central Warehouse'). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: delivery_required_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the materials or services must be delivered or completed. Critical for operational planning and vendor evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rfq_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the materials, services, or scope of work being solicited. May include technical specifications, performance requirements, and background context. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: diversity_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RFQ includes preference or set-aside provisions for minority-owned, woman-owned, or small business vendors. True if diversity preferences apply. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: Internal estimated budget or cost target for this procurement. Typically not disclosed to vendors but used for internal approval and evaluation. Confidential business data. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria and weighting factors used to evaluate and compare vendor quotations (e.g., 'Price 50%, Delivery Time 20%, Quality 20%, Vendor Experience 10%'). Ensures transparent and objective vendor selection. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the procurement cost will be charged. Used for financial accounting and expense classification (OPEX vs CAPEX). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Applicable for equipment and chemical procurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must provide proof of insurance (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) to be eligible for award. True if insurance is required. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: invited_vendor_count
attributes.description: Total number of vendors invited to submit quotations for this RFQ. Used to track solicitation breadth and competitive participation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the RFQ was officially issued and distributed to invited vendors. Marks the start of the quotation period. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: minimum_vendors_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of vendor quotations required to satisfy competitive procurement policies. Typically 3 for formal competitive bids. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this RFQ record. Audit trail for accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the RFQ process, vendor interactions, evaluation decisions, or special circumstances. Used for audit trail and knowledge capture. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms offered to vendors (e.g., 'Net 30', 'Net 60', '2/10 Net 30'). Defines when payment is due after invoice receipt. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pre_bid_attendance_mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor attendance at the pre-bid meeting is mandatory to submit a valid quotation. True if mandatory, False if optional. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of optional pre-bid or pre-proposal meeting where vendors can ask questions and clarify requirements before submitting quotes. Common for complex procurements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location of the pre-bid meeting (e.g., 'Main Office Conference Room', 'Microsoft Teams Virtual Meeting'). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Total quantity of materials or units of service being solicited in this RFQ. Used for vendor pricing and capacity evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quotes_received_count
attributes.description: Number of vendor quotations actually received in response to this RFQ. Used to assess vendor interest and competitive response rate. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which vendors should respond with their quotations. May differ from closing_date if there is a grace period or clarification window. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rfq_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the RFQ document, externally visible and used for vendor communication and tracking. Typically system-generated sequential or pattern-based number. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rfq_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFQ: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to vendors), open (accepting quotes), closed (quote period ended), cancelled (RFQ withdrawn), awarded (vendor selected and purchase order issued). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rfq_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RFQ by procurement category: materials (spare parts, consumables), services (maintenance, consulting), equipment (capital assets), chemicals (treatment chemicals), construction (infrastructure projects), or professional services (engineering, legal). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: technical_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the technical contact for vendor technical inquiries. Confidential organizational contact information. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: technical_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the technical subject matter expert (e.g., plant operator, engineer) who can answer technical questions about specifications and requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title or subject line for the RFQ, summarizing the procurement need (e.g., 'Chlorine Gas Supply Q2 2024', 'SCADA Upgrade Services'). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA for each, LB for pounds, GAL for gallons, TON for tons, HR for hours of service). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this RFQ record. Audit trail for accountability. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: approved_vendor_list
products.description: Registry of vendors pre-qualified and approved to supply specific materials or service categories to the water utility. Captures vendor, material or service category, approval status, qualification date, expiry date, qualification criteria met (financial, technical, safety, insurance), approved spend limit, and reviewing authority. Enforces procurement compliance and ensures only vetted suppliers are used for critical chemicals and infrastructure materials.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved vendor list entry. Primary key for this registry of pre-qualified vendors authorized to supply specific materials or service categories. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who granted final approval for this vendor qualification. Links to the HR employee master for audit and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: procurement_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_category. Business justification: Vendor approvals are category-specific (e.g., approved for chemicals, not for construction services). Currently uses denormalized material_category_code STRING; should be proper FK to procurement_cate. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Vendor approvals can be tied to specific contracts (e.g., pre-qualified under a master service agreement). Currently uses denormalized contract_number STRING; should be proper FK to enable contract-ba. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor entity that has been pre-qualified and approved for specific procurement categories. Links to the vendor master record in SAP MM. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and supporting documentation summary for why this vendor was approved for the specified category. May reference evaluation scores, past performance, unique capabilities, or sole-source justifications. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier assigned to this vendor approval record for tracking and audit purposes. Used in procurement compliance reporting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor approval. Approved vendors may be used in procurement; suspended or revoked vendors are blocked from new purchase orders until reinstated. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_type
attributes.description: Classification of the approval level. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration; emergency vendors are pre-approved for urgent procurements; conditional approvals have restrictions; trial approvals are temporary for evaluation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative purchase amount authorized for this vendor in the approved category without requiring additional approval authority. Null indicates no limit. Used to enforce procurement controls and delegation of authority. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency in which the approved spend limit is denominated, using ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: approved_spend_limit_period
attributes.description: The time period over which the approved spend limit applies. Per-transaction limits apply to individual purchase orders; annual limits reset each fiscal year; contract lifetime limits apply to the duration of the approval. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: awwa_standards_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Standards Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supplies materials or services that comply with AWWA standards for water treatment chemicals, pipes, valves, and equipment. Critical for ensuring product quality and regulatory compliance.

tag_set.value: American Water Works Association (AWWA) Standards Compliance Flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved vendor list record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this vendor approval becomes active and the vendor may be used for procurement in the approved category. May differ from qualification date due to administrative processing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: environmental_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met environmental compliance criteria including EPA permits, waste disposal certifications, and environmental management system standards (ISO 14001). Required for chemical suppliers and waste management vendors.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor approval expires and must be renewed. Ensures periodic re-evaluation of vendor qualifications, insurance, and compliance status. Null for indefinite approvals. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: financial_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met financial stability criteria including credit rating, financial statements review, and bonding capacity. Required for high-value or critical procurements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: insurance_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor maintains required insurance coverage including general liability, professional liability, and workers compensation at levels specified in procurement policy. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved vendor list record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance evaluation for this vendor. Used to ensure periodic assessment of vendor performance against service level agreements and quality standards. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this vendor approval was reviewed for continued compliance with qualification criteria. Used to track periodic vendor performance and compliance audits. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: local_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is located within the utility's service area or designated local procurement zone. Used to support local economic development and reduce transportation costs and lead times. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: minority_owned_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise. Used to track diversity spend and meet regulatory or policy goals for supplier diversity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this vendor approval. Ensures timely re-evaluation of vendor qualifications and performance before expiration. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information about this vendor approval, including special conditions, restrictions, preferred use cases, or historical context not captured in structured fields. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: nsf_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supplies products certified by NSF International for use in drinking water systems. NSF 60 certification is required for treatment chemicals; NSF 61 for materials in contact with drinking water. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: performance_rating_score
attributes.description: Quantitative performance score for this vendor in the approved category, based on delivery timeliness, quality, responsiveness, and compliance. Used for vendor selection and re-qualification decisions. Typically on a scale of 0-100 or 1-5. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor successfully completed the qualification process and was approved for the specified category. Used to track vendor tenure and re-qualification cycles. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quality_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has demonstrated quality management capabilities including ISO 9001 certification, quality control procedures, and product testing protocols. Critical for treatment chemicals and critical spare parts.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended or revoked vendor approval was reinstated after corrective actions were completed and verified. Null if never suspended or not yet reinstated. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reviewing_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or committee that reviewed and approved this vendor qualification. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reviewing_authority_title
attributes.description: The job title or role of the reviewing authority who approved this vendor qualification (e.g., Procurement Manager, Director of Supply Chain, Vendor Review Committee Chair). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: safety_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has met safety requirements including OSHA compliance, safety training records, and incident history review. Mandatory for vendors providing on-site services or hazardous materials.

attributes.name: service_category_code
attributes.description: The service category for which this vendor is approved, such as construction, engineering, laboratory testing, or maintenance services. Used when approval is for services rather than materials. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: small_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a small business. Used to track small business spend and meet regulatory requirements for small business participation in public utility procurement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which this vendor approval was suspended or revoked. Used to track the duration of suspension and enforce procurement blocks in SAP MM. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this vendor approval was suspended or revoked, such as performance issues, compliance violations, insurance lapse, or safety incidents. Null when approval status is active. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: technical_qualification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has demonstrated technical competence for the approved category, including certifications, past performance, and capability assessments. Critical for specialized materials and services. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_supply_domain_flag
attributes.description: Provenance flag set during supply domain build. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: woman_owned_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a woman-owned business enterprise. Used to track diversity spend and meet regulatory or policy goals for supplier diversity. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: procurement_category
products.description: Master reference table for procurement_category.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: procurement_category_id

products.name: project_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between a vendor and a CIP project. It captures the specific role, contract terms, performance, and financial details for each vendor participating in a capital improvement project. Each record links one vendor to one CIP project with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement, such as contract value, dates, performance ratings, and the vendor's role (general contractor, design engineer, materials supplier, testing lab, specialty consultant).. Existence Justification: In water utility capital improvement programs, CIP projects engage multiple vendors simultaneously in different roles (general contractor, design engineer, materials suppliers, testing labs, specialty consultants), and each vendor typically works on multiple projects concurrently across the utility's CIP portfolio. The utility actively manages these engagements as distinct business entities, tracking contract-specific data such as awarded value, performance ratings, role assignments, and contract dates for each vendor-project combination.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry document capturing all financial postings in the water utility's books, including both header metadata and individual debit/credit line items. Header captures journal type (standard, adjusting, closing, reversing), posting date, accounting period, fiscal year, originating module, document number, posting user, approval status, and narrative. Each line item records GL account, fund, cost center, WBS element, functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction and functional currency, tax code, and line text. Supports full double-entry bookkeeping, GASB fund-level reporting, and integration with SAP FI and Tyler Munis posting documents.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GL|AP|AR|FA|PM|MM|HR|payroll|billing|asset_accounting|manual — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable lifecycle management for vendor invoices and payments at the water utility. Covers the full AP process: invoice receipt (vendor, invoice number, date, terms, amounts, PO reference, three-way match status), approval workflow, and payment execution (payment method — ACH/check/wire, payment date, bank account, cleared amount, discount taken, remittance details). Tracks chemicals, equipment, contractor services, and O&M supply procurement through to disbursement. Integrates with SAP FI payment program and Tyler Munis AP/check processing.
