attributes.description: The work breakdown structure element code for detailed project cost tracking within the grant. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: debt_instrument
products.description: Debt portfolio management for the water utility's long-term obligations including revenue bonds, GO bonds, SRF loans, WIFIA loans, and commercial paper. Covers both instrument master data (type, issuance date, maturity, principal, interest rate, bond rating, trustee, GASB classification) and debt service payment transactions (scheduled/actual principal and interest payments, payment source fund, reserve fund draws, trustee confirmations). Supports amortization schedule management, bond covenant compliance monitoring, rate case preparation, and CAFR long-term debt disclosures.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the debt instrument record in the water utility's long-term debt portfolio. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: FK to CIP project per VREQ-040. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: FK to fund per VREQ-039. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: The structure of principal repayment over the life of the debt. Level principal has equal principal payments; level debt service has equal combined principal and interest payments; bullet has single principal payment at maturity; serial has staggered maturities; term has single maturity date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bond_counsel_name
attributes.description: The name of the law firm that provided the legal opinion on the validity and tax-exempt status of the debt issuance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bond_rating
attributes.description: The credit quality rating assigned to the debt instrument by rating agencies (e.g., Moody's, S&P, Fitch). Common ratings include AAA, AA, A, BBB, etc. Higher ratings indicate lower credit risk and typically result in lower interest costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cafr_reporting_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) Reporting Category
attributes.description: The category under which this debt instrument is reported in the utility's CAFR. Water utilities typically report under business-type activities as enterprise funds. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) Reporting Category

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which the issuer may exercise the call option to redeem the debt instrument before maturity. Null if the instrument is non-callable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: call_premium_percentage
attributes.description: The premium above par value that the issuer must pay to bondholders if the debt is called before maturity, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.0000 represents 2.00% premium). Null if non-callable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: callable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the issuer has the right to redeem (call) the debt instrument before its stated maturity date. True indicates callable; False indicates non-callable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: coupon_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which interest payments (coupons) are made to bondholders or lenders. Semi-annual is most common for municipal bonds. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: covenant_description
attributes.description: Description of financial covenants and restrictions imposed by the debt agreement, such as debt service coverage ratio requirements, rate covenant obligations, reserve fund requirements, or restrictions on additional debt issuance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this debt instrument record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cusip_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) Number
attributes.description: The 9-character alphanumeric identifier assigned to the debt instrument for trading and settlement purposes in the securities market. Format: 3 digits (issuer), 6 alphanumeric (issue), 1 check digit. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) Number

attributes.name: debt_description
attributes.description: Debt description. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: debt_number
attributes.description: Debt instrument number. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: debt_service_reserve_requirement
attributes.description: The required balance to be maintained in the debt service reserve fund as specified in the bond indenture, typically equal to maximum annual debt service or a percentage of outstanding principal. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: debt_type
attributes.description: Revenue Bond, GO Bond, SRF Loan, WIFIA Loan, Note Payable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gasb_classification
attributes.description: The classification of the debt instrument for GASB financial reporting purposes. Long-term debt has maturity beyond one year; short-term debt matures within one year; current portion represents principal due within the next fiscal year; non-current portion represents principal due beyond the next fiscal year. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: instrument_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier or serial number assigned to the debt instrument by the issuer, trustee, or financial institution (e.g., bond CUSIP, loan agreement number). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: instrument_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt instrument. Active indicates the debt is outstanding and serviced; matured indicates principal fully repaid at term end; defeased indicates legally satisfied through irrevocable trust; refunded indicates replaced by new debt issuance; defaulted indicates payment obligations not met; cancelled indicates instrument voided before issuance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt instrument by its legal and financial structure. Revenue bonds are secured by utility revenues; general obligation bonds by taxing authority; SRF (State Revolving Fund) loans provide low-cost financing for water infrastructure; WIFIA (Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act) loans offer federal credit assistance; commercial paper provides short-term financing; bank loans are direct borrowings from financial institutions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: insurance_provider
attributes.description: The name of the bond insurance company providing credit enhancement for the debt instrument, if applicable. Bond insurance guarantees timely payment of principal and interest in case of issuer default. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The day-count convention used to calculate accrued interest. 30/360 assumes 30-day months and 360-day years; Actual/360 uses actual days and 360-day years; Actual/365 uses actual days and 365-day years; Actual/Actual uses actual days and actual year length. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to the outstanding principal balance, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 3.5000 represents 3.50%). For variable rate instruments, this represents the current rate. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure. Fixed rates remain constant over the life of the instrument; variable rates adjust periodically based on market indices; zero coupon instruments accrue interest but pay at maturity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: is_callable
attributes.description: Callable flag. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Taxable flag. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: isin_number
attributes.description: The 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the debt instrument in international securities markets. Format: 2-letter country code + 9-character national identifier + 1 check digit. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt instrument was originally issued and funds were received by the water utility. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Issue date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: liquidity_provider_name
attributes.description: For variable rate demand obligations, the name of the financial institution providing the standby bond purchase agreement or letter of credit to ensure liquidity if bonds cannot be remarketed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final principal payment is due and the debt instrument obligation is fully satisfied. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this debt instrument record was last modified or updated in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: original_principal_amount
attributes.description: The total face value or principal amount of the debt instrument at issuance, before any payments or amortization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: outstanding_principal_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding principal amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: outstanding_principal_balance
attributes.description: The current unpaid principal balance remaining on the debt instrument after all principal payments to date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: paying_agent_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution designated to distribute principal and interest payments to bondholders on behalf of the issuer. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific capital projects or initiatives funded by this debt instrument, including water treatment plant upgrades, distribution network expansion, wastewater treatment improvements, or other infrastructure investments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The intended use of proceeds from the debt issuance, such as capital improvement projects (CIP), infrastructure replacement, system expansion, refunding existing debt, or working capital needs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rate_case_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether debt service costs for this instrument are included in the utility's rate base for rate-setting purposes. True indicates included in rates; False indicates excluded. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rate_reset_frequency
attributes.description: For variable rate debt, the frequency at which the interest rate is recalculated and adjusted based on the underlying index. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rating_agency
attributes.description: The name of the credit rating agency that assigned the bond rating (e.g., Moody's Investors Service, Standard & Poor's, Fitch Ratings). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: remarketing_agent_name
attributes.description: For variable rate demand obligations, the name of the financial institution responsible for resetting the interest rate and remarketing bonds tendered by investors. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: security_type
attributes.description: The type of security or collateral backing the debt instrument. Revenue pledge is secured by utility operating revenues; general obligation by taxing power; special assessment by property assessments; moral obligation by non-binding commitment; unsecured has no specific collateral. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether interest income from this debt instrument is exempt from federal income tax. True indicates tax-exempt; False indicates taxable. Most municipal water utility bonds are tax-exempt. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution serving as trustee, responsible for safeguarding bondholders' interests, holding collateral, and ensuring compliance with bond covenants. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: The name of the investment banking firm or financial institution that underwrote the debt issuance and facilitated its sale to investors. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: variable_rate_index
attributes.description: For variable rate debt, the market index to which the interest rate is tied, such as SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), LIBOR (being phased out), SIFMA (Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association Municipal Swap Index), or Prime Rate. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: debt_service_payment
products.description: Debt service payment transaction recording scheduled and actual principal and interest payments on the water utility's debt obligations. Captures debt instrument reference, payment due date, actual payment date, principal amount, interest amount, total payment, payment source fund, reserve fund draw indicator, and trustee confirmation number. Supports GASB debt service fund accounting and bond covenant compliance monitoring.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: debt_service_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the debt service payment transaction. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Debt service payments for project-specific bonds must be tracked to the funded project for rate case cost recovery and debt service coverage ratio calculations. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific debt instrument (bond, loan, note) for which this payment is made. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Debt service payments are drawn from specific funds. The payment_source_fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: actual_payment_date
attributes.description: Actual payment date. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the debt service payment was approved for processing by authorized personnel. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person who approved the debt service payment for processing. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The utility bank account number from which the debt service payment was disbursed. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: covenant_compliance_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this debt service payment was made in compliance with all bond covenants and debt service coverage requirements. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the debt service payment record was first created in the system. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the debt service payment. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of days the debt service payment was made after the due date, if applicable. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: debt_service_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The debt service coverage ratio calculated at the time of this payment, representing the ratio of net revenues available for debt service to the debt service payment amount, used for bond covenant monitoring. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the debt service payment is contractually due per the bond indenture or loan agreement. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fees_amount
attributes.description: Additional fees associated with the debt service payment, including trustee fees, paying agent fees, or administrative charges. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the debt service payment is recorded. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the debt service payment is recorded for financial reporting and budgeting purposes. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The general ledger document or journal entry number associated with the debt service payment transaction in SAP FI or Tyler Munis. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the debt service payment transaction was posted to the general ledger in the ERP system. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the debt service payment applied to interest expense on the debt instrument. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the debt service payment record was last modified or updated in the system. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: late_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the debt service payment was made after the contractual due date. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount assessed for late payment of debt service, if applicable per the bond indenture or loan agreement. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the debt service payment, including any special circumstances, adjustments, or explanations. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the debt service payment was made or processed by the utility. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the debt service payment was transmitted to the trustee or paying agent. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the debt service payment, typically sequential or following a numbering convention established by the utility or trustee. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the debt service payment indicating whether it is scheduled, processed, confirmed by trustee, failed, or reversed. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt service payment indicating whether it is a scheduled payment, prepayment, defeasance, refunding, or penalty payment. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: premium_discount_amortization
attributes.description: The amortization amount for bond premium or discount allocated to this payment period, following the effective interest method or straight-line method as applicable. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the debt service payment applied to the principal balance of the debt instrument. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: reserve_fund_draw_amount
attributes.description: The amount drawn from the debt service reserve fund to supplement this payment, if applicable. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: reserve_fund_draw_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this debt service payment required a draw from the debt service reserve fund to meet the obligation. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: SAP ERP company code associated with the debt service payment transaction for multi-entity utilities. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of the debt service payment, including principal, interest, amortization, and fees. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank or financial system transaction reference number for the debt service payment, used for reconciliation and audit trail. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: trustee_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or reference number provided by the bond trustee or paying agent acknowledging receipt and processing of the debt service payment. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: Name of the bond trustee or paying agent responsible for receiving and disbursing the debt service payment to bondholders. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: tyler_munis_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Tyler Technologies Munis system transaction identifier for the debt service payment, used for municipal utilities. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

products.name: finance_rate_case
products.description: Rate case master record for formal water and wastewater rate proceedings filed with the Public Utilities Commission or approved by the utility board. Captures rate case type (general rate case, interim rate, surcharge), filing date, test year, requested revenue requirement, approved revenue requirement, rate effective date, rate case consultant, regulatory docket number, and rate design methodology. Central to utility financial planning and regulatory compliance. [SSOT canonical for service.service_rate_case] [SSOT: Canonical source of truth for this concept across domains.] SSOT master for rate cases.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: finance_rate_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate case proceeding. Primary key for the rate case master record. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: canonical_service_rate_case_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the canonical service rate case referenced by each finance rate case record in the finance domain.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to fund. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: related_service_rate_case_id
attributes.description: FK to canonical SSOT entity service.service_rate_case. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: FK to service territory per VREQ-041. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: allowed_rate_of_return
attributes.description: The overall rate of return on rate base authorized by the regulatory commission, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0725 for 7.25%). Represents the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) including debt and equity components. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: allowed_return_on_equity
attributes.description: The authorized return on equity component of the rate of return, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%). Represents the profit margin allowed on shareholder equity investment in the utility. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any party filed an appeal or request for rehearing of the commission decision. Appeals may delay rate implementation or require refund provisions. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: approved_revenue_requirement
attributes.description: Total annual revenue requirement approved by the regulatory commission or utility board. This is the final authorized revenue level after regulatory review, hearings, and adjustments. May differ from the requested amount due to disallowed costs, rate base adjustments, or modified return on equity. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: capital_improvement_program_amount
attributes.description: Total value of the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) plan supporting the rate case, covering planned infrastructure investments during the test year and rate period. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate case proceeding. Tracks progression from initial draft through regulatory review, hearings, commission decision, and final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|pending_review|hearing_scheduled|decision_pending|approved|denied|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate case proceeding. General rate case (GRC) is a comprehensive review of revenue requirements; interim adjustments address specific cost changes; surcharges recover specific program costs; cost of service reviews cost allocation; rate design modifies rate structure without changing revenue; emergency rates address urgent financial needs. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: commercial_rate_impact_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in typical commercial customer bills resulting from the approved rate case. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: consultant
attributes.description: Name of the external consulting firm or advisor retained to prepare the rate case filing, cost of service study, and regulatory testimony. Common firms include Black & Veatch, Raftelis, NewGen Strategies, and specialized rate consultants.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate case record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: customer_class_allocation_method
attributes.description: The cost allocation methodology used to distribute revenue requirements across customer classes (residential, commercial, industrial, public authority). Base-extra-capacity allocates fixed costs by capacity and variable by usage; commodity-demand splits by consumption and peak demand; customer count uses simple per-account allocation; meter equivalent weights by meter size; peak demand allocates by maximum usage contribution. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: debt_service_amount
attributes.description: Annual debt service costs (principal and interest payments) on utility bonds and loans included in the revenue requirement. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date the regulatory commission issued its final decision and order on the rate case. This date establishes the official record and triggers appeal deadlines. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: decision_document_url
attributes.description: Web link to the official commission decision document, order, or ruling. Typically hosted on the Public Utilities Commission website or document management system. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: depreciation_expense_amount
attributes.description: Annual depreciation expense included in the revenue requirement, calculated based on approved depreciation rates and asset lives for utility plant and equipment. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: docket_number
attributes.description: Official docket or case number assigned by the Public Utilities Commission (PUC) or regulatory body for tracking the rate proceeding. This is the externally-known identifier used in all regulatory filings and correspondence. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the rate case application was formally filed with the Public Utilities Commission or regulatory authority. This date triggers statutory review timelines and procedural deadlines. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: gasb_compliance_notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Compliance Notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance with Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) requirements for municipal utilities, including fund accounting, regulatory asset/liability treatment, and financial statement presentation. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

tag_set.value: Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) Compliance Notes

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the formal public hearing before the regulatory commission where testimony is presented, witnesses are cross-examined, and public comment is received. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: industrial_rate_impact_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in typical industrial customer bills resulting from the approved rate case. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: intervenor_count
attributes.description: Number of parties granted intervenor status in the rate case proceeding. Intervenors may include consumer advocates, industrial customer groups, environmental organizations, or other stakeholders with standing to participate. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate case record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: lead_attorney
attributes.description: Name of the lead legal counsel representing the utility in the rate case proceeding. May be in-house counsel or external regulatory law firm. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: next_rate_case_anticipated_date
attributes.description: Anticipated filing date for the next general rate case. Used for financial planning and analysis (FP&A) and long-term capital planning. May be driven by regulatory requirements, financial need, or strategic timing. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, regulatory conditions, or internal commentary related to the rate case proceeding. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: operating_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total annual operating expenses included in the approved revenue requirement. Includes operations and maintenance (O&M) costs, administrative expenses, purchased water, power, chemicals, labor, and other recurring costs. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: public_notice_date
attributes.description: Date public notice of the rate case filing was published in newspapers, utility bills, or other media as required by regulatory rules. Triggers public comment period. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_base
attributes.description: Rate base. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_base_amount
attributes.description: The net value of utility plant and equipment upon which the utility is allowed to earn a return. Calculated as gross plant in service plus working capital minus accumulated depreciation and contributions in aid of construction. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_case_name
attributes.description: Rate case name. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_case_number
attributes.description: Rate case docket number. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_case_status
attributes.description: Filed, Pending, Approved, Denied. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_case_type
attributes.description: General Rate Case, Interim Rate Adjustment, WICA. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_design_methodology
attributes.description: The pricing methodology used to allocate the approved revenue requirement across customer classes and rate components. Cost of service allocates based on cost causation; value of service considers customer willingness to pay; marginal cost reflects incremental supply costs; tiered conservation encourages efficiency; uniform rate applies flat pricing; lifeline protects low-income customers. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved rates become effective and are applied to customer bills. May be subject to refund provisions during appeal periods or interim rate periods. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: rate_of_return
attributes.description: Rate of return. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: regulatory_commission
attributes.description: Regulatory commission name. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: regulatory_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of days between rate case filing and rate effective date. Regulatory lag represents the period during which the utility operates under outdated rates while awaiting approval, potentially impacting financial performance. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: requested_revenue_requirement
attributes.description: Total annual revenue requirement requested by the utility in the rate case filing. Represents the utility's calculation of the revenue needed to cover operating expenses (OPEX), capital costs (CAPEX), debt service, and allowed return on investment (ROI). Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: residential_rate_impact_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in typical residential customer bills resulting from the approved rate case. Used for public communication and affordability analysis. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: revenue_increase_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the approved revenue increase (or decrease if negative) compared to current authorized revenue levels. Calculated as approved revenue requirement minus current revenue requirement. Expressed in USD. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: revenue_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage increase (or decrease if negative) in authorized revenue compared to current levels. Calculated as (revenue increase amount / current revenue requirement) * 100. Used for public communication and rate impact analysis. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: settlement_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate case was resolved through a negotiated settlement agreement among parties rather than a fully litigated commission decision. Settlements often result in faster resolution and reduced regulatory costs. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: ssot_resolution_type
attributes.description: The ssot resolution type value recorded for each finance rate case in the finance domain.

attributes.name: ssot_role
attributes.description: SSOT cross-domain reconciliation link. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: ssot_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The ssot sync timestamp associated with each finance rate case record in the finance domain.

attributes.name: test_year
attributes.description: Test year. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: test_year_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the test year period used to establish the utility's revenue requirements and cost structure. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: test_year_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the test year period used to establish the utility's revenue requirements and cost structure. The test year is the 12-month period (historical or forecasted) upon which rate calculations are based. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: test_year_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test year is based on historical actual data, forecasted future data, or a hybrid approach combining historical base with known adjustments. Regulatory bodies may have preferences or requirements for test year methodology. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record update timestamp. Ref: Oracle CC&B.

products.name: revenue_requirement
products.description: Revenue requirement calculation record supporting rate case preparation and annual budget reconciliation. Captures test year, cost of service components (O&M expenses, depreciation, debt service, return on rate base, taxes), allocated by customer class (residential, commercial, industrial, municipal), revenue sufficiency gap, and rate adjustment percentage. Supports PUC filings and AWWA cost-of-service methodology.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: revenue_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revenue requirement calculation record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: billing_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.rate_schedule. Business justification: Revenue requirements drive rate schedule design in rate cases. Rate analysts and regulators need to trace which rate schedules implement each revenue requirement calculation for cost-of-service valida. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.cip_project. Business justification: Revenue requirements include specific CIP project costs for rate base calculations, depreciation expense, and return on investment. Essential for rate case filings. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue requirements are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: finance_rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rate_case. Business justification: Revenue requirements support rate cases. The docket_number STRING should be replaced with FK to rate_case.finance_rate_case_id (note: rate_case PK is finance_rate_case_id, not rate_case_id). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Revenue requirements are calculated by fund. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Component amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the revenue requirement calculation was approved by the regulatory authority or Public Utilities Commission (PUC). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the regulatory commissioner or authority representative who approved the revenue requirement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: authorized_rate_of_return_percentage
attributes.description: The rate of return on rate base authorized by the Public Utilities Commission (PUC), typically based on the utility's weighted average cost of capital (WACC). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the revenue requirement, typically cost-of-service for water utilities following AWWA standards.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue requirement calculation in the regulatory approval process. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: capital_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Planned capital expenditures allocated to this customer class for the test year, supporting infrastructure investment and asset renewal programs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: component_name
attributes.description: Component name. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Operating Expense, Depreciation, Taxes, Return, Revenue Credit. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs among customer classes, such as base-extra capacity, commodity-demand, customer count, meter equivalent, or consumption ratio. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue requirement record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: current_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Current annual revenue collected from this customer class under existing rates, used to calculate the revenue sufficiency gap. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: The customer class or rate class for which this revenue requirement component is allocated (residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, wholesale, fire protection). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: debt_service_amount
attributes.description: Annual debt service obligations (principal and interest payments) allocated to this customer class for outstanding bonds and loans financing capital improvements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: depreciation_expense_amount
attributes.description: Annual depreciation expense allocated to this customer class based on the utility's asset base and approved depreciation schedules. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the approved revenue requirement and associated rate adjustments become effective for customer billing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date when the revenue requirement calculation was filed with the Public Utilities Commission (PUC) or regulatory authority for rate case proceedings. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: grant_funding_amount
attributes.description: Grant funding or subsidies allocated to this customer class that offset the revenue requirement, such as EPA grants or state infrastructure funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this revenue requirement record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue requirement record was last modified. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or explanations regarding the revenue requirement calculation, assumptions, or regulatory adjustments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: om_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total operations and maintenance expenses allocated to this customer class for the test year, including labor, chemicals, utilities, and routine maintenance costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: operating_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Total operating expenditures allocated to this customer class for the test year, including O&M expenses and administrative costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rate_adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate increase or decrease required for this customer class to meet the revenue requirement, calculated as (revenue sufficiency gap / current revenue) * 100. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: rate_base_amount
attributes.description: The net plant investment (original cost of utility plant in service less accumulated depreciation) allocated to this customer class, used to calculate the return on rate base. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory authority or Public Utilities Commission (PUC) that has jurisdiction over this revenue requirement filing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: return_on_rate_base_amount
attributes.description: The allowed return on the utility's rate base (net plant investment) allocated to this customer class, calculated as rate base multiplied by the authorized rate of return. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: revenue_sufficiency_gap_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the total revenue requirement and current revenue, representing the additional revenue needed from this customer class. Positive values indicate a revenue shortfall; negative values indicate a surplus. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: tax_expense_amount
attributes.description: Income taxes, property taxes, and other tax obligations allocated to this customer class for the test year. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: test_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year used as the basis for the revenue requirement calculation, typically the historical year or projected year for rate case analysis. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_revenue_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue requirement for this customer class, calculated as the sum of O&M expenses, depreciation, debt service, return on rate base, and taxes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this revenue requirement record. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: encumbrance
products.description: Budgetary encumbrance record reserving appropriated funds for committed obligations not yet expended, including purchase orders, contracts, and blanket agreements. Captures encumbrance type (pre-encumbrance, encumbrance), originating document reference, fund, cost center, GL account, original amount, liquidated amount, outstanding balance, fiscal year, and period. Essential for governmental budgetary control — prevents over-expenditure of appropriated funds and supports available balance reporting per GASB standards.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: encumbrance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the encumbrance record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project identifier or work breakdown structure (WBS) element if the encumbrance is associated with a capital project. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Encumbrances are allocated to cost centers. The cost_center_code STRING should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Encumbrances reserve funds. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Encumbrances post to GL accounts. The gl_account_code STRING should be replaced with FK to general_ledger.general_ledger_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Grant identifier if the encumbrance is funded by a federal, state, or local grant program, enabling grant expenditure tracking and compliance reporting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to purchase order. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or contractor to whom the encumbrance obligation is owed, linking to the supplier master data. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.work_order. Business justification: Purchase requisitions for work order materials create budget encumbrances before invoicing. Essential for commitment accounting, budget control, and preventing cost overruns on maintenance and capital. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period within the fiscal year when the encumbrance was recorded (e.g., 01, 02, ..., 12 or period name). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Original total amount of budget funds reserved by the encumbrance at the time of commitment, representing the expected obligation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the encumbrance was approved by the authorized approver, establishing the commitment as valid. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or authorized official who approved the encumbrance, ensuring budgetary control and authorization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: budget_line_item
attributes.description: Specific budget line item or appropriation code against which the encumbrance is charged, enabling detailed budget vs. actual tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area or segment code for internal management reporting, enabling cross-functional analysis (e.g., water treatment, wastewater, distribution). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the encumbrance was closed, either through full liquidation, cancellation, or fiscal year-end closure process. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code or Tyler Munis entity identifier representing the legal entity or organizational unit recording the encumbrance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the contract or service agreement associated with the encumbrance, if applicable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the contract or service agreement associated with the encumbrance, if applicable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the encumbrance record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the encumbrance amounts. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: encumbrance_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the purpose and nature of the encumbrance, including goods or services to be acquired. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Encumbrance amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: encumbrance_date
attributes.description: Date the encumbrance was recorded in the financial system, reserving budget funds for the obligation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: encumbrance_number
attributes.description: Business-facing document number for the encumbrance, typically generated by the financial system (SAP or Tyler Munis) for tracking and reference purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: encumbrance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the encumbrance: open (active and uncommitted balance remains), partially_liquidated (some invoices applied), fully_liquidated (all funds expended), closed (fiscal year-end closure), cancelled (voided before liquidation), or reversed (accounting correction). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: encumbrance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the encumbrance stage: pre-encumbrance (requisition stage), encumbrance (purchase order or contract issued), reservation (blanket order), or commitment (other obligating document). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when goods or services covered by the encumbrance are expected to be delivered or completed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: expenditure_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the encumbrance: capital (CAPEX for infrastructure and equipment), operating (OPEX for day-to-day operations), debt_service (principal and interest payments), or grant (grant-funded expenditure). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the encumbrance was created and against which budget appropriation is reserved (e.g., 2024). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund: governmental (general, special revenue, debt service, capital projects, permanent), proprietary (enterprise, internal service), or fiduciary (pension, investment trust, private-purpose trust, custodial). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the encumbrance record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer, capturing any changes to status, amounts, or other attributes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: liquidated_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the encumbrance that has been liquidated (expended) through invoice payments or other expenditure transactions. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information related to the encumbrance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: originating_document_date
attributes.description: Date the originating document (purchase order, contract, etc.) was issued or executed, establishing the commitment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: originating_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the source transaction that created this encumbrance (e.g., PO number, contract number, requisition number). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: originating_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that created the encumbrance: purchase order, contract, blanket order, requisition, work order, or service agreement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: Remaining amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Unliquidated balance of the encumbrance, calculated as encumbrance_amount minus liquidated_amount, representing funds still reserved for future expenditure. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that initiated the requisition or purchase request leading to the encumbrance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date the encumbrance was reversed, if applicable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the encumbrance has been reversed due to an accounting correction or cancellation. True if reversed, False otherwise. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the encumbrance was reversed (e.g., vendor cancellation, budget reallocation, data entry error). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the encumbrance record in the source operational system (SAP document number, Tyler Munis encumbrance ID). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: year_end_carryforward_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the encumbrance is eligible to be carried forward to the next fiscal year if not fully liquidated by year-end. True if carryforward is allowed, False otherwise. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Treasury management for the water utility's bank accounts and reconciliation activities. Covers account master data (bank name, account number, account type, fund association, authorized signatories, balance limits, sweep arrangements, investment policy compliance) and monthly reconciliation records (GL balance vs. bank statement balance, outstanding checks, deposits in transit, reconciling items, preparer/reviewer/approval). Supports cash management, internal controls, external audit requirements, and GASB cash and investment disclosures.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record in the water utility's treasury management system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Bank accounts are associated with specific funds in municipal accounting. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sweep_target_bank_account_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the bank account to which funds are swept when the sweep arrangement is triggered. Null if no sweep arrangement exists. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The legal name or title of the bank account as registered with the financial institution, used for identification and reconciliation purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The full bank account number assigned by the financial institution. Stored in masked format for security purposes to protect sensitive financial information. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: Operating, Debt Service, Construction, Payroll. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_purpose_description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the specific business purpose and intended use of this bank account within the water utility's operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the bank account in the utility's treasury management system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its primary business purpose within the water utility's treasury operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: authorized_signatory_count
attributes.description: The number of individuals authorized to sign checks or approve electronic transactions on this account. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the specific bank branch where the account is maintained. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the bank or financial institution where the account is held. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number that identifies the financial institution for electronic funds transfers and check processing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Account closed date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was closed or is scheduled to be closed. Null for active accounts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: The current market value of securities or other assets pledged by the financial institution as collateral for uninsured deposits in this account. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: collateralization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the financial institution is required to provide collateral for deposits exceeding FDIC insurance limits, as mandated by state law or utility policy. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account record was first created in the water utility's treasury management system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the denomination of funds held in this account (typically USD for U.S. water utilities).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current balance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: current_balance_amount
attributes.description: The most recent available balance in the bank account as of the last reconciliation or update, expressed in the account's currency. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: daily_balance_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum balance amount permitted in this account on any given day, as defined by treasury policy or regulatory requirements. Used for cash management and investment policy compliance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: dual_signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions above a certain threshold require two authorized signatures for approval, as a control measure. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: dual_signature_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount above which dual signature authorization is required. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fdic_insured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation up to applicable limits. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Flag

attributes.name: fund_type
attributes.description: The classification of the associated fund according to GASB governmental accounting standards, indicating the nature and purpose of the fund. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account earns interest on deposited funds. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The current annual interest rate percentage applied to the account balance, if the account is interest-bearing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: investment_policy_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account and its associated investment activities comply with the water utility's board-approved investment policy and applicable state and federal regulations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Active flag. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who most recently modified this bank account record. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account record was most recently updated in the treasury management system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent bank reconciliation was completed for this account, ensuring that the utility's records match the bank's records. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_amount
attributes.description: The minimum balance required to be maintained in the account to avoid fees or meet contractual obligations, particularly relevant for debt service reserve accounts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments regarding the bank account, including special instructions, restrictions, or historical context. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Account opened date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the bank reconciliation process for the most recent accounting period. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP ERP company code associated with this bank account for financial integration and reporting purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sap_house_bank_code
attributes.description: The SAP house bank identifier that links this bank account to the SAP treasury management module for payment processing and cash management. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sweep_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account participates in an automated cash sweep arrangement where excess funds are automatically transferred to an investment account or vice versa. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sweep_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The balance threshold that triggers the automated sweep of funds to or from the target account. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: trustee_agreement_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the trust agreement governing this account, if managed by a trustee. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: The name of the trustee institution managing this account, applicable for debt service reserve accounts and other trust arrangements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: tyler_munis_bank_code
attributes.description: The bank code identifier used in Tyler Technologies Munis system for municipal financial management and fund accounting integration. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this bank account record in the system. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: bank_reconciliation
products.description: Monthly bank reconciliation record matching the water utility's general ledger cash balances to bank statement balances for each bank account. Captures reconciliation period, GL balance, bank statement balance, outstanding checks, deposits in transit, unrecorded bank charges, reconciling items, reconciled balance, preparer, reviewer, and approval date. Supports internal controls and external audit requirements.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: bank_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank reconciliation record. Primary key for the bank reconciliation entity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bank account being reconciled, linking to the master bank account registry. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Approved by employee. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the authorized approver who provided final approval of the bank reconciliation, completing the control cycle. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the staff member who prepared the bank reconciliation, supporting segregation of duties and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_reconciled_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reconciled by employee. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_reviewed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor or manager who reviewed the bank reconciliation, supporting internal control requirements.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Bank reconciliations are performed by fund. The fund_code STRING should be replaced with FK to fund.fund_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Bank reconciliations match bank statements to GL cash accounts. The gl_cash_account_code STRING should be replaced with FK to general_ledger.general_ledger_id. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: primary_bank_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the staff member who prepared the bank reconciliation, supporting segregation of duties and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: tertiary_bank_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the authorized approver who provided final approval of the bank reconciliation, completing the control cycle. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: adjusted_bank_balance_amount
attributes.description: The bank statement balance after applying outstanding checks, deposits in transit, and other bank-side adjustments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: adjusted_gl_balance_amount
attributes.description: The GL balance after applying unrecorded bank charges, credits, NSF checks, and other GL-side adjustments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation received final approval, marking completion of the reconciliation workflow. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized approver who provided final approval for audit trail and reporting purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: audit_finding_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this reconciliation was subject to an audit finding or exception requiring corrective action. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: audit_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or description of any audit finding associated with this reconciliation, linking to audit management systems. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Bank adjustments amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of bank service charges, fees, and other deductions appearing on the bank statement but not yet recorded in the GL. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_credits_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of interest income, wire transfers, or other credits appearing on the bank statement but not yet recorded in the GL. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the account being reconciled. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_statement_balance_amount
attributes.description: The ending balance per the bank statement for the reconciliation period, as reported by the financial institution. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The statement date from the bank statement being reconciled, which may differ from the period end date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bank_statement_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference or document number from the bank statement being reconciled, used for audit trail and verification. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: book_adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Book adjustments amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code or organizational entity code to which this bank account and reconciliation belong. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank reconciliation record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the bank account and all monetary amounts in this reconciliation.

attributes.name: deposits_in_transit_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of deposits recorded in the GL but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the period end date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly periods) to which this reconciliation applies. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this reconciliation period belongs, used for financial reporting and compliance tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gl_balance_amount
attributes.description: The cash balance per the general ledger for this account as of the period end date, before reconciling adjustments. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gl_ending_balance
attributes.description: GL ending balance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which reconciliation adjustments were posted to the general ledger. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gl_posting_document_number
attributes.description: The journal entry document number for any GL adjustments posted as a result of this reconciliation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bank reconciliation record was last updated, supporting change tracking and audit requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: nsf_checks_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of customer checks returned by the bank due to insufficient funds, requiring GL adjustment. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: other_reconciling_items_amount
attributes.description: Net amount of all other reconciling items not classified in the standard categories, including errors, adjustments, and timing differences. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of checks issued and recorded in the GL but not yet cleared by the bank as of the period end date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: outstanding_items_count
attributes.description: Total number of outstanding reconciling items (checks, deposits, adjustments) identified during the reconciliation process. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the accounting period being reconciled, typically month-end or fiscal period-end. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: prepared_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member who prepared the reconciliation for audit trail and reporting purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: prepared_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation was prepared, distinct from the reconciliation date and period end date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reconciled_balance

products.name: project_funding_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the funding allocation contract between grant and cip_project. It captures the specific terms, amounts, and compliance requirements for how each grant funds each CIP project. Each record links one grant to one cip_project with attributes that exist only in the context of this funding relationship, including allocation amounts, eligible cost categories, drawdown schedules, and grant-specific compliance requirements.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, CIP projects are routinely funded by blending multiple funding sources: federal SRF loans, EPA WIFIA loans, state grants, USDA Rural Development grants, and local bonds. A single large infrastructure project (e.g., $50M treatment plant upgrade) may draw from 3-5 different grant programs, each with distinct allocation amounts, eligible cost categories, drawdown schedules, and compliance requirements. Conversely, a single large grant award (e.g., EPA Clean Water SRF) is typically allocated across multiple CIP projects within the utility's capital program. The allocation relationship is actively managed by finance/grants staff who track drawdowns, ensure compliance, and report to grantors on a per-project, per-grant basis.

It captures the financial relationship between a grant award and the infrastructure assets it funds. Each record links one lift station to one grant with project-specific funding details, expenditure tracking, compliance milestones, and reimbursement status required for grantor reporting and GASB grant accounting.. Existence Justification: Water utilities routinely fund capital improvements to multiple lift stations using a single grant award (e.g., an EPA WIFIA loan for system-wide pump efficiency upgrades, or an ARPA resilience grant covering backup power at 10 stations). Conversely, a single lift station rehabilitation project often requires funding from multiple grant sources (e.g., 50% SRF loan, 25% state energy efficiency grant, 25% local match). The utility must track project-specific expenditures, reimbursement requests, and compliance certifications for each lift station-grant combination to support grantor reporting, GASB accounting, and single audit requirements.

products.name: project_budget

products.name: cost_transaction
products.description: Individual cost transaction posted against a CIP project or WBS element including labor charges, material purchases, equipment rentals, contractor invoices, and overhead allocations. Tracks transaction date, cost type (labor, material, equipment, subcontract, overhead), vendor or employee reference, purchase order or work order reference, amount, cost center, fund, GL account, and posting period. Provides the granular cost ledger for project cost control, earned value management, budget vs actual reporting, and capitalization at project closeout. Sourced from SAP FI/CO actual cost postings and integrated with pay application approvals.
