attributes.description: Date when the design engineer or commissioning engineer signed off on the activity, certifying that the installation and testing meet design intent and industry standards. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: flow_test_result_gpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flow Test Result in Gallons per Minute (GPM)
attributes.description: Flow rate achieved during commissioning flow testing, measured in gallons per minute. Used to verify pump capacity, pipeline hydraulic performance, and treatment process flow rates. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Flow Test Result in Gallons per Minute (GPM)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the commissioning activity record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, lessons learned, or special conditions documented during the commissioning activity execution. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: operations_sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when operations staff signed off on the commissioning activity, certifying readiness to accept the asset into operational service and assume maintenance responsibility. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: planned date for commissioning_activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pressure_test_result_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Test Result in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Maximum pressure achieved during hydrostatic pressure testing of pipelines, tanks, or pressure vessels during commissioning. Used to verify structural integrity and leak-tightness. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Pressure Test Result in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the commissioning activity based on project criticality, regulatory deadlines, operational impact, and schedule dependencies. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Record lifecycle status. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory approval or clearance was received from the governing body, authorizing the asset to enter operational service. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory notification was submitted to the appropriate governing body for the commissioning activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory notification to EPA, state drinking water program, or other governing body is required for this commissioning activity (e.g., new water treatment plant startup, major distribution system expansion). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person responsible for the commissioning activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for coordinating and executing the commissioning activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person responsible for the commissioning activity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual responsible for executing the commissioning activity (e.g., contractor name, engineering firm, operations manager). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party responsible for executing the commissioning activity. Contractor indicates construction contractor. Engineer indicates design engineer or commissioning engineer. Operations staff indicates utility operations personnel. Vendor indicates equipment supplier. Consultant indicates third-party specialist. Regulatory agency indicates government oversight body. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: scada_integration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Status
attributes.description: Status of SCADA system integration for the commissioned asset. Not applicable if asset does not require SCADA connectivity. Operational indicates successful integration and data flow to central control system. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Status

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the commissioning activity to be completed, including all testing, documentation, and sign-off requirements. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the commissioning activity to begin, as defined in the project schedule or commissioning plan. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sign_off_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the commissioning activity. Tracks progression through required sign-offs from contractor, engineer, and operations staff before final acceptance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: test_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the test procedure document, standard operating procedure (SOP), or industry standard that governs the commissioning activity execution (e.g., AWWA C651, manufacturer startup manual).

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the commissioning activity test. Pass indicates all acceptance criteria met. Fail indicates criteria not met. Conditional pass indicates minor deficiencies that do not prevent operational turnover. Not tested indicates activity was not performed. In progress indicates testing is ongoing. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record last update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_project_domain_flag
attributes.description: Vibe project domain marker. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: water_quality_sample_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether water quality samples were collected during the commissioning activity for laboratory analysis (e.g., bacteriological testing after main disinfection, process performance verification). Ref: AWWA.

products.name: asset_handover
products.description: Asset handover record documenting the formal transfer of a newly constructed or rehabilitated infrastructure asset from the project/construction domain to the operations and asset management domain (IBM Maximo). Captures handover date, asset identifier (linking to asset domain), as-built drawing references, O&M manual references, warranty start date, warranty expiration date, installed cost for capitalization, depreciation class, responsible operations group, and acceptance sign-off by operations management. Triggers asset creation in Maximo and capitalization in SAP FI.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: IBM Maximo; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_handover_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset handover record. Primary key for this entity representing the formal transfer event from project/construction to operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: accepted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Accepting employee. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: ami_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.ami_endpoint. Business justification: AMI endpoints handed over from deployment projects to operations require tracking for acceptance testing, warranty management, operational readiness verification, and commissioning documentation. Esse. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general contractor or construction firm that built or installed the asset. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the infrastructure asset being transferred to operations. Links to the asset registry in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS).

attributes.name: asset_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general contractor or construction firm that built or installed the asset. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project or construction project from which this asset is being handed over. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_permit. Business justification: Newly constructed assets operate under specific permits (new discharge outfall under NPDES permit, new treatment process under operating permit). Operations staff need permit reference at handover for. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: construction_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction contract under which the asset was delivered. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: metering_meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.metering_meter. Business justification: Asset handovers from construction projects include meters installed during main replacements or new service connections. Linking handover records to specific meters enables operations acceptance track. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pipe_main_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pipe_main. Business justification: When new mains are turned over from construction to operations, the handover record must link to the specific pipe_main asset for warranty tracking, as-built documentation association, and maintenance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: primary_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the infrastructure asset being transferred to operations. Links to the asset registry in IBM Maximo Asset Management (CMMS).

attributes.name: pump_station_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pump_station. Business justification: Pump station handovers must link to the specific station asset for SCADA integration verification, O&M manual association, spare parts inventory setup, warranty management, and operational acceptance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: quality_sampling_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.sampling_point. Business justification: Asset handover to operations must document associated sampling points for ongoing compliance monitoring. Operations acceptance requires knowing which sampling points are now their responsibility and w. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sampling_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.sampling_location. Business justification: Asset handover transfers sampling locations from construction to operations, including compliance monitoring points, access procedures, and regulatory designation. Required for operational readiness a. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: storage_tank_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.storage_tank. Business justification: Tank handovers require direct linkage to the storage_tank asset for regulatory inspection records, coating warranty tracking, mixing system documentation, level sensor calibration records, and operati. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: as_built_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or hyperlink to the as-built engineering drawings reflecting the final constructed condition of the asset, stored in the document management system or GIS. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the asset category for maintenance planning, depreciation, and asset management purposes (e.g., water treatment plant, distribution main, pump station). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset being handed over including type, capacity, specifications, and functional characteristics relevant to operations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag or equipment number affixed to the asset for field identification and tracking in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was capitalized in SAP FI fixed assets module, triggering depreciation and inclusion in rate base for regulatory reporting. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: commissioning_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference to the commissioning report verifying that the asset has been tested, started up, and is operating according to design specifications. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset handover record was first created in the system. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the installed cost amount. Typically USD for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_class
attributes.description: Depreciation category or class code used in SAP FI to determine useful life and depreciation method for financial reporting and rate-making purposes. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: asset_handover_description
attributes.description: Free-text description. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset meets all applicable environmental compliance requirements under Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA), Clean Water Act (CWA), and state regulations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: final_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when operations management formally accepted the asset after inspection and verification of all handover documentation and commissioning results. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: Hierarchical functional location code in IBM Maximo representing the assets position within the utility infrastructure hierarchy (e.g., WTP-01/Filtration/Filter-3).

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Geographic location description or address where the asset is physically installed (e.g., facility name, street address, service area). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: gis_feature_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this asset to its spatial feature in the Esri ArcGIS Geographic Information System (GIS) for network modeling and mapping. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the asset was formally transferred from the project/construction team to the operations and maintenance team. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, outstanding issues, lessons learned, or other relevant information about the asset handover process. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: handover_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or document number for this asset handover transaction, used for tracking and reference in project closeout documentation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: handover_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset handover process indicating workflow stage from draft through final completion and acceptance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: installed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total capitalized cost of the asset including construction, materials, labor, equipment, and overhead allocated for capitalization in SAP FI fixed assets module. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset handover record was last updated or modified. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: om_manual_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or hyperlink to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manual provided by the contractor or equipment vendor for operational guidance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: operations_acceptance_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or sign-off indicator confirming that the operations manager has formally accepted the asset and all associated documentation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: operations_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the operations manager or supervisor who accepted responsibility for the asset on behalf of the operations team.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the project manager or construction manager who delivered the asset and initiated the handover process. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Record lifecycle status. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_permit_number
attributes.description: Environmental or construction permit number issued by EPA, state primacy agency, or local authority authorizing the construction and operation of the asset. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: responsible_operations_group
attributes.description: Name or code of the operations department, work center, or functional group that will assume ownership and maintenance responsibility for the asset (e.g., Water Treatment Operations, Distribution Maintenance). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: safety_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset has received all required safety certifications and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) compliance approvals.

attributes.name: sap_asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI fixed asset master record number assigned upon capitalization for financial accounting and depreciation tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: scada_integration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset has been integrated into the OSIsoft PI Historian or SCADA system for real-time monitoring and control.

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Flag

attributes.name: spare_parts_stocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether critical spare parts for the asset have been procured and stocked in inventory for maintenance support. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: substantial_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset reached substantial completion per the construction contract, typically preceding final handover and marking readiness for beneficial use. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: training_completion_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether operations staff have completed all required training on the operation and maintenance of the new asset. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record last update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years for depreciation calculation and long-term asset management planning. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_project_domain_flag
attributes.description: Vibe project domain marker. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warranty_duration_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months as specified in the construction contract or equipment purchase agreement. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or contractor warranty period ends, after which the utility assumes full responsibility for repairs and maintenance costs. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or contractor warranty period begins, typically aligned with substantial completion or handover date. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: funding_source
products.description: Funding source master record defining the financial mechanisms used to fund CIP projects including revenue bonds, state revolving fund (SRF) loans (DWSRF/CWSRF), federal grants (BRIC, WIFIA, ARPA), general obligation bonds, developer contributions, impact fees, and pay-as-you-go (PAYGO) reserves. Tracks funding source type, program name, administering agency, total available amount, interest rate (for debt instruments), compliance requirements, eligible project types, reporting obligations, and drawdown restrictions. Essential for CIP financial planning and grant compliance.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the funding source record. Primary key. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Parent project. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: debt_instrument_id
attributes.description: Linked debt instrument. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Linked grant. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: administering_agency
attributes.description: Government agency or financial institution that administers and oversees the funding source. Examples: 'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency', 'State Department of Environmental Quality', 'USDA Rural Development', 'State Infrastructure Bank', 'Municipal Bond Authority'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total amount already allocated or committed to specific CIP (Capital Improvement Program) projects from this funding source. Sum of all project allocations. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: arra_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source originated from ARRA (American Recovery and Reinvestment Act) stimulus funding. True if ARRA funding; False otherwise. ARRA funds had additional reporting and Buy American requirements. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) Flag

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the funding source was officially authorized or approved. For bonds, the issuance date; for loans, the loan agreement date; for grants, the award date. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unallocated funding available for new project assignments. Calculated as total_authorized_amount minus allocated_amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bond_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company providing credit enhancement for bond issues. Bond insurance guarantees payment and can improve credit rating. Null if no insurance or not applicable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: bond_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned by rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch) for bond issues. Examples: 'AAA', 'AA+', 'A1', 'Baa2'. Higher ratings indicate lower credit risk and typically lower interest rates. Null for non-bond funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: buy_american_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this source must comply with Buy American provisions requiring use of domestically produced iron, steel, and manufactured goods. True if Buy American applies; False otherwise. Common for federal funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_source_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the funding source used in financial systems and project documentation. Examples: DWSRF-2024-001, GOB-2023-SERIES-A, WIFIA-2025-LOAN. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of key compliance obligations associated with this funding source. Examples: 'NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act) review required; State Environmental Review Process; Disadvantaged Business Enterprise goals; Prevailing wage compliance; Single Audit Act requirements'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding source record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this funding source record. Typically 'USD' for U.S. water utilities.

attributes.name: davis_bacon_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this source must comply with Davis-Bacon prevailing wage requirements. True if Davis-Bacon applies; False otherwise. Typically required for federal grants and some SRF loans. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_source_description
attributes.description: Free-text description. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: disadvantaged_community_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source is specifically designated for disadvantaged communities (typically defined by median household income thresholds). True if designated for disadvantaged communities; False otherwise. Affects eligibility for principal forgiveness and subsidized rates. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: disbursed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount actually disbursed or drawn down from this funding source to date. For loans and grants, this tracks actual cash received; for bonds, proceeds distributed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: drawdown_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of limitations or conditions on fund disbursement. Examples: 'Reimbursement only after costs incurred; Requires pre-approval for each draw; Maximum monthly draw limit; Construction milestone-based disbursement; Retainage held until project completion'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when funds become available for allocation and drawdown. May differ from authorization date due to closing procedures or program launch delays. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: eligible_cost_categories
attributes.description: Description of cost categories eligible for reimbursement or funding. Examples: 'Design, Construction, Equipment, Land Acquisition' or 'Construction Only' or 'Planning, Design, Construction, Inspection'. Some funding sources restrict soft costs or administrative expenses. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: eligible_project_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of CIP project types eligible for funding from this source. Examples: 'Water Treatment Plant Expansion, Distribution System Rehabilitation, Lead Service Line Replacement' or 'Wastewater Treatment Upgrades, CSO (Combined Sewer Overflow) Abatement, Green Infrastructure'. DWSRF (Drinking Water SRF) and CWSRF (Clean Water SRF) have specific eligible use categories. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the funding source expires or must be fully allocated. For grants, this is the period of performance end date; for bonds, the final maturity date; for loans, the commitment expiration. Null for perpetual funding sources. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: final_maturity_date
attributes.description: Date when all principal and interest must be fully repaid for debt instruments. Null for grants and PAYGO funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: first_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the first principal or interest payment is due for debt instruments. Null for grants and non-debt funding. SRF loans often have deferred payment periods during construction. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding mechanism. Revenue bonds are secured by utility revenues; general obligation bonds by tax revenues; SRF (State Revolving Fund) loans include DWSRF (Drinking Water) and CWSRF (Clean Water); federal grants include WIFIA (Water Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act), BRIC (Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities), ARPA (American Rescue Plan Act); impact fees are one-time charges on new development; PAYGO (pay-as-you-go) uses current revenues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue_bond|general_obligation_bond|srf_loan|federal_grant|state_grant|developer_contribution|impact_fee|paygo_reserve|wifia_loan|arpa_grant|bric_grant|other — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the funding source. Available: funds can be allocated to projects; Committed: allocated but not yet disbursed; Fully Allocated: no remaining capacity; Closed: program ended; Suspended: temporarily unavailable; Pending Approval: awaiting authorization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: Funding type. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: green_project_reserve_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this funding source is part of the Green Project Reserve, which prioritizes environmentally innovative projects (green infrastructure, water efficiency, energy efficiency). True if GPR funding; False otherwise. SRF programs must allocate at least 10% to GPR projects. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate for debt instruments (bonds, loans) expressed as a decimal percentage. For example, 3.5% is stored as 3.5000. Null for grants and non-debt funding sources. SRF (State Revolving Fund) loans typically have below-market rates. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of interest rate structure. Fixed: rate does not change; Variable: rate adjusts based on index; Zero: no interest charged (some grants); Subsidized: below-market rate (common for SRF loans and federal programs). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding source record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail field. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: match_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project cost that must be funded from other sources (local match). For example, a 20% match means the utility must provide 20% and the funding source covers 80%. Zero for funding sources with no match requirement. Common for federal grants. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: funding_source_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the funding source including program name, series, and year. Example: 'Drinking Water State Revolving Fund 2024 Series A' or 'General Obligation Bond 2023 Infrastructure Series'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this funding source. Free-text field for capturing unique requirements, historical context, or operational guidance. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: prepayment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether early repayment of principal is permitted without penalty for debt instruments. True if prepayment allowed; False if prepayment prohibited or penalized. Null for non-debt funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage penalty charged for early repayment if prepayment is restricted. Zero if no penalty applies. Null for non-debt funding or if prepayment is not allowed. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: principal_forgiveness_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of loan principal that is forgiven (does not require repayment). Common in SRF programs for disadvantaged communities or specific project types (e.g., lead service line replacement). Zero if no forgiveness applies. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the funding program or initiative. Examples: 'EPA Drinking Water State Revolving Fund', 'USDA Water and Waste Disposal Loan Program', 'State Infrastructure Bank', 'Bipartisan Infrastructure Law Grant Program'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Record lifecycle status. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency for progress and financial reporting to the funding agency. SRF loans typically require quarterly reports; federal grants often require quarterly or semi-annual reports; bonds may require annual disclosure. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: reporting_requirements
attributes.description: Detailed description of reporting obligations including report types, submission deadlines, and required content. Examples: 'Quarterly progress reports due 30 days after quarter end; Annual financial audit; DBE (Disadvantaged Business Enterprise) utilization reports; Environmental compliance certifications'. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Total term or duration of the funding instrument in months. For bonds and loans, this is the repayment period. SRF loans typically have 20-30 year terms (240-360 months). Null for grants and PAYGO (pay-as-you-go) funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total funding amount. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_authorized_amount
attributes.description: Total funding amount authorized or available under this funding source. For bonds, this is the par value; for loans, the principal amount; for grants, the award amount; for PAYGO, the budgeted reserve allocation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: total_committed_amount
attributes.description: total committed amount for funding_source. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution serving as trustee for bond proceeds and debt service payments. The trustee holds funds and ensures compliance with bond covenants. Null for non-bond funding. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Record last update timestamp. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_project_domain_flag
attributes.description: Vibe project domain marker. Ref: AWWA.

products.name: funding_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a CIP project to one or more funding sources with the specific dollar amount allocated from each source. Supports multi-source funding scenarios where a single project draws from SRF loans, grants, and rate revenue simultaneously. Tracks allocation amount, percentage of total project cost, drawdown schedule, conditions precedent to drawdown, amount drawn to date, and remaining available balance. Enables funding compliance reporting and ensures projects do not exceed authorized funding limits.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: funding_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project funding allocation record. Primary key for this association entity linking a Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project to a specific funding source. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cip_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project receiving funding from this allocation. Links to the parent project entity. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Funding allocations may restrict use to specific cost centers or departments per grant or loan covenants. Required for compliance tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund referenced by each funding allocation record in the project domain.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific funding source providing capital for this project allocation. May represent State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans, federal grants, municipal bonds, rate revenue, or other capital sources. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: WBS element. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The allocated amount value recorded for each funding allocation in the project domain.

attributes.name: allocation_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount allocated from this funding source to the project. Represents the authorized funding limit that may be drawn down over the project lifecycle. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The allocation date associated with each funding allocation record in the project domain.

attributes.name: allocation_number

products.name: closeout_record
products.description: Project closeout record documenting the formal completion and administrative closure of a CIP project including final cost reconciliation, retainage release authorization, punch list completion certification, as-built drawing acceptance, O&M manual delivery confirmation, warranty registration, final regulatory inspection sign-offs, lessons learned documentation, and SAP PS project settlement to fixed assets. products.name: punch_list
products.description: Punch list record tracking incomplete or deficient work items identified during substantial completion inspection that must be corrected before final completion and retainage release. Each item tracks location, description of deficiency, specification reference, responsible contractor, date identified, required completion date, actual completion date, verification inspector, and status (open, corrected, verified, accepted). The punch list drives the critical path between substantial completion and final completion/closeout. Aggregated punch list completion percentage gates retainage release authorization.

products.name: project_schedule
products.description: Project schedule record representing the contractor's CPM (Critical Path Method) construction schedule or the owner's master project schedule. Tracks schedule version/revision, submission date, approval status, data date, project completion date, total float on critical path, number of activities, schedule basis (baseline, update, recovery), and schedule health metrics. domains.name: service
domains.description: Defines the catalog of water and wastewater services, rate structures, service tiers, contractual terms, service level agreements (SLAs), and service delivery configurations. Manages the relationship between service offerings and customer accounts, supporting rate case modeling and regulatory tariff compliance.

products.name: offering
products.description: Master catalog of all water and wastewater service offerings available to customers, including potable water supply, wastewater collection, recycled water, fire protection, irrigation, and bulk water services. Defines the canonical service type, delivery mode, applicable customer classes (residential, commercial, industrial, municipal), regulatory tariff reference, connection fee schedule, service tier options, and lifecycle status. This is the SSOT for what Water Utilities offers in the market and the anchor entity for rate schedules, SLAs, and service agreements.
products.reference: Cited standards & systems of record: AWWA; EPA SDWA

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service offering. Primary key for the offering product. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: ami_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offering requires or supports Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) for automated meter reading and real-time consumption monitoring. True = AMI required or available; False = manual or Automatic Meter Reading (AMR) only. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term. True = auto-renews unless customer cancels; False = requires explicit renewal. Null if not applicable. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: backflow_prevention_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backflow prevention devices are required for this offering to protect the public water supply from contamination. True = backflow prevention required (common for commercial, industrial, and recycled water services); False = not required. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: base_rate_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly or periodic base charge for the service offering, independent of consumption. Covers fixed costs such as meter maintenance, billing, and infrastructure access. Expressed in local currency (USD for U.S. utilities). Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle or schedule applicable to this offering. Examples: MNTH (monthly), QRTR (quarterly), BIMON (bi-monthly). Aligns with Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) billing cycle configuration. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: capacity_charge
attributes.description: Fee for reserving system capacity or infrastructure access, common in industrial and municipal bulk water agreements. May be based on meter size, peak demand, or contracted volume. Also known as a demand charge or readiness-to-serve charge. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: offering_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code for the service offering used in billing systems, tariff schedules, and customer communications. Examples: WTR-RES-01, WWC-COM-02, RCW-IND-01. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: connection_fee
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to establish a new service connection, including meter installation, service line connection, and administrative setup. May vary by customer class and service type. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: conservation_program_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers enrolled in this offering are eligible for water conservation programs, rebates, or incentives (e.g., low-flow fixture rebates, landscape conversion incentives). True = eligible; False = not eligible. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Standard contract duration in months for this offering. Common for commercial, industrial, and municipal agreements. Null for month-to-month residential service. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offering record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Customer segment or class to which this offering applies. Determines rate structure, service level expectations, and regulatory treatment. Residential = single-family and multi-family homes; Commercial = businesses and offices; Industrial = manufacturing and heavy water users; Municipal = government facilities; Agricultural = farms and irrigation; Institutional = schools, hospitals, non-profits. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the service is delivered and billed. Metered = consumption-based billing via Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) or Automatic Meter Reading (AMR); Unmetered = fixed-rate service without consumption measurement; Flat rate = fixed periodic charge regardless of usage; Seasonal = service active only during specific periods; Temporary = short-term service for construction or events; Emergency = contingency supply during outages or disasters. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Standard security deposit amount required for new customers. May vary based on estimated usage, customer class, or credit assessment. Null if no deposit is required. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: deposit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit is required for new customers enrolling in this offering. True = deposit required; False = no deposit. Deposit policies vary by customer class and credit history. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: offering_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service offering including scope, delivery specifications, and any special conditions or limitations. Used in customer agreements and regulatory filings. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: dummy_attribute
attributes.description: The dummy attribute value recorded for each offering in the service domain.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the offering is no longer available for new customer enrollment. Null for open-ended offerings. Existing customers may continue under grandfathered terms. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the offering becomes available for customer enrollment and billing. Aligns with regulatory approval and operational readiness. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: fire_protection_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offering includes dedicated fire protection service (e.g., fire hydrant access, private fire line). True = fire protection included; False = potable water or wastewater service only. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: flow_capacity_gpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flow Capacity in Gallons per Minute (GPM)
attributes.description: Maximum sustained flow rate in Gallons per Minute (GPM) that the utility can deliver for this offering under normal conditions. Relevant for fire protection, industrial, and bulk water services. Null for standard residential metered service. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Flow Capacity in Gallons per Minute (GPM)

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_percent
attributes.description: Percentage penalty applied to overdue balances after the payment due date. Subject to Public Utilities Commission regulations. Null if no late fee applies. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the offering in its lifecycle. Active = available for new customer enrollment; Inactive = temporarily unavailable; Pending approval = awaiting regulatory or internal approval; Suspended = on hold due to operational or regulatory issues; Retired = no longer offered to new customers; Grandfathered = legacy offering maintained only for existing customers under prior tariff terms. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: meter_size_required_inches
attributes.description: Standard meter size in inches required or recommended for this offering based on expected flow and customer class. Common sizes: 0.625 (5/8 inch), 0.75 (3/4 inch), 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0, 8.0 inches. Null for unmetered service. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: minimum_monthly_charge
attributes.description: Minimum amount a customer will be billed each billing period, regardless of consumption. Ensures cost recovery for fixed infrastructure and service availability. Null if no minimum applies. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this offering record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offering record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: mutator_note
attributes.description: The mutator note value recorded for each offering in the service domain.

attributes.name: offering_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service offering as presented to customers and in regulatory tariff filings. Examples: Residential Potable Water Service, Commercial Wastewater Collection, Industrial Recycled Water Supply. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: pressure_range_psi_max
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Pressure Range in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Maximum water pressure in PSI at the customer service connection under normal operating conditions. Excessive pressure may require Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) installation. Null for wastewater or non-pressurized services. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Maximum Pressure Range in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)

attributes.name: pressure_range_psi_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Pressure Range in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Minimum water pressure in PSI guaranteed at the customer service connection under normal operating conditions. Part of service delivery specifications. Null for wastewater or non-pressurized services. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Minimum Pressure Range in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)

attributes.name: rate_structure_type
attributes.description: Pricing model applied to the offering. Uniform = single rate for all consumption; Tiered = increasing or decreasing rates by consumption block (e.g., conservation pricing); Seasonal = rates vary by season (summer vs. winter); Time of use = rates vary by time of day or peak demand periods; Demand-based = charges based on peak flow or capacity reservation. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the offering and its associated rate structure received regulatory approval from the Public Utilities Commission or other governing authority. Required for compliance with rate case documentation and audit trails. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: service_domain_verified_flag
attributes.description: Marker attribute confirming service domain VREQ-016 coverage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Primary category of water or wastewater service provided. Potable water = treated drinking water supply; Wastewater collection = sanitary sewer service; Recycled water = reclaimed water for non-potable uses; Fire protection = dedicated fire suppression service; Bulk water = wholesale or large-volume supply; Stormwater = stormwater management and drainage. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: sla_response_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time in Hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours within which the utility commits to respond to service requests, outages, or quality complaints for this offering. Part of the contractual Service Level Agreement (SLA). Null if no formal SLA applies. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time in Hours

attributes.name: sla_restoration_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Restoration Time in Hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours within which the utility commits to restore service following an outage or interruption for this offering. Part of the contractual Service Level Agreement (SLA). Null if no formal SLA applies. Ref: AWWA.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Restoration Time in Hours

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for customer to terminate or discontinue service. Common for commercial and industrial contracts. Null for standard residential service. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: vibe_added_flag
attributes.description: Flag added to satisfy VIBE requirement for target touch. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: volumetric_rate_amount
attributes.description: Per-unit charge for water or wastewater service based on consumption volume. Typically expressed in dollars per thousand gallons ($/kgal) or dollars per hundred cubic feet ($/CCF). Null for unmetered or flat-rate offerings. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: volumetric_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volumetric billing. kgal = thousand gallons; CCF = hundred cubic feet; gallon = individual gallon; cubic meter = m³ (common in international contexts); acre-foot = volume unit for large agricultural or municipal contracts. Ref: AWWA.

attributes.name: water_quality_standard
attributes.description: Applicable water quality standard or regulatory compliance framework for this offering. Examples: Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) Primary Standards, Recycled Water Quality Standards (Title 22 California), Industrial Discharge Permit Limits. Null for non-water offerings (e.g., wastewater collection). Ref: AWWA.

products.name: service_rate_schedule
products.description: Defines the approved tariff rate structures for each service offering, including tiered volumetric rates (with tier thresholds, unit prices, and tier sequences), flat fees, demand charges, seasonal rate adjustments, and minimum charges. Captures the rate case approval date, effective and expiration dates, regulatory authority, rate code, applicable customer class, and billing unit of measure. Tier definitions (inclining block, declining block, uniform) are maintained as structured components within each schedule. Supports rate case modeling and regulatory tariff compliance. Aligned with Oracle CC&B rate schedule configuration. [SSOT: reference view of canonical billing.billing_rate_schedule] SSOT master for rate schedules. [finance-linked]

products.name: special_contract
products.description: Records negotiated special service contracts with large industrial, municipal, or wholesale customers that deviate from standard tariff terms. Captures contract type (industrial user, wholesale, intergovernmental), negotiated rate terms, minimum volume commitments (MGD), demand charge structure, contract duration, renewal terms, special conditions (IUP compliance, pretreatment requirements), and regulatory approval status. Distinct from standard service agreements governed by published tariffs. [finance-linked]

products.name: bulk_water_agreement
products.description: Records negotiated special service agreements with large industrial, municipal, wholesale, or intergovernmental customers that deviate from standard published tariff terms. Covers wholesale bulk water supply, industrial user contracts, intergovernmental agreements, and special pricing arrangements. Captures agreement parties, contract type, negotiated rate terms, volume commitments (MGD), demand charge structure, delivery specifications (pressure, quality), take-or-pay provisions, contract duration, renewal terms, special conditions (IUP compliance, pretreatment requirements), emergency supply terms, and regulatory approval status. products.name: offering_territory_availability
products.description: This association product represents the availability and authorization of specific water and wastewater service offerings within defined geographic service territories. It captures the regulatory approval, rate adjustments, and lifecycle management of which offerings are available in which territories. Each record links one offering to one service_territory with attributes that exist only in the context of this territory-specific availability, including territory-specific rate adjustments, franchise authorization dates, and availability status that cannot be stored on either the offering or territory alone.. Existence Justification: Water utilities operate service offerings across multiple geographic territories, each with distinct franchise agreements, regulatory approvals, and rate structures. A single offering (e.g., potable water supply) is made available in multiple territories (Downtown District, North County, etc.), and each territory offers multiple service types (potable, wastewater, recycled water). The utility actively manages which offerings are available in which territories, with territory-specific rate adjustments, regulatory authorizations, and lifecycle states that cannot be stored on either the offering or territory entity alone.

products.name: service_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a billing account and a conservation program. It captures the participation of a customer account in a specific water conservation program, tracking enrollment lifecycle, incentive payments received, and water savings achieved. Each record links one billing account to one conservation program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In water utility operations, billing accounts (customers) can simultaneously enroll in multiple conservation programs (toilet rebate, irrigation audit, rain barrel incentive, drought surcharge programs), and each conservation program serves many billing accounts. The utility actively manages these enrollments as operational business entities, tracking enrollment lifecycle, processing incentive payments, measuring water savings per account-program combination, and verifying eligibility. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where enrollment records are created, updated, and closed by program administrators. products.name: program_material_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the eligibility relationship between conservation programs and materials. It captures which materials (fixtures, devices, equipment) are eligible for rebates or incentives under specific conservation programs. Each record links one conservation program to one eligible material with program-specific rebate amounts, quantity limits, and eligibility periods that exist only in the context of this program-material combination.. Existence Justification: Conservation programs in water utilities offer rebates and incentives for multiple eligible materials (high-efficiency toilets, smart irrigation controllers, low-flow fixtures, etc.). Each material can be eligible under multiple programs simultaneously (e.g., a WaterSense toilet may qualify for both a general water efficiency program and a low-income assistance program). The utility actively manages this eligibility catalog, setting program-specific rebate amounts, quantity limits, and eligibility periods for each program-material combination to support customer enrollment and budget tracking. [finance-linked]

    - name: "blockage_severity"
      expr: blockage_severity

    - name: "weather_condition"
